descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Tongue Flicker
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
Unleash up to four consecutive attacks forward, dealing Electric DMG;
After the fourth attack hits an enemy, gain 2 stacks of [Venom]. Gain an additional 1 stack of [Venom] when hitting a Stunned enemy.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Serpent's Kiss
descriptions.description:
When [Serpent Shadow] is active, hold to activate:
Cissia leaps into the air and locks onto the target, then lands to deal Electric DMG to enemies within range;
Upon activating this skill, consumes 1 stack of [Serpent Shadow];
When hitting enemies, rapidly consumes all [Venom] and triggers [Corrosion];
Upon activating this skill, triggers [Quick Assist];
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Corrosion
descriptions.description:
Deals Electric DMG to nearby enemies;
Each trigger increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by 6%, lasting 15s. Max 3 stacks. Repeated triggers refresh the duration;
Every 6 triggers, gain 1 stack of [Serpent Shadow]. Max 2 stacks;
Upon entering the battlefield, gain 1 stack of [Serpent Shadow].

descriptions.name: Dodge: Serpentine
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: Fang Marks
descriptions.description:
Press during a dodge to activate:
Perform a quick slash forward, dealing Electric DMG.

descriptions.name: Dodge Counter: Bite Back
descriptions.description:
Press during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Leap forward and perform a sweeping attack upon landing, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Quick Assist: Alarm Device
descriptions.description:
When the active character is launched, press to activate:
Leap forward and perform a Tail Swipe attack upon landing, dealing Electric DMG;
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Defensive Assist: Seconds in the Slammer
descriptions.description:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Assist Follow-Up: Partners in Crime
descriptions.description:
Press after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Unleashes a series of downward smash attacks on the target, dealing massive Electric DMG;
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Fang
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
Launches a long-range snake bite forward, dealing Electric DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Venomous Fang
descriptions.description:
With enough Energy, press or hold to activate:
Unleash multi-hit long-range serpent strikes forward, dealing Electric DMG;
Upon activating this skill, restore 5 Energy;
When held, consumes additional Energy to launch extra strikes, consuming 20 Energy per strike and dealing Electric DMG, up to a maximum of 60 additional Energy consumed;
After holding to activate, gain 3 [Venom] stacks, plus 1 additional [Venom] stack for every 20 Energy consumed while holding;
After using this skill, immediately follow up with the 4th hit of [Basic Attack: Tongue Flicker];
A [Quick Assist] is triggered when this skill hits an enemy;
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Chain Attack: Gang's All Here
descriptions.description:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes multiple attacks forward, dealing massive Electric DMG;
Gains 3 Venom after using this skill;
A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy;
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Ultimate: Creeping Fear
descriptions.description:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate:
Launches a downward smash at enemies ahead, dealing massive Electric DMG;
After using this skill, gain 3 Venom;
After using this skill, activates Ether Veil: Serpent's Eye for 30s, increasing the whole squad's CRIT DMG by 8%;
Activating Ether Veil: Serpent's Eye again will deactivate the existing Ether Veil: Serpent's Eye;
A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy;
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Core Passive: Lethal Homebrew
skills.description:
When entering the battlefield, gain 3 [Venom]. This effect can trigger once every 180s in Investigation Zone mode.
While you have [Venom], consume 1 [Venom] every 5s while in-combat to trigger [Corrosion], dealing Electric DMG;
While you have [Venom], all squad members' Electric DMG against enemies ignores 3% of the enemy's DEF. When Energy Regen is greater than 1.4, for every 0.12 above this threshold, ignore an additional 0.52% of enemy DEF, up to a maximum of 12.88% DEF ignored. This effect lasts until 30s after [Venom] is depleted.
[Corrosion] additionally deals Electric DMG equal to 242% of the wearer's ATK;
When there are 1/2 Electric attribute characters in the squad, [Corrosion] Daze increased by 40%/60%;
When gaining [Venom], for every 1 excess [Venom], trigger [Corrosion] once.

skills.name: Additional Ability: Venom Fermentation
skills.description:
When another character in your squad has [Stun] or shares the same attribute:
While [Venom] is active, increases CRIT DMG for all squad members by 30%, and additionally increases own CRIT DMG by 20%. Lasts for 30s after [Venom] is depleted.

mindscapes.name: Traveler and Prey
mindscapes.description:
Upon entering the battlefield, [Venom] points gained increased to 6;
[Core Passive] enemy DEF ignore effect increased to 140% of the original value;
[Corrosion] DMG ignores 20% of the target's Electric RES.
mindscapes.flavorDesc: Scent, footsteps, a flickering gaze... these "traces" help me tell hunter from prey. Slip away before you become the prey, keep your head down before you become the hunter—that's my way of survival. A "home"? That's something that only shows up in fairy tales. The vast wasteland—that's my hunter's lodge.

mindscapes.name: Hunger & Hymns
mindscapes.description: When a [Chain Attack] or [Ultimate] hits a Stunned enemy, gain an additional 3 [Venom]; Increases the DMG dealt by [Basic Attack: Serpent's Kiss] by 35%.
mindscapes.flavorDesc: A place that fills my belly is a good place, and anyone who feeds me is a good person—that's the simplest, most solid truth in the world. Also—omurice is a gift from the heavens, including those leftovers on your spoon.

mindscapes.name: Chains and Cozy Nest
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc: Justice? Order? That whole righteous, upstanding thing makes my knees weak. What I know are the rules of the shadows: betrayal, deception, and how to kneel real pretty when it's about survival. I don't mind being used as a tool, long as the pay's a hot meal and a warm corner to crash in.

mindscapes.name: A Villain's Resolve
mindscapes.description: When launching an [EX Special Attack], [Chain Attack], or [Ultimate], gain 1 stack of [Venomous Fang], up to a maximum of 3 stacks. When launching a [Basic Attack: Serpent's Kiss], consume all [Venomous Fang] stacks to trigger [Corrosion] 1 additional time per stack consumed without consuming [Venom].
mindscapes.flavorDesc: The collar's ice-cold, the cuffs weigh heavy—constant reminders of sins I can't wash clean. But compared to those invisible rules and cold stares, this kind of upfront, no-BS restraint actually puts me at ease… at least I know what the price is. And hey, soon as I get back to that little nest with the couch and snacks, even these chunks of iron start to feel warm.

mindscapes.name: Lies and Fangs
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc: Memories scorched by blinding light, crimes written in black and white... these "traces" made me who I was. But things are different now—I've learned to read, and I've learned to smell deception. When that familiar scent of conspiracy drifts my way again, I won't just walk into the cage like some fool. This time, I'll be the one leaving "traces"—with my teeth, viciously.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Meteor Step
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
Unleashes up to 3 attacks forward, dealing Ether DMG.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Adorable Mine Sky Strike
descriptions.description:
Hold to charge, then release at the right opportunity to execute a Perfect Charge Attack, increasing the Daze inflicted by this skill by 20%;
Nangong Yu can execute up to three attacks, with the second and third attacks each consuming 50 [Downbeat];
When executed after [Dodge Counter], [Assist Follow-Up], [Quick Assist], [Chain Attack], [Ultimate], or [EX Special Attack], Perfect Charge is easier to achieve;
After [Chain Attack], [Ultimate], or [EX Special Attack], if there is sufficient [Downbeat], can immediately follow up with the second attack without interrupting the combo count of [Basic Attack: Adorable Mine Sky Strike];
During the first attack's charging phase, Anti-Interrupt Level increases and DMG taken is reduced by 60%;
During the second and third attacks' charging phases, character is invulnerable;
During the first attack's dash phase, can Block enemy attacks—successfully Blocking an attack counts as a Perfect Charge Attack;
Character is invulnerable during the execution of all attacks.

descriptions.name: Dodge: Natural Born Dancer
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: Revolving Meteor
descriptions.description:
Press during a dodge to activate:
Perform a quick forward attack, dealing Ether DMG.

descriptions.name: Dodge Counter: Meteor Waltz
descriptions.description:
Press during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Launch a series of attacks on the target, dealing Ether DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Quick Assist: Clutch Techniques
descriptions.description:
When the active character is launched, press to activate:
Launch a series of attacks at the target, dealing Ether DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Defensive Assist: Perfect Rhythm
descriptions.description:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Assist Follow-Up: Improv Show
descriptions.description:
Press after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Unleashes consecutive attacks on the target, dealing massive Ether DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Love That Hits Hard
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
Swing the hammer to attack, dealing Ether DMG.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: A Rather Heavy Love
descriptions.description:
With enough Energy, press to activate:
Swings the hammer to attack, dealing Ether DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Chain Attack: Comet Gravity
descriptions.description:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes consecutive attacks forward, dealing massive Ether DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Ultimate: Exiled Starstream
descriptions.description:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate:
Unleashes multiple attacks forward, dealing massive Ether DMG.
Upon activating this skill, Nangong Yu activates Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise. While Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise is active, all squad members gain an additional 50 ATK for 30s. Activating Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise again will deactivate the existing effect.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Core Passive: Genius Idol
skills.description:
Nangong Yu's Anomaly Proficiency increases by 60;
When Nangong Yu's Anomaly Mastery exceeds 110, every point of initial Anomaly Mastery above this threshold increases her Impact by 1;
When an enemy is Stunned, they accumulate 1 stack(s) of [Vibrato] each time they enter an Anomaly state, are hit by an [Abloom] attack, or a [Disorder] attack;
The same enemy can accumulate a maximum of 4 stacks of [Vibrato];
When an enemy is affected by an Attribute Anomaly state, if [Vibrato] reaches maximum stacks or when an enemy with [Vibrato] recovers from being Stunned, all [Vibrato] stacks are removed;
When [Vibrato] is removed, if the enemy is affected by an Anomaly state, Nangong Yu performs an [Abloom] attack against the target: triggering an additional instance of Attribute Anomaly DMG, with a ratio relative to the original Attribute Anomaly DMG of 720%/360%/900%/63%/90%. For every stack of [Vibrato] on the enemy, this [Abloom] attack's DMG is additionally increased by 25%. During the same Stun period, if [Vibrato] has already been cleared, the enemy cannot be inflicted with [Vibrato] again;
When Nangong Yu's [Basic Attack: Adorable Mine Sky Strike] or [EX Special Attack] hits an enemy, her Anomaly Buildup Rate is increased by 15%, Daze inflicted is increased by 11%, and DMG dealt by the whole squad is increased by 15% for 20s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
While in-combat, Nangong Yu recovers 3.5 [Downbeat] per second. When any squad member causes an enemy to enter an Anomaly state, Nangong Yu additionally recovers 15 [Downbeat]. This effect can trigger once every 6s;
Nangong Yu can have a maximum of 100 [Downbeat], and starts with 30 [Downbeat].

skills.name: Additional Ability: Angel Captain
skills.description:
When another character in your squad is an Anomaly character or shares the same Faction:
When any squad member's attacks hit an enemy in the Stunned state, their Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by 20%. Chain Attacks hitting enemies in the Stunned state gain an additional 40% Anomaly Buildup Rate increase.
When any squad member Dazes an enemy, Nangong Yu gains 2 stacks of Dance Fever, up to 2 stacks, lasting 15s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. While Dance Fever is active, when Nangong Yu's EX Special Attack, Basic Attack: Adorable Mine Sky Strike, or Quick Assist heavy attack hits an enemy suffering from both Attribute Anomaly and Stunned, she consumes 1 stack of Dance Fever to trigger a special Disorder effect called Polarity Disorder on that enemy, dealing 25% of the original Disorder DMG to the target. Polarity Disorder does not clear the target's Attribute Anomaly state. If the skill fails to trigger Polarity Disorder, Dance Fever is not consumed.
While Nangong Yu has Dance Fever active, her next switch to on-field will immediately trigger the first Charged Attack of Basic Attack: Adorable Mine Sky Strike. This Charged Attack is considered a Perfect Charge.
When both Nangong Yu and Aria are in the squad, if Aria's Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch heavy attack hits an enemy suffering from both Attribute Anomaly and Stunned, Nangong Yu will also consume 1 stack of Dance Fever to trigger Polarity Disorder on that enemy.
When the third hit of Nangong Yu's Basic Attack: Adorable Mine Sky Strike heavy attack hits an enemy, that enemy gains the Stun effect. Enemies with this effect have their Daze duration extended by 3s and their Stun DMG Multiplier increased by 30% when entering the Stunned state. The Stun effect can only trigger once per target before they recover from being Stunned. The Daze duration extension does not stack with similar effects. The Stun effect ends when the enemy recovers from being Stunned.

When the third hit of Nangong Yu's Basic Attack: Adorable Mine Sky Strike heavy attack hits an enemy, that enemy gains the Stun effect. Enemies with this effect have their Daze duration extended by 3s and their Stun DMG Multiplier increased by 30% when entering the Stunned state. The Stun effect can only trigger once per target before they recover from being Stunned. The Daze duration extension does not stack with similar effects. The Stun effect ends when the enemy recovers from being Stunned.

mindscapes.name: Lazy Spotlight
mindscapes.description: When [EX Special Attack] or [Basic Attack: Adorable Mine Sky Strike] hits an enemy, reduces the enemy's All-Attribute RES by 16% for 40s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. When entering the battlefield, Nangong Yu's [Downbeat] is restored to maximum. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
mindscapes.flavorDesc: Dreams are too much hassle and way too expensive. Standing under the spotlight? Yeah, it's just kinda warm, that's all. Honestly, teasing Sunna till she goes red, watching Aria freeze up when she's nervous, or stumbling onto the next Jin-making opportunity—now that's where the real fun is.

mindscapes.name: Painless Tears
mindscapes.description: Each stack of [Vibrato] additionally increases the [Abloom] DMG boost in [Core Passive: Genius Idol] to 35%; additionally increases the Stun DMG Multiplier provided by [Additional Ability: Angel Captain] by 20%, and increases the max stacks of [Dance Fever] to 3.
mindscapes.flavorDesc: Tears are a precious performance prop, but sadly her natural supply runs low. Lucky for her, this idol's acting chops are top-tier—she can make them fall right on cue when the moment calls for it—whether to comfort a real crybaby or milk a little sympathy from the crowd.

mindscapes.name: Chips on the Scale
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc: Dance moves can be choreographed, stage positions can be designed—even popularity and the future seem like things money can solve. Numbers bouncing around in bank accounts, that's a comforting game... until you run into a problem that doesn't have a price tag. Toying with this stack of "chips" I'm best at using, the scales of "just business" start tipping.

mindscapes.name: Partner in Crime
mindscapes.description: Anomaly Proficiency increased by 40; when triggering a Perfect Charge, the Anomaly Buildup Rate of [Basic Attack: Adorable Mine Sky Strike] is increased by 35%.
mindscapes.flavorDesc: I've always made it a point to design the most dazzling positions for Sunna, and save those sky-piercing high notes for Aria. My 'dream' was borrowed from them, but the determination to protect what I've borrowed? That's 100% mine.

mindscapes.name: Center Stage
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc: The lights of the new year rise into the sky, and the stage curtain finally opens. The stage, the lights, their profiles… everything's never been this crystal clear. Turns out I've been standing center stage in the spotlight all along—never just watching from the sidelines.

mindscapes.name: Angel's Delusion
mindscapes.description: When an enemy is not Stunned, each time they are attacked by an Agent and enter an Anomaly state, are hit by an [Abloom] or [Disorder] attack, or are struck by a heavy attack from [EX Special Attack: A Rather Heavy Love] or [Basic Attack: Adorable Mine Sky Strike], 1 stack(s) of [Vibrato: Revised] will accumulate. When struck by a heavy attack from [Ultimate: Exiled Starstream], 2 stack(s) of [Vibrato: Revised] will accumulate. [Vibrato: Revised] can accumulate up to 4 stacks. When an enemy becomes Stunned, all [Vibrato: Revised] stacks are cleared. When [Vibrato: Revised] is cleared, Nangong Yu will launch an [Abloom] attack against the target: dealing an additional instance of Attribute Anomaly DMG, at a ratio relative to the original Attribute Anomaly DMG of 800%/400%/1,000%/70%/100%. For each stack of [Vibrato: Revised] on the enemy, this [Abloom] DMG is increased by an additional 25%. [Vibrato: Revised] and [Vibrato] cannot stack with each other.
mindscapes.flavorDesc: Cameras, cheers, glow sticks... distant warmth igniting into searing fireworks. A dream borrowed from others—now fused with my flesh and blood. An intoxicating "delusion," now personally defined by Captain Nangong.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Sweet Melody
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
Launches up to four consecutive attacks forward, dealing Ether DMG.
After hitting an enemy with the fourth hit, 1 Fandom Power is generated on the field after the attack ends.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch
descriptions.description:
Hold to activate:
Aria enters a charging state and can reach three levels of charge. Releasing or reaching the maximum charge time causes Aria to unleash a powerful downward attack forward based on the current charge level, dealing massive Ether DMG.
If there is Fandom Power nearby while Aria is charging, she will absorb the Fandom Power, with each absorbed Fandom Power instantly increasing charge level by 1 and granting 1 stack of a buff that increases the next Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch's Ether Anomaly Buildup by 10%. This buff can stack up to 2 times and is removed after the attack ends.
After the 4th hit of Basic Attack: Sweet Melody, Special Attack: Full-Sugar Electronica - No Ice, an EX Special Attack, the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch, a Quick Assist, a Chain Attack, or an Ultimate, if there are at least 2 Fandom Power nearby, hold to consume 2 Fandom Power and quickly activate the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch. After the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch, a Chain Attack, or an Ultimate, if there are at least 2 Fandom Power nearby, the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch can also be quickly activated by pressing within a short window, consuming 2 Fandom Power.
Anti-Interrupt Level is increased while charging, and received DMG is reduced by 40%. Character is invulnerable while using this attack.

stats.name: Charge Level One Attack DMG Multiplier
Charge Level Two Attack DMG Multiplier
Charge Level Three Attack DMG Multiplier
Charge Level Three Attack DMG Multiplier (Coordinated)
Charge Level One Attack Daze Multiplier
Charge Level Two Attack Daze Multiplier
Charge Level Three Attack Daze Multiplier
Charge Level Three Attack Daze Multiplier (Coordinated)

descriptions.name: Dodge: On-Beat Precision
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
If activated during a Basic Attack: Sweet Melody chain, this action does not reset the Basic Attack count.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: Silky-Smooth Combo
descriptions.description:
Press during a dodge to activate:
Flies forward with a swift slashing attack, dealing Ether DMG.
If activated during a Basic Attack: Sweet Melody chain, this action does not reset the Basic Attack count.

descriptions.name: Dodge Counter: Slide-Shift Variation
descriptions.description:
Press during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Unleashes a powerful slash against the target, dealing Ether DMG.
After using this skill, it can be immediately followed up with the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Sweet Melody.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Quick Assist: Shatter Fantasy
descriptions.description:
When the active character is launched, press to activate:
Delivers a powerful slash to the target, dealing Ether DMG.
After using this skill, it can be immediately followed up with the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Sweet Melody.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Defensive Assist: Clutch Save
descriptions.description:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Assist Follow-Up: Encore Song
descriptions.description:
Press after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Unleashes a powerful series of slashes on the target, dealing massive Ether DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Full-Sugar Electronica
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
Delivers a forward kick, dealing Ether DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Full-Sugar Electronica - No Ice
descriptions.description:
After the 4th hit of Basic Attack: Sweet Melody, an Assist Follow-Up, a Chain Attack, or an Ultimate, press to activate:
Delivers a quicker forward kick, dealing Ether DMG. If the attack hits an enemy, 1 Fandom Power is generated on the field after the attack ends.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Fall Into Delusion
descriptions.description:
With enough energy, press to activate:
Delivers a powerful forward kick followed by a sonic wave attack, dealing Ether DMG. If the attack hits an enemy, 3 Fandom Power are generated on the field after the attack ends.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Instantly Hooked
descriptions.description:
After launching EX Special Attack: Fall Into Delusion, and with enough Energy, press to activate:
Performs a powerful downward attack in front, dealing Ether DMG. If the attack hits an enemy, 3 Fandom Power are generated on the field after the attack ends.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Chain Attack: Dream Collab
descriptions.description:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Launches a series of attacks forward, dealing massive Ether DMG. 4 Fandom Power are generated on the field on skill activation.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Ultimate: 100% Energy
descriptions.description:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate:
Releases all her power, entering Moment of Delusion, and fires multiple powerful shots at the target, dealing massive Ether DMG.
Upon entering Moment of Delusion, Aria gains 3 stacks of All-Out Cheering and activates Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise. While Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise is active, all squad members gain an additional 50 ATK for 30s. Re-activating Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise will first cancel any existing instance of Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise.
While Aria is charging, if she has All-Out Cheering, stacks of All-Out Cheering are consumed first to charge. Each stack of All-Out Cheering consumed increases the charge level by 2.
Upon entering Moment of Delusion, if Aria already has All-Out Cheering, all remaining stacks of All-Out Cheering are first converted into Fandom Power and generated on the field. Each stack of All-Out Cheering is converted into 2 Fandom Power.
Moment of Delusion lasts for up to 15s. During Moment of Delusion, Aria's Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch 3rd hit is upgraded to an enhanced version.
When exiting Moment of Delusion, if Aria has All-Out Cheering, all remaining stacks of All-Out Cheering are converted into Fandom Power and generated on the field. Each stack of All-Out Cheering is converted into 2 Fandom Power.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.description:

If Aria's 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch lands a heavy attack on an enemy suffering an Ether, Electric, Fire, Physical, or Ice Anomaly, it will trigger Abloom, which resolves an additional instance of Attribute Anomaly DMG. If Aria's 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch lands a heavy attack on an enemy suffering an Ether, Electric, Fire, Physical, or Ice Anomaly, it will trigger Abloom, which resolves an additional instance of Attribute Anomaly DMG. The additional DMG is calculate as 27.5%/14.3%/35.7%/2.5%/3.6% per 10 points of initial Anomaly Mastery of the original Anomaly DMG. If the target is Stunned, the DMG ratio is further increased by 50%.

skills.name: Charge Level Three Attack Daze Multiplier (Coordinated)
skills.description:
When another character in your squad is a Stun or Support character, or shares the same Faction:
When Ether Veil is activated, 4 Fandom Power are generated on the field. This can trigger once every 1s.
When any squad member applies Corruption to an enemy, its duration is extended by 3s.

mindscapes.name: Energetic Sound Waves
mindscapes.description: When Aria's Basic Attack, Special Attack, or EX Special Attack deals DMG to enemies, it ignores 10% of the target's Ether Anomaly Buildup RES. Additionally, when Aria triggers Abloom, it has a chance to trigger a critical hit. The base CRIT Rate is 25%, and CRIT DMG is 25%. If initial Anomaly Mastery exceeds 100, each additional point of initial Anomaly Mastery increases this effect's CRIT Rate by 0.5%.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"You see them? Everyone out there is waiting for us. So when the lights come up, we have to be full of energy. That's what it means to be an idol."
—A few whispered words before going on stage.

mindscapes.name: Fantastical Beat
mindscapes.description: When Aria attacks or triggers Abloom, it ignores 16% of the target's DEF. During Moment of Delusion, attacks and Abloom triggers also ignore an additional 8% of the target's DEF.
mindscapes.flavorDesc: "We don't have to sing it yet. Just close our eyes, feel it, and accept it. Then, on stage, through our performance, we'll make the whole audience fall in love with it."

mindscapes.name: Delulu
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc: "Whether it's a dream or just a delusion, we just need to keep running toward a better version of ourselves. Everyone is worthy of being appreciated, and every effort will be remembered by someone."

mindscapes.name: Mechanical Angel
mindscapes.description: When Aria triggers Abloom, she gains 4 Energy and 70 Decibels. This effect can trigger once every 10s.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
My wings are moonlight forged from tempered steel,
with lines of code, each vibration made real.
Gears bite into the rhythm of destiny,
while silent electricity roars through me.

mindscapes.name: Tears in the Rain
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc: I once saw a city swallowed by the Hollows, its order reshaped by Ether. Everything beautiful was consumed by darkness, sinking into the long river of time... like tears fading in the rain.

mindscapes.name: Construct's Dream
mindscapes.description: Upon entering the battlefield, Aria immediately gains 1,200 Decibels. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s. After Aria enters Moment of Delusion, she will not exit it, and enhanced Basic Attack: Perfect Pitch and her Ultimate deal 40% increased Ether DMG. While in Moment of Delusion, when an enemy on the field enters an Anomaly state, Aria gains 1 stacks of All-Out Cheering. This effect can occur once every 6s. When gaining the All-Out Cheering effect, if already at 3 stacks of All-Out Cheering, any excess All-Out Cheering is converted into 2 Fandom Power and generated on the field.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
Do you still remember that night in September, when love was born?
Do you still remember the dancing on the stage, in those days when we fell into delusions?

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Mischief Meteor Hammer
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
Unleashes up to four attacks ahead, dealing Physical DMG.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Naughty Cat Spotted
descriptions.description:
During combat, when Sunna is off-field and there are no enemies with Cat's Gaze, Bubblegum consumes 1 Claw Sharpener to automatically launch an attack, dealing Physical DMG.
When any squad member activates Ether Veil, Sunna gains 2 Claw Sharpeners.
When any squad member applies an Attribute Anomaly to an enemy, Sunna gains 1 Claw Sharpener. This effect can trigger at most once every 10s.
Bubblegum inherits Sunna's initial ATK. Sunna can hold up to 6 Claw Sharpeners.

descriptions.name: Dodge: Can't Hit Me
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: Skyward Hammer
descriptions.description:
Press during a dodge to activate:
Launches enemies in front into the air, dealing Physical DMG.

descriptions.name: Dodge Counter: Delusion Strikeout
descriptions.description:
Press during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Strikes enemies in front with a series of hammer blows, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Quick Assist: Sonic Beatdown
descriptions.description:
When the active character is launched, press to activate:
Unleashes a series of hammer attacks against enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Defensive Assist: Stage Fright
descriptions.description:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Assist Follow-Up: Jump Training
descriptions.description:
Press after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Continuously jumps forward on the inflatable hammer, dealing massive Physical DMG to enemies in front.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Star Shooter
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
Shoots Bubblegum to attack enemies in front using an air gun, dealing Physical DMG. After activation, Bubblegum enters combat.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Bubblegum Barrage
descriptions.description:
With enough energy, press to activate:
Hurls Bubblegum at the target, dealing Physical DMG. After activation, Bubblegum enters combat.
Upon activating this skill, all Agents in the squad gain Angelic Chord-ination for 40s.
Landing a heavy attack with this skill triggers a Quick Assist.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Special Photography Technique
descriptions.description:
While in the Angelic Chord-ination state, press to activate, or during EX Special Attack: Bubblegum Barrage, keep holding to quickly activate:
Attacks the target enemy in coordination with Bubblegum, dealing Physical DMG. After activation, Bubblegum enters combat.
Before the heavy attack is executed, activates Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise. While Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise is active, all squad members gain an additional 50 ATK for 40s. Re-activating Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise will cancel the existing instance of Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise.
Landing a heavy attack with this skill triggers a Quick Assist.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill. EX Special Attack: Special Photography Technique can be used once each time Sunna enters the Angelic Chord-ination state.

stats.name: Bubblegum Barrage DMG Multiplier when quickly chaining into Special Photography Technique
Bubblegum Barrage Daze Multiplier when quickly chaining into Special Photography Technique

descriptions.name: Chain Attack: Don't Mess With the Cat
descriptions.description:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Charges forward on Bubblegum, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Landing a heavy attack with this skill triggers a Quick Assist.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Ultimate: Smash It All!
descriptions.description:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate:
After a series of hammer attacks, launches Bubblegum to cause an explosion, dealing massive Physical DMG to enemies in an area.
On activating the heavy attack, gains 6 Claw Sharpeners.
Upon landing the downward attack from above on an enemy, triggers a Quick Assist and restores {0} HP to all squad members.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Core Passive: Cuteness Is Justice
skills.description:
Characters in the Angelic Chord-ination state gain increased ATK, equal to 30% of Sunna's initial ATK, up to a maximum of 525 ATK. When Sunna's initial ATK reaches 1,750, the ATK bonus granted to all squad members reaches its maximum.
When attacks from Basic Attack: Naughty Cat Spotted, EX Special Attack: Bubblegum Barrage, EX Special Attack: Special Photography Technique, Chain Attack: Don't Mess With the Cat, or Ultimate: Smash It All! hit an enemy, apply Cat's Gaze to the target for 12s. While Sunna is the currently active character, the duration of Cat's Gaze is continuously refreshed. Some normal enemies affected by Cat's Gaze show reduced aggression toward Sunna.
When Attack or Anomaly characters in the squad continuously land attacks on enemies affected by Cat's Gaze, Cat's Gaze is triggered and removed:
When triggered by an Attack character, deals the Agent's Attribute DMG equal to 150% of ATK to enemies in an area.
When triggered by an Anomaly character, deals the Agent's Attribute DMG equal to 240% of ATK to enemies in an area. This DMG is guaranteed to CRIT, and the CRIT DMG is increased by 80%.
DMG dealt by Cat's Gaze is treated as DMG dealt by the triggering Agent.
When multiple enemies on the field have Cat's Gaze, only the primary attack target's Cat's Gaze is triggered. Upon triggering, Cat's Gaze is removed from all enemies on the field.
When an enemy is Stunned, the number of attacks required to trigger Cat's Gaze is significantly reduced.

skills.name: Additional Ability: Daydreamer's Counterpoint
skills.description:
When another character in your squad is an Attack character or shares the same Faction:
When characters inside Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise land attacks on enemies, the target's Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 30% for 40s.
When Sunna enters the battlefield, she gains 15 Energy. In Investigation Zone mode, the effect can trigger once every 180s.

mindscapes.name: "Loneliness Corruption Symptoms"
mindscapes.description: When Sunna enters the battlefield, she gains 15 Energy. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s. When Cat's Gaze triggers and damages an enemy, the target's DEF is reduced by 7% for 40s, stacking up to 3 times. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
It didn't matter if no one understood her. As long as she had music, that was enough. It didn't matter if no one ever talked to her first, either. She'd never expected them to anyway...
Being surrounded by people made her so nervous that she fled the world, using delusions to fill the empty space it left behind. She was the master of her own tiny realm, setting up "keep out" warnings at the edges, then painting everything bright with music.
"I'm not like them. I—I'm a lonely genius!"
She puffed out her cheeks and quietly wiped away the lonely tear that slipped from the corner of her eye.

mindscapes.name: "Feline Go-With-the-Flow"
mindscapes.description:
While Sunna is within any Ether Veil, all squad members gain 10% ATK and she obtains 1 Claw Sharpener every 10s. The number of attacks required to trigger Cat's Gaze is reduced, and the DMG Multiplier on trigger is increased:
When triggered by an Attack character, the DMG Multiplier is increased by 200%.
When triggered by an Anomaly character, the DMG Multiplier is increased by 300%.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"That kid's an odd one, always humming strange songs alone in the corner..."
Having heard such remarks all her life, she stopped hoping for any other kind of judgment.
Then, one warm and gentle afternoon, a dark-haired girl stretched her hand out like an angel.
Ah... so she had always been seeking this sense of being understood. Always... waiting for someone she could call a friend.
Even having grown accustomed to loneliness from endless practice, humans are still, in the end, social animals. That person lifted her out of damp, clinging solitude, and from then on, she had a shelter made of feathers.

mindscapes.name: "Transformation Apple"
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
She has never before received praise from so many strangers.
"Those gentle songs gave me strength."
"Finding music I could resonate with at my saddest moment was so moving..."
"This style of music is so cute!!"
The girl stares nervously at the screen. The small red dot marking new messages quivers along with her heartbeat, as she opens the same window over and over again—
Just a little more... just a few more people seeing my music... a few more people seeing me, someone who's good for nothing but writing music...
All I want is for a few more people to take power from this.

mindscapes.name: "Delusion Investigation Team"
mindscapes.description: When Sunna uses her Ultimate, all squad members deal 18% increased DMG for 60s.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
From being dragged out the door by Nangong to signing her name on that contract... to the girl, the entire day passed as swiftly as a flash of summer lightning cutting through a rainy night.
Like a dream, like playing house... in the end, it all belonged to the realm of "delusion."
The moment they walked out, they were no longer three separate individuals, but a group: the Angels of Delusion. And the moment she walked out, she stopped being only Sunna, the songwriter working behind the scenes, and became an idol standing before her fans, expressing herself onstage.
—This overwhelming delusion descending upon her was the most incredible gift she had ever known.

mindscapes.name: "Galaxy Tramway"
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
The stars were strung across the night like gas lamps lit at dusk.
She imagined that somewhere in the vast galaxy, someone was driving a clattering electric tram, setting off from pale morning light and heading straight toward infinity.
The passengers were all adorable little creatures like cats, dogs, and bunnies, and the conductor was fluent in the languages of deep-sea fish and owls.
Leaving behind the rush of everyday life, stepping away from mundane routines—
"If I could borrow the wings of the Angels of Delusion, maybe I could bring everyone into a world of music like this!"
Surrounded by the sugary aroma of a scented candle, she stretched with a soft yawn, then wrote this romantic dream onto the sheet music.

mindscapes.name: "Hollow Big Bang"
mindscapes.description:
When Sunna uses an EX Special Attack, she enters the Focused Creation! state for 8s.
While in the Focused Creation! state, all attacks Sunna performs are guaranteed to CRIT, and her CRIT DMG increases by 0.03% of her initial ATK, up to a maximum of 105%.
While in the Focused Creation! state, Sunna's Anti-Interrupt Level is increased, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
While in the Focused Creation! state, Sunna can trigger Cat's Gaze, its DMG being calculated using Attack Agent rules. If Cat's Gaze is triggered while Sunna has a Claw Sharpener, the Claw Sharpener is immediately consumed, and Cat's Gaze is reapplied to the enemy.
While in the Focused Creation! state, DMG dealt when any squad member triggers Cat's Gaze increases by 50%.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"Why did you choose to step onto the stage?"
Was it for the fans? For the glory under the spotlight? Or for that version of yourself who stayed in the corner, watching others play, too afraid to step forward?
Maybe it was all of those. Or maybe it was none of them.
All the girl knew was that the moment she gripped the microphone, her heartbeat would slow, and the world around her would fall quiet... until the drums kicked in, and the music rippled across the stage. In that split second, music's gentle light illuminated the time they all shared together.
It felt as if they were angels, with wings capable of carrying everyone away from "the here and now."

skins.name: Clouddrift Illumination
skins.description:
Cloud-woven silk, a blade's gleam reflected in its folds. The attire mirrors the person.
But who truly chose this dress? Was it her... or the deeper self within?

skins.name: Touch of Dawnlight
skins.description: The gentle glow of sunlight and warm breeze seem to welcome your next encounter as you walk down the streets.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Swiftedge
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
Launches up to four forward slashes, dealing Physical DMG.
Can be chained into Dash Attack: Phantasm Dash after the 4th hit.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Cloudstream Sword Will
descriptions.description:
Hold to activate:
Launches a flurry of blade shockwaves, dealing Physical DMG. Hold to extend the attack.
Anti-Interrupt Level is increased during this skill.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Splitting Currents
descriptions.description:
While in the Enlightened Mind state and on the ground, press to activate:
Performs up to three forward slashes, dealing Physical DMG.
If struck by an enemy attack during the 3rd hit, triggers a block, negating that instance of DMG.
If she possesses Qingming Sword Force, the 3rd hit is replaced with Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Skyward Ascent.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Skyward Ascent
descriptions.description:
While in the Enlightened Mind state and with Qingming Sword Force, after the 2nd hit of Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Splitting Currents, press to activate:
Launches a swift rising attack, dealing Physical DMG and entering an airborne state.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Maximum
descriptions.description:
After activating Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Annihilation, and with Qingming Sword Force, press to activate:
Launches a wide sweeping slash forward, dealing massive Physical DMG. On hit, 1 point of Qingming Sword Force is consumed.
If struck by an enemy during the skill, triggers a block, negating that instance of DMG and increasing the skill's Interrupt Level.
After using this skill and with Qingming Sword Force, press to consume 1 point of Qingming Sword Force and launch a hit of EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Soaring Light. This skill is automatically followed up with Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Skyward Ascent, and Ye Shunguang enters an airborne state.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight
descriptions.description:
In the Enlightened Mind state, and while airborne, press to activate:
Launches up to two downward slashes in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Ye Shunguang will not exit the Enlightened Mind state during this skill.
Press or to follow up with Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Annihilation.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Annihilation
descriptions.description:
After the 2nd hit of Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight, press to activate:
Performs a falling attack in front, entering a grounded state, and dealing Physical DMG.
When launching this skill with 2 or more points of Qingming Sword Force, Ye Shunguang will perform a downward falling strike across a large area in front instead, dealing massive Physical DMG. On hit, 2 points of Qingming Sword Force are consumed, granting the Culmination effect. After using this skill, if Ye Shunguang possesses Qingming Sword Force, press to consume 1 point of Qingming Sword Force and launch a hit of EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Soaring Light, which can be quickly followed up with Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Maximum.
Ye Shunguang will not exit the Enlightened Mind state during this skill.
During this skill, if attacked by enemies, triggers a block, negating that instance of DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Culmination
descriptions.description: During EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Soaring Light, each time Qingming Sword Force is consumed while Culmination is active, the Qingming Sword Force cost is replaced by consuming Culmination instead. This effect does not stack, and lasts until the current Enlightened Mind ends.

Press to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
During the Enlightened Mind state, and if a Perfect Dodge is triggered, press to activate Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Skyward Ascent.

descriptions.name: Dodge: Wandering Cloud
descriptions.description:
While tilting the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick}, hold to activate:
Enters a high-speed movement state. Steer with the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick}, and release the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} to stop.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: Phantasm Dash
descriptions.description:
Press during a dodge to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.

descriptions.name: Dodge Counter: Swallow Strike
descriptions.description:
Press during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Leaps into the air and thrusts forward, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Entry Skill: Illuminating Darkness
descriptions.description:
With 6 Qingming Sword Force and while not in the Enlightened Mind state, hold to activate, or press while in combat and switch on-field from off-field to activate:
Enters the Enlightened Mind state and activates Ether Veil: Verdict.
Deals Physical DMG to enemies in a large area in front.
Activating this skill is considered as activating a Quick Assist.
Enters the airborne state after using this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Quick Assist: Support Guard
descriptions.description:
When the active character is launched, press to activate:
Leaps into the air and thrusts forward, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Assist Follow-Up: Cease Hostility
descriptions.description:
Press after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Deals massive Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Defensive Assist: When I Return
descriptions.description:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Quick Assist: Enlightened Mind - Tactical Support
descriptions.description:
While in the Enlightened Mind state, when the active character is launched, press to activate:
Launches a forward slash, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Assist Follow-Up: Enlightened Mind - Unification
descriptions.description:
While in the Enlightened Mind state and after a Defensive Assist, press to activate:
Deals massive Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Guiding Tides
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
If a dodge is available, 1 dodge chance is consumed, and the action is counted as activating a Dodge.
If no dodge is available or a Perfect Dodge is not triggered, launches a quick sword energy attack that deals Physical DMG.
If a Perfect Dodge is triggered at this time, launches a flying sword attack, dealing Physical DMG, and immediately follow up with the 2nd hit of Basic Attack: Swiftedge.
Character is briefly invulnerable during the skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Gale Suppression
descriptions.description:
With enough Energy, press to activate:
Launches a rushing slash and a flying sword attack at the enemy, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Enemy attacks can be dodged during this skill.
After this skill is used, gain 1 point of Qingming Sword Force.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Clean Exit
descriptions.description:
While in the Enlightened Mind state and grounded, press to activate:
Performs a swift backstep slash, dealing Physical DMG.
If a dodge is available, 1 dodge chance is consumed, and the action is counted as activating a Dodge.
If a Perfect Dodge is triggered at this time, press to quickly activate Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Maximum and enter Vital View.
After this Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Maximum activates, it can be immediately followed up with Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Skyward Ascent.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Soaring Light
descriptions.description:
In the Enlightened Mind state and with Qingming Sword Force, hold to activate:
Performs quick consecutive slashes, dealing massive Physical DMG while rapidly consuming Qingming Sword Force until none remains.
The skill ends early if Qingming Sword Force is insufficient or if is released.
Ye Shunguang will not exit the Enlightened Mind state during this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Return to Dust
descriptions.description:
In the Enlightened Mind state, press or hold when all Qingming Sword Force is expended to activate:
Deals massive Physical DMG to enemies in a large area.
Ye Shunguang will not exit the Enlightened Mind state during this skill.
After using this skill, Ether Veil: Verdict is removed and the Enlightened Mind state ends.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.description:

Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Ultimate: Chasing Storms
descriptions.description:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate:
Summons a sword formation and enter the Enlightened Mind state, activating an Ether Veil: Verdict while also gaining 6 Qingming Sword Force. This skill deals massive Physical DMG.
Upon activating this skill, if Decibels are consumed, press while in this Enlightened Mind state to launch an Ultimate: Cleaving Heavens that doesn't consume Decibels.
Enter the airborne state after using this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Chain Attack: Enlightened Mind - Lure Thunder
descriptions.description:
While in the Enlightened Mind state, and when a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a powerful slash at enemies ahead in a large area, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Ye Shunguang will not exit the Enlightened Mind state during this skill.
Enter the airborne state after using this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Ultimate: Cleaving Heavens
descriptions.description:
After consuming Decibels to launch Ultimate: Chasing Storms and while in the Enlightened Mind state, press or hold when all Qingming Sword Force is expended to activate:
Summons a massive blade, dealing massive Physical DMG to enemies.
Ye Shunguang will not exit the Enlightened Mind state during this skill.
After using this skill, the Enlightened Mind state ends, and Ether Veil: Verdict is removed.
This skill doesn't consume Decibels.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Core Passive: Burning Clarity
skills.description:
When not in the Enlightened Mind state and with fewer than 6 points of Qingming Sword Force, certain attacks slowly build Qingming Sword Force. Whenever Qingming Sword Force is gained by any means, each 1 point of Qingming Sword Force that exceeds the limit is converted into 1 stack of Bearer, stacking up to 3 times. Upon leaving the Enlightened Mind state, all Bearer stacks are consumed to grant the same number of Qingming Sword Force stacks.
Upon entering the battlefield, gain Unity, increasing CRIT Rate by 15% and DMG by 10%.
When Ultimate: Chasing Storms or Entry Skill: Illuminating Darkness is unleashed, Ye Shunguang enters the Enlightened Mind state and activates Ether Veil: Verdict. Ether Veil: Verdict has the same duration as Enlightened Mind. The duration lasts 16s, and the duration timer pauses while she is off-field. During the Enlightened Mind state, Ye Shunguang's skills are enhanced, all Physical DMG dealt by her skills becomes Honed Edge DMG.
While Ether Veil: Verdict is active, when an enemy enters Ether Veil: Verdict, they gain a Veil Vulnerability effect based on their current Stun DMG Multiplier. During this, when Ye Shunguang deals DMG to enemies with her skills, enemy Stun DMG Multiplier is ignored and replaced with the Veil Vulnerability bonus. Veil Vulnerability caps at 110%. The effect is removed when Ether Veil: Verdict ends.

skills.name: Additional Ability: Shadowtrace Flight
skills.description:
When another character in your squad is a Support or Defense character:
When a squadmate activates any Ether Veil, gain 3 points of Qingming Sword Force. If already in the Enlightened Mind state, this is instead converted into 3 stacks of Bearer.

mindscapes.name: Dreambound Self
mindscapes.description:
Upon entering the battlefield, gains 6 Qingming Sword Force. This effect can trigger once every 180s in Investigation Zone mode.
The Unity effect from Core Passive: Burning Clarity increases DMG dealt by an additional 10%, and they ignore 20% of the target's DEF.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
Countless times, in the dead of night, she finds herself returning to that day...
Steel cried out, the sword acknowledged its wielder, and a contract was forged.
Was it a blessing, or a curse?

...No one knows the answer. Yet from that day on, her fate became bound to the sword.

mindscapes.name: Light & Shadow
mindscapes.description: The max stack count of Bearer increases to 6, and Culmination can stack up to 9 times. While in the Enlightened Mind state, each point of Qingming Sword Force consumed grants 1 stack of Culmination. EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Soaring Light and Ultimate: Cleaving Heavens's DMG ignore 40% of the target's DEF.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
Time flowed on, winters giving way to summers.
Her entire world amounted to this tiny stretch of Yunkui Summit, the changing seasons of the mountain were all she would ever see.
In endless solitude and ever-present fear, "another self" quietly came into being.

"...I am a part of her. From beginning to end, we were never apart."
"If she is the light, then I am the shadow. If she stands as a lofty idol, then I am the mortal who crawls below."
"Unlike her, I have no wish to become some kind of 'hero'..."
"...I just want to survive."

mindscapes.name: Swordswoman
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
A peerless famed sword lies hidden deep in the mountains, its edge fully restrained.
But once unsheathed, its icy light reaches far and wide, even after storms of wind and snow, a single piercing light endures.

"What is someone who wields a blade?"
"Nothing more than... the courage to press forward without hesitation, and the resolve to cut through anything."

mindscapes.name: Together into the Dust
mindscapes.description: Upon entering the battlefield, gains 1,000 Decibels. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s. The Vulnerability bonus provided by Ether Veil: Verdict is increased to a maximum of 200%.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
Hidden beneath a grand vision was a lie, where salvation came only by burning oneself to ash.
Fate showed her no mercy, yet she willingly met her end.

"I understand."
"I will live my whole life alongside 'loss'."
"I willingly accept everything..."
"...This is the person I choose to be."

mindscapes.name: Guiding Glimmer
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"...I suppose, in the end, I'm still that 'lucky' child."
"Miasma won't overwhelm me, disaster won't swallow me."
"Even the Qingming Sword can't drag me into that pitch-black, bottomless abyss..."

"My brother, Shifu, everyone at Suibian Temple... and you."
"...I know you'll all keep waiting for me."
And so, even if the road ahead is filled with thorns, a faint light still guides the way.

mindscapes.name: Lantern Wish
mindscapes.description: Upon entering the battlefield, gains 2 stacks of Lantern Wish. When entering the Enlightened Mind state, gains 1 stack of Lantern Wish, stacking up to 4 times. With 3 stacks of Lantern Wish, EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Return to Dust is replaced with Ultimate: Cleaving Heavens. When this Ultimate: Cleaving Heavens is activated, it consumes 3 stacks of Lantern Wish. The last hit of Enlightened Mind - Return to Dust and Ultimate: Cleaving Heavens deal 1,500% of ATK as additional Physical DMG.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
Once, she stood alone, walking through the dark.
Then she took up her sword and rushed toward disaster. As Qingming left its sheath, a fleeting arc of light split the sky, illuminating that silent, shadowed land.

"...I want to be one light among countless fireflies."
"The sun will rise. No matter how long the night lasts, dawn always comes."
"In the distant past, and in the distant future, there must be countless others who made the same choice as me. We... were never alone."

skins.description: Warm, woolly ears and a small build may invite underestimation, but the Judge of "Value" won't think twice about bringing her branch down on anyone who tries.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Glacial Judgment
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
Launches up to five slashes forward, the first dealing Physical DMG, and the following four Ice DMG.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Final Verdict
descriptions.description:
Hold to activate:
After getting ready, Zhao starts charging up, then launches a forward slash on release, dealing massive Ice DMG.
While charging, Zhao accumulates up to 5s of charge time. When the Finishing Move of Basic Attack: Final Verdict, Chain Attack, or Assist Follow-Up hits, the stored charge time is consumed to deal additional DMG. For every 1 second of charge time, Zhao deals {0}% of Max HP as additional DMG.
When Zhao is in any Ether Veil, if she gets switched out while charging, the charge can continue.
If Frostbite Points are maxed out when the skill activates, all Frostbite Points are consumed to trigger Ether Veil: Wellspring and a Quick Assist. If a squadmate is then switched in via Quick Assist, Zhao automatically follows up with Basic Attack: Final Verdict and begins charging.
During skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
While not the currently controlled character, the character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dodge: Bunny Hop
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.description:
Press during a dodge to activate:
Slashes forward, dealing Physical DMG and Ice DMG.

descriptions.name: Dodge Counter: Swift Blink

Performs a falling slash ahead, dealing Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

When Zhao has maximum Frostbite Points, and is in combat, press to activate:
Launches consecutive attacks forward, followed by a slash, dealing massive Ice DMG.
Upon activating this skill, all Frostbite Points are consumed to activate Ether Veil: Wellspring.
Upon activating this skill, a Quick Assist is triggered. If a squadmate is then switched in via Quick Assist, Zhao automatically follows up with Basic Attack: Final Verdict and begins charging.
Activating this skill is considered as activating a Quick Assist.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.description:

Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of Assist Points when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Launch multiple slashes in front, dealing massive Ice DMG.
Upon activating this skill, if Frostbite Points are maxed out, all Frostbite Points are consumed to activate Ether Veil: Wellspring.
Upon activating this skill while in any Ether Veil, a Quick Assist is triggered. If a squadmate is then switched in via Quick Assist, Zhao automatically follows up with Basic Attack: Final Verdict and begins charging.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Launches a forward slash, dealing Ice DMG.

skills.name: Core Passive: Ideal Colleague
skills.description:
Zhao gains bonus CRIT Rate based on her initial Max HP, gaining 0.8% CRIT Rate for every 1,000 initial Max HP.
Upon entering the battlefield, Zhao gains 100 Frostbite Points. This effect can trigger once every 180s in Investigation Zone mode. The maximum amount of Frostbite Points is 100.
When the currently active character's attacks hit an enemy, Zhao gains 6 Frostbite Points. This can be triggered once every 3s.
When Frostbite Points are maxed out, switching Zhao to the field while in combat will activate her Entry Skill.
When Zhao activates her Entry Skill, all Frostbite Points are consumed to activate Ether Veil: Wellspring.
While Ether Veil: Wellspring is active, all squad members gain 5% Max HP for 40s. Re-activating Ether Veil: Wellspring ends the existing instance before applying a new Ether Veil: Wellspring.
When Zhao activates Ether Veil: Wellspring, all squad members' ATK increase by 100 for 50s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

skills.name: Additional Ability: Crystallization
skills.description:
When another character in your squad is an Attack, Anomaly, or Support character:
When Zhao is within any Ether Veil, the whole squad's DMG increases by 10%. If Zhao's initial Max HP exceeds 15,000, every additional 400 initial Max HP increases this DMG bonus by an additional 1%, up to a total maximum increase of 40%. This bonus reaches its maximum when Zhao's initial Max HP reaches 27,000.

mindscapes.name: Righteous Verdict
mindscapes.description: When Zhao switches out of being the active character, all squad members' DMG ignores 15% of the target's All-Attribute RES for 50s.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"Don't let that cute face fool you! I'll never forget that meeting — right there in front of a few dozen people, she pointed her finger and, with the sweetest expression, delivered the coldest verdict: 'If your company refuses any single item in this rectification list, you will be removed from TOPS. This isn't a threat — it's the objectively correct conclusion.' That image is forever etched in my mind! ...Still, I have to thank Miss Zhao."
—A company manager who revived his business after a brutal restructuring, speaking with a conflicted look as he rubbed his temples.

mindscapes.name: Krampus Senior
mindscapes.description: When Zhao recovers HP, her ATK increases by 20%, and other squad members' ATK increases by 15% for 50s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
mindscapes.flavorDesc: Xiao'Zhao joined Krampus very early on, and even within the elite of the elite, the Krampus Compliance Authority, she's still addressed as "senior." That's how it should be... if only the juniors who came after weren't all the type who value personality over protocol.

mindscapes.name: Frostveil Edge
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc: Xiao'Zhao's weapon, "Frostveil," is an experimental asset supplied through a confidential TOPS research project. Rather than merely projecting Ice-aligned Ether into strikes, the weapon channels Ether into its own structure. Under normal conditions, Frostveil is only half the weight of comparable weapons, but once in combat, its rapidly condensed ice edge gains far greater destructive power. The design might as well have been tailor-made for Xiao'Zhao.

mindscapes.name: Featherlight Footsteps
mindscapes.description: When Zhao activates an Ether Veil, she gains 250 Decibels. The CRIT DMG of her Ultimate, Chain Attack, and Basic Attack: Final Verdict increase by 40%.
mindscapes.flavorDesc: Agile, light, and hard to pin down. Words once used to describe a little rabbit are now being used to describe a terrifying warrior wielding a massive blade, capable of cutting through anything...

mindscapes.name: Fuzzy Listener
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc: If Xiao'Zhao's ears twitch unconsciously and perk up slightly, it means she's heard that which matters to her most. It could be intel, a mission, a deal... or praise.

mindscapes.name: No Value Has Its Own Value
mindscapes.description: The CRIT Rate buff from Core Passive: Ideal Colleague increases to 125% of the original value. The extra DMG gained from charging during Basic Attack: Final Verdict increases to 140% of the original value, and accumulated charge time is no longer consumed when attacking.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
The wall of beliefs she'd built since childhood, molded by so many people, has begun to crack because of one encounter.
Xiao'Zhao now sees value differently: when something carries no listed price, it isn't useless, it's simply too precious for anything to stand as its equivalent.

skins.description: A sweet voice comes from the receiver, and when you lean in to listen, it softens into a gentle whisper, announcing that the verdict has arrived... just kidding, it's just a standard satisfaction survey.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Happy to Be of Service
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
Unleashes up to four attacks, dealing Physical DMG.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Rock, Paper, Scissors
descriptions.description:
After EX Special Attack: Rock or EX Special Attack: Scissors, press to activate:
Performs up to two attacks, dealing Physical DMG.
During skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.

descriptions.name: Dodge: Line Busy
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: Sudden Call
descriptions.description:
Press during a dodge to activate:
Launches a dashing attack at enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.

descriptions.name: Dodge Counter: Number Unavailable
descriptions.description:
Press during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Launches consecutive attacks against enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.
After using this skill, can immediately follow up with the 4th hit of Basic Attack: Happy to Be of Service.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Quick Assist: Forward Call
descriptions.description:
When the active character is launched, press to activate:
Launches consecutive attacks against enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.
After using this skill, can immediately follow up with the 4th hit of Basic Attack: Happy to Be of Service.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Defensive Assist: Decline Call
descriptions.description:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of Assist Points when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Assist Follow-Up: Back-to-Back Calls
descriptions.description:
Press after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Performs a rapid dash followed by a slash attack, dealing Physical DMG.
After using this skill, can immediately follow up with the 4th hit of Basic Attack: Happy to Be of Service.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Get Lost!
descriptions.description:
With Customer Complaint, hold to activate:
Delivers a forward martial salute attack. On activation, it consumes 1 Customer Complaint and deals Physical DMG.
After activation, the previous character's Quick Assist is triggered.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Welcome Gesture
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
Throws dual rings to slash enemies, dealing Physical DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Rock
descriptions.description:
With enough Energy, press to activate:
Launches a fist attack, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Scissors
descriptions.description:
With enough Energy, press to activate:
Launches a scissors attack, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Paper!
descriptions.description:
With enough Energy, press to activate:
Launches a paper attack, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Chain Attack: Welcome Mat
descriptions.description:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Launches consecutive kicks against enemies in front, dealing massive Physical DMG.
After using this skill, can immediately follow up with the 4th hit of Basic Attack: Happy to Be of Service.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Ultimate: Service Stopped for Number Dialed
descriptions.description:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate:
Rushes forward and performs a finger flick attack, dealing massive Physical DMG.
After using this skill, can immediately follow up with the 4th hit of Basic Attack: Happy to Be of Service.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Core Passive: Five-Star Service Hotline
skills.description:
Upon entering the battlefield, Dialyn starts with 60 Positive Reviews. If her initial CRIT Rate surpasses 50%, her Impact increases by 1.4 for each additional 1%, up to a maximum increase of 100.
After using EX Special Attack: Rock, the next EX Special Attack becomes EX Special Attack: Scissors for 8s.
After using EX Special Attack: Scissors, the next EX Special Attack becomes EX Special Attack: Paper! for 8s.
When EX Special Attack: Paper! hits an enemy, it applies the Malicious Complaint effect. While under Malicious Complaint, if the enemy becomes Stunned, the Stun duration is extended by 2s, and Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 15%. Before recovering from Stun, Malicious Complaint can trigger on the same target only once. The Stun duration bonus does not stack with similar effects. When an enemy with Malicious Complaint recovers from being Stunned, the effect ends.
While in combat, Dialyn gains 0.6 Positive Reviews per second. When a heavy attack of EX Special Attack: Rock, EX Special Attack: Scissors, or EX Special Attack: Paper! hits enemies, she gains 7.5 Positive Reviews. Each use of a skill can grant this bonus only once, up to a maximum of 120.
With at least 90 Positive Reviews, when Dialyn triggers the Chain Attack window using Chain Attack: Welcome Mat, EX Special Attack: Get Lost!, or Quick Assist: Forward Call, the next character to switch in will have their Chain Attack upgraded to an Ultimate. When an ally launches an Ultimate this way, Dialyn consumes 60 Positive Reviews.
With at least 90 Positive Reviews, when Dialyn hits an enemy with EX Special Attack: Get Lost! and doesn't trigger a Chain Attack window, she consumes 90 Positive Reviews to forcibly trigger a Chain Attack window. The next character to switch in will have their Chain Attack upgraded to an Ultimate.
Each time Positive Reviews reaches 90 or an Ultimate is activated, Dialyn obtains 1 Customer Complaint. A maximum of 1 Customer Complaint can be held at a time.

skills.name: Additional Ability: External Line
skills.description:
When another character in your squad is an Attack or Rupture character:
Dialyn's EX Special Attack CRIT DMG is increased by 50%.
When an EX Special Attack or Ultimate is activated, all squad members gain the Overwhelmingly Positive effect. While Overwhelmingly Positive is active, DMG dealt is increased by 40% for 15s. When Dialyn uses an EX Special Attack or Ultimate while Overwhelmingly Positive is active, if the remaining duration of Overwhelmingly Positive is less than 35s, its duration is extended by 10s.
When a heavy attack from EX Special Attack: Rock, EX Special Attack: Scissors, or EX Special Attack: Paper! hits, additional DMG is dealt based on the previous squad member's Specialty:
If the squad member is an Attack Agent, EX Special Attack: Rock, EX Special Attack: Scissors, and EX Special Attack: Paper! deal additional DMG equal to 320% of that Attack Agent's ATK.
If the squad member is a Rupture Agent, EX Special Attack: Rock, EX Special Attack: Scissors, and EX Special Attack: Paper! deal additional DMG equal to 400% of that Rupture Agent's Sheer Force.

If the squad member is a Rupture Agent, EX Special Attack: Rock, EX Special Attack: Scissors, and EX Special Attack: Paper! deal additional DMG equal to 400% of that Rupture Agent's Sheer Force.
