mindscapes.name: Boundless Hospitality
mindscapes.description: The amount of Positive Reviews accumulated each second and gained when EX Special Attack: Rock, EX Special Attack: Scissors, or EX Special Attack: Paper! hits an enemy increase by 16%. While the Overwhelmingly Positive effect is active, characters ignore 15% of enemy All-Attribute RES.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
Welcome to the Cross-Department Customer Service Center!
Our motto is simple: always wear a smile, always greet every customer with passion~!
A smile... the one expression I once found hardest to fake. When did it become second nature to me?
"Hello there, darling~ How can I help you? Well~ not that I really can do anything for you!"

mindscapes.name: 24/7 Hotline
mindscapes.description: Enemies affected by Malicious Complaint gain an additional 20% Stun DMG Multiplier when Stunned, and all units deal 15% increased DMG to targets affected by Malicious Complaint.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
TOPS is the biggest corporate alliance in New Eridu, and our work keeps this city alive~!
We're the essential lubricant that keeps this great machine turning, so our service hotline must stay open 24/7, no matter what!
Endless noise and constant chatter? No problem — that's what I know best.
"Please feel free to contact me anytime~! No matter when you do, I'll still be just as annoying~!"

mindscapes.name: Call From the Hollow
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
The Hollows are a vast tomb, where every echo of life falls silent within its pitch-black coffin.
But to me, it's a call I can never refuse, the final page of every diary, a memo of obsession and lingering resentment.
Even if... all that talk of letting go or holding on, they've got nothing to do with my own story.
"It's alright! I've talked with plenty of clients far harder to communicate with than you~!"

mindscapes.name: The Past Never Fades
mindscapes.description: Upon entering combat, Dialyn recovers 20 Energy. This effect can trigger once every 180s in Investigation Zone Mode. While the Overwhelmingly Positive effect is active, Dialyn's ATK increases by 500.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
People always treat me like a kid because I'm small, but my childhood is long since over.
Which day did it end, though? The first time I heard the whispers of the dead? When I was sent into the Hollow as a sacrifice? Or that first night I cried myself to sleep?
With no one to protect me, I had to find my own footing. Unable to forget the past, I pretended to let it go.
"I don't care about your personal issues~ but I am very concerned about how your childhood trauma might affect my complaint rate~!"

mindscapes.name: Lies
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
We lie when others still care about us, and only tell the truth once they've stopped.
Such foolish choices always lead to regret. My job is simply to use yesterday's regrets to make today's a little lighter.
I know people always lie, but at least there are still some who bother to lie to me.
"My suggestion? Mix a bit of flattering nonsense in between your insults — it'll work in your favor~!"

mindscapes.name: Truth
mindscapes.description: When an ally enters the field with an Ultimate through the Core Passive's effect, that ally gains the Aftertone effect. With this effect, landing an attack causes Dialyn to deal an additional instance of Physical DMG equal to 480% of Dialyn's ATK. This DMG is treated as EX Special Attack DMG, and can trigger once every second, up to 12 times. Gaining Aftertone again refreshes its trigger count. Only one ally can have Aftertone at a time.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
A sudden death is like a moment preserved in time, capturing truth in its final, immutable form.
I take these specimens from the hands of the dead, using their death certificates as the foundation for my judgments.
Pure, objective "truth" is the only rule I can depend on, the only thread guiding my way forward... until—
"Proxy, can I lie as well?"

skins.description: He carries a righteous, unshakable aura — every bit the master he is. Don't judge him by his silence; a stone heart makes no sound, and compassion doesn't speak aloud either.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Towering Peaks
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
Launches up to four attacks in front, dealing Fire DMG.
Interrupt Level is increased during this skill.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Majestic Summit
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
Launches up to four attacks in front, dealing Fire DMG.
Anti-Interrupt Level is increased during this skill.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Immolate
descriptions.description:
While not in the Visage of Wrath state and with at least 120 Wrathful Fires, hold to activate:
Deals Fire DMG to nearby enemies, then enters the Visage of Wrath state.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Inflame
descriptions.description:
While not in combat and with more than 50% HP and less than 120 Wrathful Fires, hold to activate:
Banyue consumes HP to recover Wrathful Fires. Upon reaching 120 Wrathful Fires, Banyue immediately enters the Visage of Wrath state.
Upon entering the battlefield, gain one chance to use this skill. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once per 180s.
HP consumption will at most reduce Banyue's HP to 50% of Max HP.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Toppling Mountain
descriptions.description:
When Banyue is in the Visage of Wrath state, hold to consume 120 Wrathful Fires and activate:
Banyue hurls a massive mountain at the enemy, dealing massive Fire DMG.
After using this move, Banyue exits the Visage of Wrath state.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Crushing Peaks
descriptions.description:
While Banyue is in the Visage of Wrath state and after performing two different EX Special Attacks through Basic Attack branches or quick input commands, hold to activate:
Banyue launches his beads forward to imprison enemies, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Banyue automatically follows up with Basic Attack: Toppling Mountain.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dodge: Immovable Mountain
descriptions.description:
While attacking, press without moving the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} to activate:
Banyue enters a defensive stance. If attacked during this time, he parries the enemy's attack and accumulates Daze.
If attacked at the exact moment the skill is activated, a Perfect Block occurs.
Character is invulnerable during a successful parry.

descriptions.name: Dodge: Overcome Peaks
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dodge: Battle Cry
descriptions.description:
Rotate the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} in a half-circle and press to activate:
Dodges backward and taunts enemies.
After any EX Special Attack, follow up with Dodge: Battle Cry and quickly execute the required inputs during Dodge: Battle Cry to then follow up with the corresponding EX Special Attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: Scattering Sands
descriptions.description:
During a dodge, press , or during Dodge: Battle Cry, hold to activate:
Launches beads forward, dealing Fire DMG.
After using this skill, can be followed up with the 2nd hit of Basic Attack: Towering Peaks or the 2nd hit of Basic Attack: Majestic Summit.

descriptions.name: Dodge Counter: Stoneburst
descriptions.description:
After a Perfect Dodge is triggered through Dodge: Overcome Peaks, press , or after a Perfect Dodge is triggered though Dodge: Battle Cry, hold to activate:
Launches a forward attack that deals Fire DMG.
After using this skill, can be chained into the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Towering Peaks or the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Majestic Summit.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Quick Assist: Batholith
descriptions.description:
When the active character is launched, press to activate:
Executes a series of attacks against enemies in front, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Defensive Assist: Iron Bastion
descriptions.description:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Assist Follow-Up: Lofty Ascent
descriptions.description:
Press after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Quickly dash forward and attack, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Assist Follow-Up: Pierce Heavens
descriptions.description:
After successfully parrying an enemy attack with Dodge: Immovable Mountain, press to activate:
Quickly dash forward and attack, dealing Fire DMG
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Earth Shaker
descriptions.description:
With enough Adrenaline, can be activated in one of three ways:
After the 3rd or 4th hit of Basic Attack: Towering Peaks, press to activate:
After an Assist Follow-Up, Dodge Counter, or Quick Assist, hold to activate:
During an EX Special Attack, Basic Attack: Immolate, Chain Attack, Ultimate, Assist Follow-Up, Dodge Counter, or Quick Assist, quickly input in sequence to activate:
Banyue slams the ground repeatedly, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Mountain Tremor
descriptions.description:
With enough Adrenaline, can be activated in one of two ways:
After the 1st or 2nd hit of Basic Attack: Majestic Summit, press to activate:
During an EX Special Attack, Basic Attack: Immolate, Chain Attack, Ultimate, Assist Follow-Up, Dodge Counter, or Quick Assist, quickly input in sequence to activate:
Banyue throws a mountain, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: One's Path
descriptions.description:
With enough Adrenaline, can be activated in one of three ways:
After the 3rd or 4th hit of Basic Attack: Majestic Summit, press to activate:
After an Assist Follow-Up, Dodge Counter, or Quick Assist, hold to activate:
During an EX Special Attack, Basic Attack: Immolate, Chain Attack, Ultimate, Assist Follow-Up, Dodge Counter, or Quick Assist, quickly input in sequence to activate:
Banyue throws out his beads, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Lion's Roar
descriptions.description:
With enough Adrenaline, can be activated in one of two ways:
After the 1st or 2nd hit of Basic Attack: Towering Peaks, press to activate:
During an EX Special Attack, Basic Attack: Immolate, Chain Attack, Ultimate, Assist Follow-Up, Dodge Counter, or Quick Assist, quickly input in sequence to activate:
Banyue sends out a sonic wave forward, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Mountain Tremor - Wrath
descriptions.description:
With enough Adrenaline when using EX Special Attack: Earth Shaker, quickly input in sequence to activate:
Banyue throws out an even larger mountain, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Lion's Roar - Wrath
descriptions.description:
With enough Adrenaline when using EX Special Attack: One's Path, quickly input in sequence to activate:
Banyue releases a powerful sonic wave in front, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Cancel
descriptions.description:
When Banyue activates an EX Special Attack ALT through quick input commands, the currently activating EX Special Attack can be interrupted. Each EX Special Attack has its own Perfect Interrupt window. Interrupting an EX Special Attack after its Perfect Interrupt window will not affect the interrupted EX Special Attack's effect. Interrupting an EX Special Attack during the Perfect Interrupt window is equal to triggering a Perfect Cancel.
While in the Visage of Wrath state and with Mountain's Might, Perfect Cancel is easier to trigger.

descriptions.name: Chain Attack: Blazing Wrath
descriptions.description:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Launches a large area attack in front, dealing massive Fire DMG.
If Banyue has more than 120 Wrathful Fires, he automatically enters the Visage of Wrath state after the attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Ultimate: The World Trembles
descriptions.description:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate:
Launches a large area attack in front, dealing massive Fire DMG.
If Banyue has more than 120 Wrathful Fires, he automatically enters the Visage of Wrath state after the attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Core Passive: One With the Mountains
skills.description:
Banyue gains extra Sheer Force based on his Max HP, with every 1 point of Max HP increasing his Sheer Force by 0.1.
All Fire DMG Banyue deals is Sheer DMG, ignoring enemy DEF and using his Sheer Force stat as the DMG Multiplier.
When Banyue enters the battlefield, he immediately recovers 60 Adrenaline. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
Banyue can recover Wrathful Fires through the following methods:
Recover 0.5 Wrathful Fires for every point of Adrenaline consumed;
Recover 4 Wrathful Fires upon activating Defensive Assist;
Recover 4 Wrathful Fires when parrying an enemy with Dodge: Immovable Mountain, and recover 6 Wrathful Fires instead upon triggering a Perfect Block, up to once every 1s;
Recover 4 Wrathful Fires upon triggering a Perfect Dodge, up to once every 1s.
Banyue can have up to 150 Wrathful Fires. When he possesses at least 120 Wrathful Fires, Banyue can enter the Visage of Wrath state by using Basic Attack: Immolate. While in Visage of Wrath state, Banyue can no longer gain Wrathful Fires. After Banyue uses Basic Attack: Toppling Mountain, he exits the Visage of Wrath state.
When entering the Visage of Wrath state, Banyue gains 4 Mountain's Might. If Banyue has Mountain's Might, launching an EX Special Attack no longer consumes Adrenaline, instead consuming 1 Mountain's Might and restoring 10 Adrenaline. Upon exiting the Visage of Wrath state, remove all Mountain's Might.
When possessing Mountain's Might in Visage of Wrath state, hold to launch four different EX Special Attacks and Basic Attack: Toppling Mountain in a fixed sequence.
When Banyue uses an EX Special Attack or Assist Follow-Up, he increases his Sheer Force by 150, Fire DMG by 18%, and CRIT DMG by 18% for 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

skills.name: Additional Ability: Mountain's Zenith
skills.description:
When another character in your squad is a Support or Stun character:
While in the Visage of Wrath state, when Banyue consumes Mountain's Might to unleash an EX Special Attack through a Basic Attack branch or quick input commands, he gains one stack of Vidyaraja. Each stack of Vidyaraja increases his Fire DMG by 5%, stacking up to 3 times and lasting 8s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

mindscapes.name: Greed Burns Like Fire
mindscapes.description: When Banyue hits an enemy with EX Special Attack: One's Path or EX Special Attack: Earth Shaker, he inflicts the Tremor state. In this state, enemies' Fire RES is reduced by 10%, lasting 30s. When EX Special Attack: Lion's Roar, EX Special Attack: Lion's Roar - Wrath, EX Special Attack: Mountain Tremor, EX Special Attack: Mountain Tremor - Wrath, Basic Attack: Toppling Mountain, and Basic Attack: Crushing Peaks hits an enemy in the Tremor state, the Sheer DMG dealt is increased by 10%. When Basic Attack: Crushing Peaks hits a Stunned enemy, the current Stun duration is extended by 2s. This effect can only trigger once per Stun and does not stack with similar effects.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
Did Banyue Shifu ever have any desires of his own? He runs a martial arts school in Failume Heights, apparently only because a certain grandmaster once suggested he open one.
The school doesn't even have a name, he isn't looking for fame for fortune, and he's never once told his students to shout slogans about passing down his art.
Only Banyue Shifu himself knows that the obsession called repentance burns that iron heart, day and night. A single mistake could send him spiralling.

"Greed is like fire. When kept in check, it lights the way forward, but left unchecked, it burns you instead."

mindscapes.name: Anger Cuts Like a Blade
mindscapes.description: The CRIT DMG bonus from the Core Passive is increased by an additional 15%, and the Fire DMG bonus is increased by an additional 15%. While in the Visage of Wrath state, Banyue restores an additional 5 Adrenaline when consuming Mountain's Might to unleash an EX Special Attack.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
The students at the martial arts school had never seen Banyue Shifu lose his temper, let alone fly into a rage. Even with the dullest or most reckless students, he seemed endlessly patient. After all, how could a mountain ever grow angry? Its deep, immovable calm makes people almost forget the fury it can hold.
But when it stirs with the wrath of the heavens, even the fiercest of beasts will tremble in fear.

"Anger is like a blade — keep it sheathed in daily life, lest it wound those around you."

mindscapes.name: Ignorance Binds Like Chains
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
Banyue Shifu was not just a warrior, but a wise man — or so said both his students and the neighbors who knew him.
After all, he always looked so composed and thoughtful. Though he spoke little, every word that left his mouth sounded like a proverb worth pondering.
Martial arts, he often said, are not only a way to train the body but also the heart. And as he would always add, he himself was still just a student.

"I, Banyue, have been slow and foolish, once straying from the right path. But to clear the way for you on this journey... these fists are still yours to command."

mindscapes.name: Purge Unit - Type Zero
mindscapes.description: EX Special Attack: Lion's Roar - Wrath, EX Special Attack: Mountain Tremor - Wrath, Basic Attack: Toppling Mountain, and Basic Attack: Crushing Peaks DMG increase by 30%.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
Fate may be ordained by the heavens or shaped by human hands. Yet for some, destiny and guilt were never granted the mercy of free will.
Before ever having a name, the combat construct known as "Type Zero" was, in the truest sense, nothing more than a killing machine.
And when did a "heart" form? Was it the day she erased the chains of his code, or the moment he found the courage to carry it all and keep moving forward?

"Repentance is too easy. Rather than fleeing from past sins, shoulder the mountain of your past... and throw a punch."

mindscapes.name: Student
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
Did you hear? There's a martial arts school up in the mountain taught by some big construct.
The students there are no joke; they can even hold their own against Ethereals.
Their iron-bodied Shifu often heads into the Hollows to help with rescues, too. Must be quite the martial arts master, huh?

"I'm still just a clumsy student myself... Though you all call me 'Shifu,' it's you who have taught me what it means to be a person."

mindscapes.name: Descended Vidyaraja
mindscapes.description: At any time, when Banyue uses an EX Special Attack, he also gains Vidyaraja. The Fire DMG bonus from Vidyaraja is increased by an additional 8%, and its duration is extended to 30s. When activating Basic Attack: Crushing Peaks, Banyue deals Fire DMG equal to 600% of his Sheer Force to nearby enemies. Using Dodge: Battle Cry immediately after an EX Special Attack also grants Vidyaraja.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"Dying's the easy way out, isn't it, big guy? You've still got a long path of redemption ahead of you!"
"This... is my final verdict!"
Her frame was delicate, yet her words landed with a weight that seemed to cut through a mountain of burden and doubt.

"I still question whether I have the wisdom and courage to judge... but that's no excuse to stop moving forward."

skins.description: Her cloak is the curtain of night, and beneath her hood rests the world's quiet whispers. She sings for the dusk and speaks in dreams, gathering the thoughts sleepers leave behind and weaving them into halos and riddles across the stars.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Orbital Combo
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
Perform up to five forward strikes, dealing Ether DMG.
The fifth attack is a Whim, conjuring an Ethereal figure that inflicts Ether DMG on enemies in a circular area ahead.
When in combat and not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 40 Dream Points upon using this Whim.

descriptions.name: Dodge: Fading Silhouette
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: Refraction
descriptions.description:
Press during a dodge to activate:
Deliver a quick strike forward, dealing Ether DMG.

descriptions.name: Dodge Counter: Stardust Echo
descriptions.description:
Press during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
This Dodge Counter is a Whim. When activated, summons an Ethereal figure that delivers a downward attack in a circular area ahead, dealing Ether DMG.
If not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 20 Dream Points upon using this Whim. This effect can trigger once every 5s.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Quick Assist: Crushing Mist
descriptions.description:
When the active character is launched, press to activate:
This Quick Assist is a Whim. When activated, it summons an Ethereal figure that delivers a downward attack in a circular area ahead, dealing Ether DMG.
If not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 20 Dream Points upon using this Whim. This effect can trigger once every 5s.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Defensive Assist: Voice of Illusory Dreams
descriptions.description:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Assist Follow-Up: Harmony of Painted Dreams
descriptions.description:
Press after a Defensive Assist to activate:
This Assist Follow-Up is a Harmony. When activated, it summons an Ethereal figure that delivers a downward attack in a circular area ahead, dealing Ether DMG.
If not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 40 Dream Points upon using this Harmony.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Symphony of the Reaper - Storm
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
This Special Attack is a Whim. When activated, it recreates an Ethereal figure that slashes forward in a line, dealing Ether DMG.
When in combat and not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 20 Dream Points upon using this Whim. This effect can trigger once every 5s.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Symphony of the Reaper - Daybreak
descriptions.description:
With enough Energy, press to activate:
This EX Special Attack is a Harmony. When activated, it summons an Ethereal figure that delivers a powerful forward slash in a line, dealing Ether DMG.
When Lucia uses any Harmony, all squad members gain the Darkbreaker state. While in Darkbreaker state, Sheer Force increases by 12. Every 200 points of Lucia's initial Max HP grants an additional {0} Sheer Force. The Darkbreaker state can increase Sheer Force by up to a maximum of {1}, lasting 20s and repeated triggers reset the duration. When Lucia's initial Max HP reaches 24,000, the above bonus effect reaches its maximum value.
When any Harmony deals DMG, Lucia increases the final attack's DMG by an additional {2}% of her Max HP.
If she activates this EX Special Attack while in the Dream state and under the effect of Ether Veil: Wellspring, Ether Veil: Wellspring duration is extended by 16s.
After activating her EX Special Attack, Lucia can immediately follow up with the 5th hit of her Basic Attack.
If not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 60 Dream Points upon using this Harmony.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Chain Attack: Stage of Brilliance
descriptions.description:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
This Chain Attack is a Harmony. When activated, it summons an Ethereal figure that pulls in enemies in a circular area ahead and deals Ether DMG.
If not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 40 Dream Points upon using this Harmony.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Ultimate: Charge, Great Armor!
descriptions.description:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate:
This Ultimate is a Harmony. When activated, Lucia summons an Ethereal figure and rides it forward in a charge. Holding a directional button allows her to steer and extend the charge, up to 3s. During the charge, Anti-Interrupt Level is increased, DMG taken is reduced by 40%, and when Lucia takes fatal DMG, she remains in battle with HP not dropping below 1.
When the charge ends, Lucia unleashes a powerful strike in a large area around her, dealing Ether DMG. A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy, and after the skill is used, it leaves behind a Starlight Convergence. Starlight Convergence lasts 8s. While inside Starlight Convergence, the currently active character gains HP regeneration equal to {0}% of Lucia's Max HP per second. This effect ends 4s after leaving the Starlight Convergence or immediately when switching out.
After activation, if Lucia is in the Dream state and Ether Veil: Wellspring is active, Ether Veil: Wellspring duration is extended by 32s.
If not in the Dream state, Lucia gains 100 Dream Points upon using this Harmony. If she is in the Dream state when activating this Harmony, she will gain 100 Dream Points and re-enter Dream state the next time she exits it. This effect cannot be stacked.
Character is invulnerable while performing the powerful strike.

skills.name: Core Passive: Lost Nocturne
skills.description:
When entering the battlefield, Lucia immediately gains 60 Dream Points. If her Dream Points reaches 100 upon activating a Whim or Harmony, she enters the Dream state.
When entering the Dream state, it triggers a Quick Assist and simultaneously activates Ether Veil: Wellspring. While Ether Veil: Wellspring is active, all squad members' Max HP increase by 5%, lasting 40s. Repeated triggers extend the duration, up to a max of 300s.
While Lucia is in the Dream state, using any Whim consumes 25 Dream Points and upgrades it to Harmony. Whenever another active character's attack hits an enemy, Lucia consumes 25 Dream Points to unleash an Aftershock. This Aftershock is a Harmony. After Lucia triggers a skill upgrade or Aftershock, Aftershock cannot be triggered for 8s.
When Lucia triggers a skill upgrade or an Aftershock, all squad members gain the Dreamer's Nursery Rhyme state. While in Dreamer's Nursery Rhyme state, DMG dealt increases by 10% for 12s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
If Lucia runs out of Dream Points or she leaves the Ether Veil, she exits the Dream state.

skills.description:

mindscapes.name: Secret Friend
mindscapes.description: When Dreamer's Nursery Rhyme deals additional DMG, ignore 18% of enemy All-Attribute RES and have 5% increased Decibel Generation Rate. Each time Lucia performs a skill upgrade, she gains 1 stack of Echo, stacking up to 4 times. When Dreamer's Nursery Rhyme ends, if Lucia has any Echo stacks, 1 stack is consumed to reapply Dreamer's Nursery Rhyme to all squad members.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
As a child, Lucia's grandmother took her by the hand and led her into the Hollows.
From that moment on, she roamed its darkened trails and hunted in its boundless depths. With her brush, she painted the Ethereals she encountered, and the glow of Ether became the brilliance that lit her childhood.
"When I was little, I had three friends: the mighty black shield, the teleporting Thana, and the super-powerful great armor!"
"Then one day, they were gone..."
"But it's okay! I drew them in my notebook. Now, with just a wave of my staff, I can summon them all back!"

mindscapes.name: Great Magician
mindscapes.description: While Lucia is inside Ether Veil: Wellspring, Harmony deals 15% more DMG. Agents in the Darkbreaker state gain an additional 15% Sheer DMG increase while in Ether Veil: Wellspring.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
Lately, a tale has been spreading through New Eridu about the Night Emissary.
"Every night at midnight, the Night Emissary shows up on the streets to tell us all kinds of stories!"
"She's also an amazing magician! Just by chanting a spell, there's a 'Woosh!' and she summons a whole swarm of Ethereals to fight for us!"
"Last time we got lost in a Hollow, the Night Emissary used that very trick to save us!"
—As told by Avocaboo, Devilboo and Boollseye.

mindscapes.name: The Best Partner
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
—Knock, knock knock.
With the steady rhythm of knocks, a kebab was passed through the window.
"Proxy, take it! Hot off the fire — roast skewers with lemon popping candy, paired as perfectly as a Dullahan's sword and shield!"
"Once you finish eating... let's head out and play!"
"I have a feeling... tonight we'll find some amazing inspiration for an urban legend, the kind that can make the entire forum explode!"

mindscapes.name: Late-Night Hours
mindscapes.description: When Ether Veil is activated or extended on the field, Lucia grants all squad members 100 Decibels. This effect can trigger once every 15s.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
A Scholar of Urban Legends must have keen curiosity, plenty of drive, and the guts to set off without hesitation. Lucia is no exception.
That's why, during her early days in New Eridu, she became a regular at Public Security.
"How many times do I have to tell you? Chasing after ghost stories doesn't give you the right to wander into construction zones!"
"Don't sleep on the streets, don't run around in the middle of the night, and don't go diving into Hollows in front of everyone... These are all part of the 'Rules for Life in New Eridu,' and you need to take them seriously!"
"If you really can't sleep, then... uh, why not go explore Thymefield manor, and tell Alice a few ghost stories while you're there?"

mindscapes.name: Dream Watcher
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
Night falls dark as ink, the stars shining bright and brilliant.
She journeys from afar, carrying stories, ballads, and unfinished verses.
She plucks a flower, dew gathered upon its petals, and sets it on the windowsill.
She watches over your dreams, keeping them warm and safe.

"Good morning... Huh? When did you get here, Lucia?"
"I'm not sure, but it hasn't been too long... time just seems to fly when I'm around you, Proxy."

mindscapes.name: The Never-Ending Journey
mindscapes.description: When Lucia is inside any Ether Veil, her ATK increases by 2% of her initial Max HP, and Harmony always triggers a CRIT with Harmony CRIT DMG increased by 30%.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
Lucia's life is an endless journey. She runs beneath the moonlight, searching, crossing street after street, city after city.
Stories intertwine like threads, spinning endless dreams, while gentle song flows beneath the glow of the night lanterns.
Her search never stops, and under the stars, the journey goes on without end.

Only when the night fades and the sun rises does the girl step out of the Hollows, stretching lazily.
"Yaaawn... I'm so tired... but everyone says it's best not to sleep inside a Hollow..."
"Maybe I should just crash on the floor at the video store instead!"

skins.name: Loyal Wild Soul
skins.description:
The standard attire of the unofficial mediator in Sailume Bay, enough to intimidate petty thugs.
Still, it sometimes draws wandering eyes.

skins.name: White Heart Silhouette
skins.description:
A young Manato made a solitary vow to himself — and from his deep reverie, a lone pale shadow was born.
Mimicking his attire enhances Manato's already exceedingly intimidating presence.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Blazing Wind Slash
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
Perform up to three forward slashes, dealing Physical DMG.
During each slash, pressing triggers Scorchwind, causing the attack to deal increased Fire DMG.

descriptions.name: Dodge: Radiant Blade
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: Radiant Blade - Zanshin
descriptions.description:
Press during a dodge to activate:
Perform a shoulder slam forward, dealing Physical DMG.

descriptions.name: Dodge Counter: Radiant Blade - Battle Sweep
descriptions.description:
Press during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Perform a slash followed by a punch at enemies ahead, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Quick Assist: Lone Shadow - Regroup
descriptions.description:
When the active character is launched, press to activate:
Slashes and punches enemies in front, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Defensive Assist: Lone Shadow - Mountain Stand
descriptions.description:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, inflicting massive Daze and dealing Fire DMG.
Gain 75 Blazing Heart upon activating this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Assist Follow-Up: Lone Shadow - Breaking Fang
descriptions.description:
Press after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Unleash multiple slashes at enemies ahead, dealing Fire DMG.
Repeated presses allow up to 7 extra consecutive slashes.
While chaining slashes, if Manato's HP is above 30%, 2% of Max HP is consumed.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Return to Ashes
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
Slash forward at enemies, dealing Fire DMG.
If hit by an enemy during the skill, restore 20% of missing HP when unleashing the slash. The healing effects of Special Attack: Return to Ashes and Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice have a shared cooldown and can trigger once every 20s.
If hit by an enemy during the skill, the slash is enhanced.
DMG taken is reduced by 40% while using this skill.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice
descriptions.description:
Hold to activate:
Enter a charging state, consuming up to 10% of Max HP and gaining 100 Blazing Heart. HP consumption will at most reduce Manato's HP to 30% of Max HP.
Release the button to activate Special Attack: Return to Ashes. If struck during the skill, the slash heals 20% of missing HP. The healing effects of Special Attack: Return to Ashes and Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice have a shared cooldown and can trigger once every 20s.
If hit by an enemy during the skill or if charging reaches a certain duration, the slash is enhanced.
DMG taken is reduced by 40% while using this skill.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Fall
descriptions.description:
While in the Molten Edge state and with sufficient Adrenaline, press to activate:
Jump up and unleash a falling slash on enemies in front, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Upon activating the skill, restore 33% of Max HP.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Chain Attack: Blazing Eruption
descriptions.description:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Hurls his sword forward, then charges the enemy to trigger an explosion, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Ultimate: Musou Aratama
descriptions.description:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate:
Jump into the air and deliver a falling slash at enemies in front, followed by an explosion, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Core Passive: Mighty Molten Edge
skills.description:
Manato gains extra Sheer Force based on his Max HP, with every 1 point of Max HP increasing Sheer Force by 0.1.
All Fire DMG Manato deals is Sheer DMG, ignoring enemy DEF and using his Sheer Force stat as the DMG Multiplier.
When Manato uses Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice or a Defensive Assist, he accumulates Blazing Heart, up to a maximum of 100 points. At 75 Blazing Heart, Manato enters the Molten Edge state. While in the Molten Edge state, Manato consumes 3.3 Blazing Heart per second. When Blazing Heart is fully depleted, he exits Molten Edge.
While in the Molten Edge state, Manato's Basic Attacks are enhanced, and he can use EX Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Fall.
When consuming HP during Basic Attack: Blazing Wind - Misty Slash or during the consecutive slashes from an Assist Follow-Up, that attack's CRIT DMG increases by 25%, and the Adrenaline Generation Rate increases by 100%.
While in the Molten Edge state, Manato's CRIT Rate increases by 10%, and his Fire DMG increases by 10%.

skills.name: Additional Ability: Rekindled Heart
skills.description:
When another character in your squad is a Support or Stun character:
When Manato uses his Ultimate, he gains 8 stacks of Remnant Flame, and when using a Chain Attack, he gains 4 stacks of Remnant Flame, lasting 60s, stacking up to 20 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration. While launching Basic Attack: Blazing Wind - Misty Slash or during the consecutive slashes of an Assist Follow-Up, if his HP is below 100% of Max HP, one stack of Remnant Flame is consumed to restore 2% of his Max HP.

mindscapes.name: Drifter's Rules of Survival
mindscapes.description: Whenever Manato loses HP, the amount of HP lost is tallied. Each 1% of his Max HP tallied increases the Fire DMG of Assist Follow-Ups and Basic Attacks by 0.4%, up to a max of 20%.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
Unfortunate children are all alike.
The once-kind voices, the warm lights, the joyful promises... all vanished without a farewell. Being formless, even the sharpest fangs could not hold them, nor the sharpest claws grasp them.
"I can eat just about anything, and I'm not too afraid of the cold — if there's a 'secret to surviving,' maybe it's just that."

mindscapes.name: Day & Night, Kitchen & Love
mindscapes.description: While in the Molten Edge state, Manato ignores 8% of a target's Fire RES. After being hit by an enemy while using Special Attack: Return to Ashes or Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice, press to trigger an Assist Follow-Up.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
Perhaps this is what a peaceful family is — Manato, A-Cing, and A-Yuet all think of themselves as the fortunate "child picked up and brought home."
If there's anything left worth arguing about, it's probably just "who should eat the last bit of vegetables."
"It doesn't taste good? I'll ask at Yum Cha Sin if maybe I made a mistake somewhere..."
"...Trade secret?! But last time... I just stood there and the chef told me everything."

mindscapes.name: Enter the Realm of Urban Legends
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
Getting established on a forum starts with a memorable nickname — everyone thinks they're bad at it, but for a dog Thiren who sometimes has to stay back for make-up exams in literature, it's especially tough.
"...You already know it, don't you? It's, uh... ahem, SailumeSadLoneGhost"
"—You heard me!"
"Damn it. One of these days, I'm changing it to 'Mention My Old Name Again and I'll See You in the Hollow.'"

mindscapes.name: Childhood Oath
mindscapes.description: Max HP increases by 8%. During Special Attack: Return to Ashes and Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice, when Manato takes fatal DMG, he remains in battle, with his HP not dropping below 1. This effect can trigger once every 10s.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
Maybe every teenager imagines themselves as a lone wolf with cold eyes... but Manato had an edge in that regard.
If not for the drowned ideals, he could have gone on pretending nothing had ever happened, just like everyone else.
"Like I said, that was just how I thought when I was eight—"
"So this is what a 'friend' is... You didn't treat me like I was fragile, but sometimes you don't treat me like a person either."

mindscapes.name: Lone Shadow Returns to the Pack
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
In truth, despite the barrier his appearance put up, Manato was popular with everyone.
Some made friends with him, some looked to him for protection, and some... tried to rope him into advertising.
"Sorry, I'm probably not the right choice to promote your shop."
"As for 'bench pressing,' I've never done it — unless you're referring to... being pinned by Ethereals and pushing up my greatsword to keep their claws off me?"

mindscapes.name: Beyond Dreams of the Past
mindscapes.description: When Special Attack: Return to Ashes hits a Stunned enemy, Manato gains 75 Blazing Heart and 4 stacks of Remnant Flame, and pressing will launch an Assist Follow-Up. This Remnant Flame effect can trigger once every 20s. When his Assist Follow-Up hits an enemy, Manato's Fire DMG increases by 3% for 8s, stacking up to 5 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
Manato set aside the dream of lone courage and embraced the friends he held dear.
Of course, these friends could still cause him trouble, like at Waifei Peninsula's specialty soup shop.
"When I said I'd cover the rear, I didn't mean while drinking coconut chicken soup."
"Then how come I'm the one on the front lines when it's scorpion soup?"
...But he charged ahead anyway.

skins.description: Past recollections and novel dreams spill over, inviting her to drown in them as they entwine on paper. With a blank page before her, she pens the opening line at the crossroads of reality and illusion.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Crushing Strike
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
Unleashes up to 3 strikes, dealing Ice DMG.
On the 3rd hit, Yidhari recovers 10% HP.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Frostbite Embrace
descriptions.description:
Hold to activate:
Yidhari begins charging, continuously consuming HP to reach up to three levels of charge. When is released, Yidhari unleashes a powerful charged hammer attack in front based on the current charge level, dealing massive Ice DMG.
The higher Yidhari's HP, the faster charging consumes it. HP consumption will at most reduce Yidhari's HP to 25% of Max HP.
At 2 charge levels, after using the skill, press to immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Crushing Strike. The DMG of a Basic Attack: Crushing Strike triggered this way increases based on the current charge level, up to 30%.
At 3 charge levels, Yidhari gains increased Anti-Interrupt level during the charged skill. Press to chain early into the finishing smash.

descriptions.name: Frost's Crushing Weight
descriptions.description:
While charging or spinning during Basic Attack: Frostbite Embrace, if hit by an enemy, Yidhari can block with her tentacles, reducing the DMG taken by 25%.
If charging or not yet at full charge, Yidhari counterattacks with her tentacles, returning to the charging stance and instantly gaining 1 charge level, while also dealing Ice DMG to enemies ahead.
While Frost's Crushing Weight is active, pressing makes Yidhari immediately unleash the finishing slam of Basic Attack: Frostbite Embrace based on her current charge level.
While Frost's Crushing Weight is active, pressing or makes Yidhari unleash a Special Attack: Surging Cold, Crushing Pursuit that is guaranteed to trigger Surging Cold.

descriptions.name: Dodge: Dreamshift
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: Frostbloom Impact
descriptions.description:
Press during a dodge to activate:
Strike forward, dealing Ice DMG.

descriptions.name: Dodge Counter: Icehaul Reverb
descriptions.description:
Press during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Strikes enemies in front, dealing Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Quick Assist: Frostshock Reinforcement
descriptions.description:
When the active character is launched, press to activate:
Strikes enemies in front, dealing Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Defensive Assist: Flashquake Rejection
descriptions.description:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Assist Follow-Up: Glacial Onslaught
descriptions.description:
Press after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Execute an ice shard hammer attack against enemies in front, dealing Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Cease Thoughts
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
Launches enemies in front into the air, dealing Ice DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Frost Coil
descriptions.description:
With enough Adrenaline, press to activate:
Perform two consecutive upward strikes, then release an icy mist, dealing massive Ice DMG.
If EX Special Attack: Frost Coil hits an enemy, Yidhari recovers HP at the end of the skill equal to 33% of her missing HP.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Surging Cold, Crushing Pursuit
descriptions.description:
Press or while charging or spinning during Basic Attack: Frostbite Embrace, or press while holding to activate:
Launches enemies in front into the air, dealing Ice DMG.
When the skill's attack collides with an enemy's attack, it triggers Surging Cold.
If the skill hits a Stunned enemy, and with sufficient Adrenaline, it triggers Crushing Pursuit.
Triggering Surging Cold or Crushing Pursuit instantly raises the charge level to maximum.
During this skill, press and Yidhari will immediately unleash the finishing slam of Basic Attack: Frostbite Embrace based on the current charge level.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Glacial Crush
descriptions.description:
When triggering Surging Cold or Crushing Pursuit, and with enough Adrenaline, press or to activate:
Dash forward with an upward attack, then leap into the air before delivering a powerful downward smash, dealing massive Ice DMG.
If EX Special Attack: Glacial Crush hits an enemy, Yidhari heals at the end of the skill for 33% of her missing HP.
If the skill is used after Surging Cold, it grants an additional 15 Adrenaline. This effect can trigger once every 1s.
After using this skill, press to immediately unleash the finishing slam of Basic Attack: Frostbite Embrace based on the current charge level.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

stats.name: EX Special Attack: Glacial Crush DMG Multiplier
Additional Ability Icy Tentacle DMG Multiplier
EX Special Attack: Glacial Crush Daze Multiplier

descriptions.name: Chain Attack: Frostbound Oath
descriptions.description:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleash a powerful strike against enemies in a small area ahead, dealing massive Ice DMG.
If inside Ether Veil: Wellspring, tentacles join in the assault, further enhancing the skill's power.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Ether Veil: Wellspring
descriptions.description:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, the final hit of Basic Attack: Frostbite Embrace, EX Special Attack: Frost Coil, EX Special Attack: Glacial Crush, and Chain Attack: Frostbound Oath will consume 3,000 Decibels to activate an Ether Veil: Wellspring. While Ether Veil: Wellspring is active, all squad members' Max HP increase by 5% for 30s. Repeated triggers extend the duration, up to a maximum of 300s.
While Yidhari is within Ether Veil: Wellspring, the charge speed of Basic Attack: Frostbite Embrace increases, and HP is consumed faster during charging.

descriptions.name: Ultimate: Final Act - Crossing the River of Regret
descriptions.description:
After Yidhari expends Decibels to activate Ether Veil: Wellspring, press within 30s to activate:
Deliver a powerful strike to enemies in a large area ahead, dealing massive Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Each time Yidhari expends Decibels to activate an Ether Veil: Wellspring, she can use Ultimate: Final Act - Crossing the River of Regret once.

stats.name: DMG Multiplier in Ether Veil: Wellspring
Daze Multiplier in Ether Veil: Wellspring

mindscapes.name: The Past Lost Beneath the Abyss
mindscapes.description: The Adrenaline cost to activate Yidhari's EX Special Attack is reduced by 10. After using EX Special Attack: Frost Coil or EX Special Attack: Glacial Crush, keeping hold of the Basic Attack or Special Attack button consumes 35 Adrenaline to forgo healing and immediately chain into another EX Special Attack: Glacial Crush. The HP restored by this EX Special Attack: Glacial Crush is increased by 100% of the original value. Yidhari's Basic Attacks and EX Special Attacks ignore 20% of targets' Ice RES.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
She plunged into an unfathomable abyss.
—What is this place, and where will it carry her?
The moment doubt arose, a voice whispered from the darkness:
"This is the realm of the unknown, opening the path to all that is known."
Endless shadows tumbled down with her.
—Who are they, and why do their shadows fall here?
As the question rose in her thoughts, the voice replied once more:
"They are those cut off from fate. What falls here are the remnants of their past."
And so, the little girl hugged herself in solitude, carried downward by countless bygone memories.
Her eyes widened in bewilderment, seeing only cold, stillness, and loneliness blooming at the bottom of the abyss.

mindscapes.name: Who Lingers Here, Lost in Thought?
mindscapes.description: Yidhari's CRIT DMG increases by 40%. Triggering Surging Cold or Crushing Pursuit grants Adrenaline regen of 0.5/s for up to 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
In the darkness lay the girl's slumbering thoughts.
They were not innocent daydreams, nor carefree flights of fancy.
Her mind was fixed on the memories she had witnessed.
"What must I do? What must I bear?"
"Good thing it's me, and not someone else."
"I know how to deal with being alone... I think."
As she sifted through those pasts, the girl calmly accepted this heavy gift.

mindscapes.name: A Story Without an Audience
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
So this is what humanity is — such a complex existence.
A lifetime can hold so much joy, and just as much sorrow.
Yet now, all of it has fallen into this void, to be swallowed, erased, and buried.
No one will ever care again for those joyful laughs, or those grief-stricken cries.
Still... every one of those untold stories has been etched into this abyss of the soul.

mindscapes.name: Blooming in Silence
mindscapes.description: Yidhari gains 10% more Decibels when losing HP for Core Passive: Dreamscape Collection. While in Ether Veil: Wellspring, Yidhari's Max HP is further increased by 5%.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
The flower trembled as it bloomed in the dark, white and translucent, as though it reflected the lone light of the abyss's depths.
—It was, in truth, a soul, fragile yet unyielding.
Amid the countless falling shadows, amid the flood of cascading memories... she remained untouched, still blooming with her own strength.
But in the end... will she too fade away, drifting with nothing to hold on to?

mindscapes.name: This Solace Is Real
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"Such beautiful eyes... am I still inside a dream?"
It was their first meeting, and her first brush with something real.
Amid the emptiness and the grotesque, in the barren abyss that threatened to devour everything, she caught sight of those eyes.
They were like a hint of green breaking through the burning desert, like a clear spring rising from a parched riverbed.
"I think I've found it... the hope of someone who will willingly respond to me."

mindscapes.name: At Last, a Peaceful Dream
mindscapes.description: After Yidhari spends Decibels to activate or extend Ether Veil: Wellspring, she gains Erudition for 30s. While Erudition is active, her Sheer DMG increases by 25%. Also, upon taking fatal DMG for the first time, her HP is reduced to at most 1, and for the next 5s, she cannot be defeated and will restore 25% HP over time.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
Immersed in the tide of memories, she had never found even fleeting rest.
Her only refuge was solitude, escaping the bustle of the world, losing herself in strange tales, seeking quiet beneath veils of misty rain or within the embrace of warm waters.
But now, she can walk calmly among the crowds, no longer troubled by noise or the burning sun, for "illusion" no longer binds her spirit, and "reality" has become the anchor of her soul.

profile.details:
Yixuan is the 13th High Preceptor of Yunkui Summit and a Void Hunter-level investigator, officially recognized by Mayor Mayflower.

She was once an orphan, wandering the world with her sister from a young age. Later, the then-High Preceptor of Yunkui Summit took them in, and they became disciples, learning the craft of Yunkui Summit. During this time, Yixuan demonstrated exceptional talent. No matter the technique, she would quickly master it, not only understanding it thoroughly but also creating her own unique techniques. The Qingming Bird was one of the special techniques she and her sister developed together, which helped her eliminate enemies and banish evil spirits in various difficult and dangerous situations. After becoming the sect's High Preceptor, she accepted an invitation from Mayor Mayflower and joined the Hollow Investigative Association as a partnered special investigator.

After becoming High Preceptor, Yixuan took in many talented disciples to continue Yunkui Summit's lineage. However, her approach is rather casual, and often, even when teaching by example, her disciples can only guess her intentions... Yet, Yixuan isn't troubled by this, as she believes there's no standard answer to the so-called "right path." What matters to her is that her disciples find their own "right path." Of course, if they can understand and learn on their own, that's even better. As their Shifu, she simply lets things unfold naturally.
profile.details2:
When Yixuan was young, she loved eating char siu buns with her sister. but after the fall of the old capital, she lost all interest in them overnight and hasn't eaten them much since.

The disciples of Yunkui Summit are unaware of this, and just think their master is a bit picky.

Naturally, it's best to keep this a secret. Some memories and attachments should just be left to fade away with time.

skins.name: Summit of Clouds
skins.description: As the Master of Yunkui Summit, one's fashion and accessories need only be what feels natural. Stay true to one's self.

skins.name: Trails of Ink
skins.description: A custom attire in shades of ink. Like an elusive shadow, gone in a flash.

descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
Perform up to five attacks forward, dealing Auric Ink DMG.
This skill's Anti-Interrupt Level increases during the 3rd and 4th hit.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Ink‐Veil Cloud Coalescence
descriptions.description:
Hold to activate:
Deploy a Grand Tai Chi Formation, dealing Auric Ink DMG.
When the skill ends, automatically launch the 5th hit of Basic Attack: Cirrus Strike.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill, and DMG received is reduced by 40%.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Auric Array
descriptions.description:
While possessing an Auric Ink Point: tap during Dodge: Nimbus Step, or hold to activate:
Deploy an array, continuously dealing Auric Ink DMG.
When the skill ends, it automatically triggers Basic Attack: Qingming Eruption.
While channeling, continuously recover Adrenaline, recovering 7/s, for up to 3s.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill, and enters the Vital View state.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Qingming Eruption
descriptions.description:
Automatically activates when Basic Attack: Auric Array reaches the max duration:
Spreads her wings to launch an explosive attack, dealing massive Auric Ink DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

A quick dash dodge.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: Skybreaker
descriptions.description:
Press during a dodge to activate:
Launch a forward rush attack, dealing Auric Ink DMG.

descriptions.description:
When dragging the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick}, hold to activate:
Enter a high‐speed Light as Air state. While in the Light as Air state in Investigation Zone Mode, automatically collect from all resource pickup points within range.
While in the Light as Air state, use the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} to steer. Release the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} to stop.

descriptions.description:
When the active character is launched, press to activate:
Launch a series of attacks on enemies ahead, dealing Auric Ink DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Defensive Assist: Clear Sky Surge
descriptions.description:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Assist Follow-Up: Celestial Cloud Blitz
descriptions.description:
Press after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Quickly dash forward and attack, dealing Auric Ink DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Shadow-Ignition
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
Swiftly retreat, then attack forward, dealing Auric Ink DMG.
While retreating, a Perfect Dodge can be triggered, but cannot be followed up with a Dodge Counter.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Ink Manifestation
descriptions.description:
With enough Adrenaline, press or hold to activate:
Charge continuously, and release to launch an upward wing attack, dealing massive Auric Ink DMG.
While charging, incoming attacks are automatically blocked and will activate the upward wing attack.
If hit at the exact moment charging begins, it triggers a Perfect Block effect, negating the DMG and increasing the skill's Interrupt Level to match a Heavy Defensive Assist, and recovering 10 Adrenaline.
When an upward wing strike hits an enemy with a red flash or yellow flash, a Perfect Block can be triggered, negating the hit and increasing the skill's Interrupt Level to match a Defensive Assist and recovering 10 Adrenaline.
The Perfect Block effect can occur at most once every 0.5s.
If charged until flashing or when triggering the Perfect Block effect, the upward wing attack can be followed by an additional Talisman Attack.
After the skill, press to launch EX Special Attack: Celestial Cloud Blitz - Break.
After EX Special Attack: Celestial Cloud Blitz - Break, and with enough Adrenaline, press to consume another 20 Adrenaline to launch EX Special Attack: Qingming Eruption - Break.
After using EX Special Attack: Qingming Eruption - Break and with enough Auric Ink Points, hold to quickly follow up with Basic Attack: Auric Array.
Character is invulnerable during the upward wing attack, and Anti-Interrupt Level is increased while charging.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Cloud-Shaper
descriptions.description:
With enough Adrenaline, hold to activate:
Continuously charge up, channeling energy around enemies to deal DMG over time, up to a max of 2s, dealing massive Auric Ink DMG.
Once fully charged or if interrupted, automatically trigger EX Special Attack: Ashen Ink Becomes Shadows.
At the moment the skill is activated, a Perfect Dodge can be triggered. After the Perfect Dodge, enter the Vital View state.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Ashen Ink Becomes Shadows
descriptions.description:
Triggers automatically during EX Special Attack: Cloud-Shaper:
When the energy orb appears and contracts, it deals Auric Ink DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Upon activating this skill, Yixuan evenly redistributes the squad's HP.
After using this skill and with enough Auric Ink Points, hold to quickly follow up with Basic Attack: Auric Array.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Consumes 120 Technique Points to spread her wings, then guide countless talismans to attack, dealing massive Auric Ink DMG.
With both enough Technique Points and Decibels, this skill triggers with priority.
After using this skill and with enough Auric Ink Points, hold to quickly follow up with Basic Attack: Auric Array.
Upon activating this skill, Yixuan evenly redistributes the squad's HP.

mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"Fate is ever-changing and the path ahead uncertain. Only a pure, peaceful spirit holds firm. Even through the tides of time, I harbor no regrets."
"The mystic arts take a thousand forms, yet its core stays the same; the road may fork and falter, but the spirit stays steadfast."
"No matter the peril you face or the foe you meet, improvise as needed and face them with composure."

mindscapes.name: Ward Off Misfortune
mindscapes.description: When an Ultimate or EX Special Attack deals DMG, it ignores 15% of the target's Ether RES. Triggering Ultimate: Qingming Skyshade extends all enemies' Stunned state by 3s. In a single Stun state duration, enemies can only have this effect applied once, and it does not stack with similar effects. Additionally, when using Ultimate: Endless Talisman Suppression, gain one stack of the Condensed Ink effect. After Basic Attack: Qingming Eruption or EX Special Attack: Ashen Ink Becomes Shadows, press the Basic Attack button, or after EX Special Attack: Qingming Eruption - Break, press the Special Attack button to consume one stack of Condensed Ink and launch EX Special Attack: Endless Talisman Suppression - Break, dealing DMG up to 1,200% of Sheer Force. Only one stack of Condensed Ink can be held at a time.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"Life's twists are unpredictable — at best, the diviner discerns but a fraction."
"Dispelling misfortune and blessing rituals are merely reading the signs to pursue gain and avoid peril."
"Once you understand how to sidestep misfortune, you can just as easily cast it upon your foe... just call forth the calamity they've yet to face."

mindscapes.name: Cycle of Yin and Yang
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"Everything in the world follows laws of mutual generation and restraint; by understanding that principle, you can balance yin and yang to overpower your foes."
"Achieving optimal results with simple techniques isn't cutting corners, but a natural result of following the flow."

mindscapes.name: The One Path of Mysticism
mindscapes.description: Activating an Ultimate grants one stack of Tranquility, up to a max of 2 stacks. For each stack of Tranquility, the next EX Special Attack: Cloud-Shaper DMG and EX Special Attack: Ashen Ink Becomes Shadows DMG increase by 30%.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"It's said that countless transformations arise from a single principle. In studying the mystic arts, one must not be bound by forms but must grasp their underlying meaning."
"If you can perceive the core principles, each technique flows into another. Such is the path of the mystic: infinite forms converge into unity."

mindscapes.name: Calm Sky Vigil
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"To master the mystic arts, diligent study and reflection are but the start — you must learn to maintain a pure mind, listening to the wind and watching the clouds."
"When you transcend self and world, your command of Ether grows ever stronger, almost without effort."
"As you persist, you'll be able to maintain inner poise through any trial, meeting any change with unshakable calm."

mindscapes.name: Swift Yet Still
mindscapes.description: After using Ultimate: Qingming Skyshade, gain a stack of the Regulated Breathing effect. While under this effect, you can ignore the Technique Point cost to launch Ultimate: Endless Talisman Suppression once. The Regulated Breathing effect ends after Ultimate: Endless Talisman Suppression is used. This effect can only be gained once every 30s. Only one stack of Regulated Breathing can be held. Additionally, while in the Meditation state, Yixuan's Sheer DMG is increased by 20%.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"Tranquility to govern force, motion and calm coexist. In every movement there lies a pause, and in every pause a potential for energy."
"At any moment, if your mind remains clear, you can meet endless change with unchanging focus — and strike for victory at just the right moment."
"Do you understand?"
"If not, that's okay... after silent contemplation, there comes that instant of awakening. This is yet another expression of 'swift yet still.'"

profile.details:
Ju Fufu, a rare tiger Thiren of New Eridu. She looks small and is still young, but she's the most senior disciple of Suibian Temple and one of Yixuan's first disciples.

"Able to deal with anything," "can even make Shifu listen," "super patient and meticulous teacher," "has great taste when choosing restaurants for teambuilding."
—Yunkui Summit trainee performance review, peer evaluation

"Always messing up the tasks given by Shifu," "doesn't command respect in speech or combat," "doesn't know how to act tough against bad guys," "juniors are more skilled."
—Yunkui Summit trainee performance review, self-evaluation

"'The most skilled senior ever who can do anything, a righteous hero with righteous might' is what I heard her say when I passed by her room. Hm... I concur."
—Yunkui Summit trainee performance review, Shifu's evaluation

Other: I suggest you suggest Yunkui Summit improve their network security to avoid the risk of disciples' personal data being stolen or leaked.
profile.details2:
Tiger Thirens, a Thiren race living in the mountains far from New Eridu's urban areas. Using the security camera footage in Janus Quarter, it can be extrapolated that there are no more than twenty tiger Thirens currently active in New Eridu.

During the fall of the old capital, a Hollow Zero companion Hollow disaster erupted in the tiger Thiren settlement. Records show that multiple notorious Ethereals appeared in this Hollow that swallowed up their settlement, killing 98 percent of all registered tiger Thirens. Most of the survivors were the sick, young, or elderly. If it hadn't been for a team of mystics from Yunkui Summit arriving within half an hour for search and rescue, the name Ju Fufu would likely have never appeared in your Agent records.

From Yunkui Summit's records and dates, Ju Fufu was already a disciple of the leader of Yunkui Summit, Yixuan, when the disaster happened.

skins.description: Dressed like a simple mystic, this senior sister looks like she's tucked all her bravado away, but with a tiger in her heart... she still radiates that heroic fire.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Tiger Seven Forms - Flaming Claw
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
Slash forward up to four times, dealing Physical DMG and Fire DMG.
During the 3rd hit, repeatedly press to maintain the combo and keep striking the enemy.
During the 3rd hit, hold or pause before pressing to chain into the 4th hit.
During the 3rd hit, Anti-Interrupt Level is increased, and DMG received is reduced by 40%.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Hu Wei
descriptions.description:
During combat, Hu Wei will automatically attack enemies, dealing Fire DMG.
Upon hitting an enemy, gain 20 points of Might, triggering up to once per use of a skill. The maximum for Might is 200.

descriptions.name: Dodge: Tiger Seven Forms - Tigerwind
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: Tiger Seven Forms - Tiger Charge
descriptions.description:
Press during a dodge to activate:
Perform a quick slash forward, dealing Physical DMG.

descriptions.description:
After using Dash Attack: Tiger Seven Forms - Tiger Charge, hold to activate:
Enter a high-speed spinning state. While in this state, use the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} to move and deal Physical DMG upon contact with enemies.
After Ju Fufu gains Momentum from other skills, she will be surrounded by flames in the high-speed spinning state. Upon contact with enemies, 1 point of Momentum is consumed, changing the DMG to Fire DMG and granting 25 points of Might. The maximum for Momentum is 15.
When consuming Momentum to deal Fire DMG, if Might is above 100 points, 100 points of Might will be automatically consumed to trigger Chain Attack: Suppressing Tiger Cauldron.
Releasing will have Ju Fufu exit the spinning state and throw Hu Wei to attack enemies, dealing Fire DMG. When switching to another character, Ju Fufu will remain in the spinning state and attempt to collide with the nearest enemy.
While Ju Fufu is the currently active character, DMG taken during the skill is reduced by 40%, and Anti-Interrupt Level is increased. If not the active character, she becomes Invulnerable.

descriptions.name: Dodge Counter: Tiger Seven Forms - Reignited Mountain
descriptions.description:

Perform multiple slashes on enemies ahead, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Quick Assist: Decisive Stomp
descriptions.description:
When the active character is launched, press to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Defensive Assist: Steadfast Crouching Tiger
descriptions.description:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Assist Follow-Up: Feral Blazing Maw
descriptions.description:

Gain 1 point of Momentum upon activation at most once every 10s.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Tiger Seven Forms - Mountain-Descending Tiger
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
Perform a spinning slash forward, followed by a falling slash, dealing Fire DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Tiger Seven Forms Alt - Mountain-Descending Savage Tiger
descriptions.description:
With enough Energy, press to activate:
Swing Hu Wei forward for a powerful strike, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Upon activation, gain 3 points of Momentum and 80 points of Might.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Chain Attack: Tiger Cauldron Collapse
descriptions.description:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Swing Hu Wei to deliver a powerful strike to enemies in a small area ahead, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Chain Attack: Suppressing Tiger Cauldron
descriptions.description:
With at least 100 points of Might, after triggering a Chain Attack, automatically activate:
Consume 100 Might to open Hu Wei and fire flames and popcorn at enemies, striking them in a small area ahead, dealing massive Fire DMG.
If Momentum is available, and while not the active character, the high-speed spinning state will activate after the skill ends.
This is an Aftershock. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.description:

Upon activation, gain 6 points of Momentum and 100 points of Might.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

mindscapes.name: Super Scary Little Tiger
mindscapes.description: Upon entering combat, Ju Fufu's CRIT Rate increases by 12%, and she immediately gains 100 Might. When Ju Fufu's Chain Attack hits an enemy, when the target is Stunned, the target's Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 35%, lasting for 30s.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"The topic of farewells and life and death is too difficult for children to understand, too heavy for adults to bear, and too cruel for the elderly."
"But I'm not afraid — I'm the fearless Tiger Thiren who learned this lesson early."
"I'm a super scary big tiger, little critters, so please don't look directly into my eyes!"

mindscapes.name: Almighty Qingming Warrior
mindscapes.description: While in the Tiger's Roar state, character CRIT DMG increases by an additional 22%. Whenever any character activates an Ultimate, Ju Fufu gains 3 points of Momentum.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"The techniques Shifu taught me are truly amazing, though it can't compare to those of fairy tales and legend."
"If I were a little stronger — just a little stronger — could I rewrite those fated pasts, like in the stories and legends?
"At first, I was just as puzzled, but once you grasp the trick, it's actually quite simple! Let me teach you, Junior!"

mindscapes.name: Righteous Young Hero
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"Good or evil, in that moment, perhaps it's all just a matter of a single thought. A single thought leaves behind so many regrets, so many 'what ifs' — and so much sacrifice and love."
"I'm not smart, I don't understand many of those grand principles, so I just do what I think is right."
"Wherever the great hero Fufu goes, there's justice!"

mindscapes.name: Monster-Slaying Tiger Mystic
mindscapes.description: While Ju Fufu is in the Tiger's Roar state, her CRIT DMG increases by 35%.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"Ethereals are terrifying, bandits are terrifying, Hollow Raiders are terrifying, the dark night without stars is terrifying — and yet, I'm the most powerful mystic of Yunkui Summit. I cannot retreat, I cannot let my story repeat."
"The dark and gloom is a blanketing shroud, unbearable for mountain, moon, and cloud."
"I am the strongest mystic of Yunkui Summit, evil spirits and demons, meet your end!"

mindscapes.name: Unrivaled Almighty Senior
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"No need to fear — your senior is here!"
"The hero I longed for when I was a child never came, but I won't make you wait — I will be your hero."
"You can bully me, but not my juniors! I'll take you on! Rwaar!"

mindscapes.name: Roar of My Inner Tiger
mindscapes.description: Ju Fufu's Chain Attack DMG increases by 30%. Upon consuming Momentum and hitting an enemy in the high-speed spinning state, fire 3 popcorns, each dealing 160% of Fufu's ATK as DMG. This DMG is treated as Chain Attack DMG.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"My might shakes the moon down from the mountain, my aura levels caves — how's this line? Does it capture the grandeur of my imposing presence?"
"The name of a hero doesn't matter, their regrets don't matter, their tears don't matter, and even the inevitable farewell doesn't matter."
"As long as you remember, I once roared with bravery."

profile.details:
Pan Yinhu, disciple of Yunkui Summit, serves as both the head chef and financial manager of Suibian Temple. He's proficient in martial arts, and an expert in pressure-point techniques.
As the one managing Suibian Temple's money, he's a master at keeping costs down and can bargain a 5,000 Denny piece of meat down to 500. If he can make something at home, he refuses to purchase it at a store, and no matter which big supermarket or shop you name, he's got a coupon for it tucked in his pocket.
Thanks to him, the members of Suibian Temple enjoy delicious yet budget-friendly meals every day. As the head of the kitchen, he demands precise flavor profiles and pays keen attention to his friends' opinions.
What's more, given his years of frugality, it's safe to assume that both the group's treasury and his secret piggy bank have ballooned to jaw-dropping levels.
profile.details2:
Being a Panda Thiren, an exceedingly rare sight in New Eridu, Pan Yinhu has scraped by on his own since he was a child. Only someone who's truly known starvation understands its terror, and to fill his belly he sampled every trade he could find. In the end, his remarkable Ether aptitude led him to become a Hollow Raider.
As a Hollow Raider, he had a chance encounter with Yixuan. Following a harsh beating and a sudden spiritual awakening, he opted to become a disciple of Yunkui Summit, where he now practices the mystic arts to cleanse his then-increasingly violent nature.
Because he joined the sect later than most, he actually has very few junior disciples — and you, Master, are one of them. As your senior, he shows his care by cooking special dishes just for you and constantly sneaking store coupons into your pockets.

skins.name: Hundred Flavors
skins.description: Yunkui Summit's largest disciple uniform, spacious enough for this senior brother's belly and all his seasonings. And that iron wok on top is a first of its kind. But... putting a pan you just used for stir-frying on your head? Doesn't it burn?

skins.name: Culinary Jewel
skins.description:
Senior Yinhu once dreamed of becoming a renowned chef, but in this day and age, there's always some thug looking to smash your bowl.
—"Go on, try smashing one."
