mindscapes.name: Qi Shield
mindscapes.description: All units deal 10% increased DMG to enemies affected by Depleted Qi.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
This Yunkui technique wards off the external flow of Ether while reinforcing your inner meridians and muscles. With qi acting as a shield, no blade or spear can pierce it — this is Pan Yinhu's secret to enduring every blow.
Side note: this trick comes in extra handy when you're elbow-to-elbow with aunties and uncles fighting over supermarket sale items.

mindscapes.name: Yunkui Pressure-Point Strike
mindscapes.description: For every 6 points of Break Force consumed, Pan Yinhu will recover 4 Energy, and the Depleted Qi effect applied when Special Attack: Touch of Death hits an enemy will have its duration increased to 12s.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"Heh, can't move an inch now, can you, thief?"
"This technique is called Yunkui Pressure-Point Strike — it both paralyzes the body and clears the meridians — it's our sect's ultimate technique for punishing evil and upholding justice!"
"...Eh? You mean my grip was so strong that you just went numb? ...Alright then — can you move or not?"

mindscapes.name: Non-Meridian Pressure Point
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"These pressure points are a lot like us Panda Thirens."
"They're few and scattered, don't fit into any one system, and hardly anyone's ever studied them. It's a shame."
"But they really catch people off guard as a surprise weapon. Pretty great, right?"

mindscapes.name: First-Class Head Chef
mindscapes.description: When Ultimate: A Feast Fit for an Emperor! heals all squad members, the HP recovery is increased by 25%, and the healing over time effect is increased by 25%. On activating Ultimate: A Feast Fit for an Emperor!, gain the Backup Provisions effect. Whenever any character in the squad loses HP, consume the Backup Provisions effect to instantly restore 50% of the HP recovered with Ultimate: A Feast Fit for an Emperor!'s instant HP recovery effect. This effect does not stack.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
The first time he cooked, he nearly set the stove on fire. Among those who rushed to help was a chef who, looking at the pile of burnt food, used the unused eggs to make him a plate of fried rice.
He wolfed it down with tears in his eyes. When he finally looked up, the cook was holding out a slip of paper with "100" written on it.
"I understand, Master! You're teaching me in cooking, you have to give it 100%, right?" "No, I'm saying it's 100 Dennies per bite, and you've had over a hundred bites. Time to pay up."
From that day on, Pan Yinhu insisted on cooking for himself and never messed up again. And that's how a first-class chef was born.

mindscapes.name: "Thiren"
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
In the sprawling city of New Eridu, Panda Thirens are extremely rare. He's always bristled at curious stares and long ago gotten used to living a lonely life with nobody to support him.
It wasn't until he became an apprentice on Yunkui Summit that he stopped feeling so isolated.
And once he realized that many citizens would even pay to take a photo with a Panda Thiren... he no longer minded the stares.

mindscapes.name: Meridian Theory
mindscapes.description: The Meridian Flow effect provided by Core Passive: Meridian Enlightenment increases by an extra 6% of Pan Yinhu's initial ATK. The maximum Sheer Force provided by this effect increases to 720.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"There's an old saying that there are 365 pressure points in the feet. Funny — it's the same with how we live our lives."
"Here — pick whichever point you like from this chart."
"That point represents your current way of life — where it is or what it does doesn't matter. As long as you like it, that's enough."
"And what good is choosing it, you ask? Let me think... Ah, of course. Next time I deal with some thieves, that's the point I'll target!"

profile.details:
Seed, heavy weapons specialist of New Eridu Defense Force, Obsidian Division, Obol Squad. Her real name is Flora. The codename "Seed" was passed down from her guardian, the combat-grade Intelligent Construct formerly known by the same name, who now goes by "Seed Sr."

According to multiple sources, Seed is an unidentified orphan Seed Sr. rescued from Hollow Zero during the fall of the old capital. Seed Sr. adopted her and raised her alone in the Defense Force dormitories.
A few years ago, Seed Sr. successfully applied to join Obol Squad, but not long after, he passed away due to irreversible damage to his logic core. As a result, Seed took his place in the squad. Any voice lines heard from Seed Sr. today are system-preloaded audio files.

Seed possesses an extraordinary gift for mechanical engineering and research, capable of designing and building inventions far beyond the imagination of most. She also has an exceptional adaptability for Ether, able to push Seed Sr.'s combat capabilities to the limit by piloting him, through remote control, and by using custom combat modules.

And so, despite her extraordinarily substandard physical capabilities and entirely mysterious origins, the military still gave tacit approval for her to serve as an elite soldier.

Seed behaves quite differently from most people in everyday situations. She uses Seed Sr.'s cockpit as her bed, prefers confined spaces, and strongly dislikes talking to or interacting with anyone outside her immediate circle. Her logic jumps wildly, making meaningful conversation difficult.

The good news? For some reason, she's taken a special liking to you, Master, and the second assistant. You've been spared the long ordeal of earning her trust — and you don't have to worry about her occasional bouts of destructive behavior turning your way. Congratulations.

Suggestion: Focus on topics like flowers and robots — her favorite things — when engaging in conversation. Stay calm when parts of her logic or meaning don't make sense; treating such moments as normal can help strengthen your bond with her.
profile.details2:
From a young age, Seed has displayed unusual and potentially hazardous anomalous abilities. These include the ability to control, disable, or detonate nearby machines. The ability only surfaces during episodes of intense emotional instability, with a red glow in her eyes being the most visible symptom.

It was this very ability that caused Seed Sr.'s self-defense system to automatically classify her as a high-risk threat upon their first encounter, indirectly leading to the irreversible damage to his logic core.

By the time Seed Sr. rescued her from Hollow Zero, Seed already exhibited a lack of emotional connection to life — she was unable to understand it, feel it, or empathize with it, due to unknown causes.

Seed Sr. spent the following years trying to raise her into a more complete person. After his death, the task fell to the rest of Obol Squad. Thankfully, her condition has improved considerably over time.

Master, based on your previous exploration logs in Hollow Zero with Seed, it's now clear that her true identity is similar to yours — she was also a student of the Helios Academy.

It's presumed that while at Helios, she belonged to a different research project, likely one focused on machine studies. Her abnormal abilities and personality defects are likely residual effects of that project. However, due to her memory loss of both the Helios Academy and the fall of the old capital, no further details can currently be determined.

Additionally, Master, she sometimes stares at me with a smile, leading me to suspect she may have an urge to dismantle me out of curiosity. It is deeply unsettling. I must formally request enhanced protection for my personal safety, lest you lose a very cute and capable assistant.

skins.description: A corner of the world blooming in color, a single salty tear, a perfect circle of life — this is where the girl and the construct uncovered the truth of the heart. She never needs to look back; she has already blossomed into her own sea of petals.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Chrysanthemum Wheel Dance
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
Perform up to 4 attacks forward, dealing Physical DMG for the first two hits and Electric DMG for the third and fourth hits.
When attacked between the retreat of the 3rd hit to before the 4th hit, triggers an automatic dodge.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter
descriptions.description:
After the 4th hit of a Basic Attack, Dodge Counter, Quick Assist, or Assist Follow-Up, hold or press to activate:
Summon the mech to perform a charged punch attack, dealing massive Electric DMG.
When Steel Charge reaches 120, gain one chance to quickly activate Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter by holding . This effect expires when Steel Charge is less than 120 or after using the method above to activate Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter once.
Does not accumulate Steel Charge on hit.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Downfall
descriptions.description:
Seed has Steel Charge, which she can accumulate by hitting enemies with her skills.
Steel Charge has a maximum value of 150, and an initial value of 60. Upon reaching 120 Steel Charge and triggering Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter or Ultimate: Clockwork Garden - Bloom!, press or hold to consume 60 Steel Charge and unleash Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Downfall First Form, then automatically consume 60 Steel Charge to follow up with Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Downfall Second Form.
Pilots the mech to fire sweeping shots and perform a jumping smash, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Does not accumulate Steel Charge on hit.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dodge: Running on Petals
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: Magnetic Wheel Dance
descriptions.description:
Press during a dodge to activate:
Throw steel wheels forward, dealing Physical DMG.

descriptions.name: Dodge Counter: Blossom Burst
descriptions.description:
Press during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Unleash a barrage of lasers at enemies in front, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Quick Assist: Barrage of Raining Flowers
descriptions.description:

Unleash a barrage of lasers at enemies in front, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Defensive Assist: Sprouting Barrier

descriptions.name: Assist Follow-Up: Crimson Core Burst

Press after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Unleash continuous floating turret attacks at enemies ahead, dealing Electric DMG.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Withered in Frost
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
Throw a steel wheel that traces a curved path, dealing Electric DMG.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Raining Iron Petals
descriptions.description:
With enough Energy, press to activate:
Enter flight mode, where Seed can move in four directions, and unleash a continuous barrage of missiles, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Hold to extend the barrage duration while continuously consuming Energy.
During flight, release to trigger EX Special Attack: Raining Iron Petals - Away.
Upon consuming 60 Energy points in one flight, automatically trigger Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Raining Iron Petals - Away
descriptions.description:
During EX Special Attack: Raining Iron Petals, release to activate:
Unleash rapid cannon fire, dealing Electric DMG.
Does not accumulate Steel Charge on hit.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Chain Attack: Tempest of Frosty Petals
descriptions.description:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Summons her mech for protection, then launches cannon shots and a barrage of missiles, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Ultimate: Clockwork Garden - Bloom!
descriptions.description:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate:
Seed will pilot the mech personally, raining down missiles and a meteor shower of rockets, then performing a jumping smash, dealing massive Electric DMG.
After using this skill, accumulate 60 Steel Charge.
Does not accumulate Steel Charge on hit.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Core Passive: Flower Chain Protocol
skills.description:
The Attack teammate with the highest initial ATK is considered Seed's Vanguard.
When the Vanguard unleashes an EX Special Attack, Seed gains Onslaught status, increasing Seed's ATK by 100 and CRIT DMG by 15%. When Seed unleashes an EX Special Attack, the Vanguard gains Direct Strike status, increasing the Vanguard's ATK by 100 and CRIT DMG by 15%.
When Direct Strike and Onslaught are both active, Seed and the Vanguard simultaneously gain Besiege status, increasing DMG dealt by 12.5%.
Onslaught, Direct Strike, and Besiege buffs can all take effect when the character is the current active character. When switching to inactive, the buffs remain until the character goes off-field or 3s after the switch. When the character returns to being the active character, the buffs re-activate.
Upon entering the battlefield with a Vanguard, Seed immediately gains Onslaught status and Besiege status, while the Vanguard immediately gains Direct Strike status and Besiege status.
Direct Strike and Onslaught status last for 40s, and repeated triggers refresh the duration.
When the Vanguard consumes Energy as the active character or when Seed consumes Energy, for every 1 point of Energy consumed, Seed recovers 0.5 points of Steel Charge.

mindscapes.name: "Hibernation Period"
mindscapes.description: When Seed's Steel Charge reaches 100, Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Downfall can be triggered, and the total Steel Charge consumed is reduced to 100. The amount of Steel Charge required to gain one chance to quickly release Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter is reduced to 100. Accumulate an additional 40/20 Steel Charge when entering the battlefield/using Ultimate. Increases Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Downfall CRIT DMG by 30%.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
This is a solemn and mysterious building, isolated from the outside world.
The pure white one belongs here. She shrinks back, carefully peering out through the wire fence. What's the world outside like?
Her curiosity flows beyond the sterile room, past the crumbling towers, dodging the pink giant flowers in the sky.
Flowing further and further...
"Looks just like a cracked, stinky egg~"
"But I want to experience it for a while..."

mindscapes.name: "Light Absorption Technique"
mindscapes.description: When Besiege is active for an Agent, that Agent's DMG ignores 20% of DEF. When activating EX Special Attack: Raining Iron Petals, after consuming a total of 60 Energy, Seed can continue consuming Energy to extend the duration of the skill until the button is released or a total of 120 Energy is consumed. For every 5 Energy consumed by EX Special Attack: Raining Iron Petals, the following Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter's DMG increases by 5%.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
This is a sprawling ruin of twisted steel.
An inexplicable, indescribable emotion chokes her throat, yet her tongue remains silent...
Her vision blurs as some alien liquid trickles down her cheeks.
Rubbing her eyes, blinking...
What is this blinding thing clumsily drawing closer?
"Don't be afraid... I'm here... to save you..."
"Do you have... a name? My codename is... 'Seed.'"

mindscapes.name: "A Story of Sprouting"
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
This is just another break room in a military camp.
They greeted her, trying to open her heart.
A shy redheaded young lady, a strange chatty gun barrel, a golden retriever with an eye cover...
The big robot told her that they were all her friends.
"What are friends?"
"Friends... they're the ones you see when you look behind you."

mindscapes.name: "Fragrant Tune"
mindscapes.description: When Seed's Besiege status buff is active, her Decibel Generation Rate increases by 10%, and Ultimate DMG increases by 20%.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
This is a grand, bustling plaza.
On a stage towering above everyone else, someone is muttering something.
A voice calls out her name, and many people crowd around. The dazed flower is transplanted onto the stage, gunpowder still fresh in her hair.
The black box flickers with light brighter than stars, and small metal patches are pinned onto both the older and the younger one, both equally at a loss for what to do.
This recognition also means that from this moment on, she is "Seed," and the robot that has always been by her side is now "Seed Sr."
"Did I do well?"
"Of course, you're our pride... this codename is proof of that, Seed."

mindscapes.name: "Time to Bloom"
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
This is a tiny safe house that almost no one knows about.
The entire space is filled with scattered, miscellaneous items. Boxes, sofas, picture frames, and pots upon pots of flowers — red ones, yellow ones, pink ones, some standing straight, some fluffy, some drooping.
Close your eyes, cover your mouth, you'll hold it in for sure — she promised.
"Give them a little more time, okay?"
"They'll grow up beautifully... just like you."

mindscapes.name: "Theory of the Heart"
mindscapes.description:
Seed's CRIT DMG increases by 50%.
When using Basic Attack: Falling Petals - Slaughter, fires 3 additional laser beams, each dealing 165% of ATK as DMG. This effect can trigger once every 3s.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
Here lies a vast sea of flowers, blooming wild and brilliant.
She remembers how this place once looked — barren, without even a single blade of grass.
Who could have done such mischief? Who transformed this desolate, gloomy Hollow Zero into this? Who planted such a strong heart in this pale soil?
"So you've come such a long way on this circle..."
"Until we meet again, Seed Sr."

profile.details:
Alice Thymefield, a new member of Spook Shack, is a young lady from the prestigious Thymefield family of New Eridu.

Alice has studied fencing and Ether science since childhood, showing exceptional talent in both fields. She currently attends Celestia School for Girls, a subsidiary of High Ambitions Academy, where she's a model student excelling in both academics and conduct. It is predicted that she will one day inherit the family business and become a next-generation Ether scholar of New Eridu.

She places extreme importance on order and patterns, showing an almost obsessive pursuit of symmetry in particular. This even affects her aesthetic judgment, making symmetry the primary criterion in determining whether something is beautiful or ugly.

Furthermore, she's easily frightened, with practically zero resistance to ghost stories and supernatural tales. Despite this, she seems to show considerable interest in encountering such phenomena. Suggestion: Master can use ghost stories as a topic of conversation with her. No matter how much she initially refuses, it is likely that she will eventually come closer to investigate.
profile.details2:
According to my investigations, Alice has been obsessed with symmetry ever since she was young, but after experiencing the loss of her symmetrical hairpin and her father's subsequent death, she subconsciously attributed the tragedy to the loss of a symmetrical object, which intensified her obsession with symmetry.

As a prestigious family known for their Ether science research, the Thymefield family is currently facing a decline. With Alice's parents passing away early and her grandfather falling ill, and after giving away the family's patents to save a friend, she's determined to start anew and revive the family through her own strength.

Despite her timid nature, once she sets her mind on accomplishing something, she'll pursue it with unwavering determination. Moreover, she values her companions deeply and would never ignore their difficulties... Therefore, Master, I strongly recommend improving relations with Alice and informing her about our current financial struggles with paying the electricity bills.

skins.name: Celestian Etiquette
skins.description: The young woman's perfect symmetry is only ever slightly compromised when she wears the school crest — such is the elegant and noble Thymefield spirit.

skins.name: Sea of Thyme
skins.description:
Though it wasn't completely symmetrical, she did not mind this gift from a dear friend.
The girl pushed open the locked door and walked along the pink beach after the sudden downpour, the cool waves brushing over her ankles. There were no unknowns left to frighten her.

descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
Perform up to 5 slashes forward, dealing Physical DMG.
When Alice triggers Assault through Attribute Anomaly Buildup, the 5th hit of her next Basic Attack is enhanced.

descriptions.description:
When Alice's Blade Etiquette reaches 1 bar, hold to activate:
Hold to charge, expending up to 3 bars of Blade Etiquette. Release or when Blade Etiquette is below 1 bar, Alice performs a series of slashes in an area centered on the target enemy, with the number of hits determined by charge level, dealing massive Physical DMG.
When the Finishing Move of a three-stage charged Basic Attack: Starshine Waltz hits, it triggers a special Assault effect: Polarity Assault. Slash and kick enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Defensive Assist: Parry Guard

Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Back away with a slash, then thrust forward, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Activating the skill can trigger Perfect Dodge and restores 10 Blade Etiquette.

mindscapes.name: Palmful of Cilantro
mindscapes.description: When Alice triggers a Polarity Assault, she gains 25 Blade Etiquette. When she triggers Assault against an enemy, the target's DEF is reduced by 20% for 30s.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
A sprig of coriander sways like a newborn green star,
So fragile her fingertips felt they might pass through it.
She slowly opened her trembling hands,
And held that flicker of feeling in her palms.
Her heart beat like a spring bud breaking the earth at dawn, just after the rain.

mindscapes.name: Sage at the Sword's Tip
mindscapes.description: When Ultimate: Starfall Finale's Finishing Move hits an enemy, it triggers Polarity Assault. All squad members' Assault DMG increases by 15%. Disorder DMG against enemies suffering from Physical Anomaly increases by 15%. Upon entering the battlefield, Alice immediately gains 1,000 Decibels. Triggers once per 180s in Investigation Zone mode.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
The silver blade dips low, kissing the frost-lined sage leaf.
This pre-battle salute is the girl's quiet show of composure.
Fear and helplessness lie frozen in the faded dreams of yesterday.
Her sword stirs, ready to trace the outline of the stars.
Dawn is near, and the flower bud waits to bloom.

mindscapes.name: Symmetrism
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
She couldn't resist perfect symmetry.
In symmetry, there was order, balance, and meaning. Without it, her bunny ears and tail would dull and droop, as if something lovely were about to vanish from her world.
"So... that's why you had to bring up my mismatched socks, and tried to take off my leg band?"
"I just can't stand your asymmetry! Just for a second, I swear — just one second!"

mindscapes.name: Rosemary on Her Lips
mindscapes.description: Alice ignores 10% of the target's Physical RES. Enhanced Basic Attack: Celestial Overture accumulates 25% more Physical Anomaly Buildup.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
The scent of rosemary lingered between her lips,
A vow searing and resolute, carried on every breath of frost.
Even as the air in her lungs turned cold and heavy,
The girl would never forget the spell called love.
"In the name of the Thymefields... I will never betray it."

mindscapes.name: Passion for the Supernatural
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
She couldn't resist scary paranormal things.
Within the paranormal hid the unknown and the dangerous. When she felt it, her bunny ears and tail would bristle in fright — only to become irresistibly smooth once she calmed down.
"So... that's why you always tag along on my ghost-hunting trips, even though you're scared out of your mind?"
"I just wanted to see what would happen... but it's so scary, I totally regret it! Just this once — I swear I'm not coming next time!"

mindscapes.name: A Heart of Thyme
mindscapes.description: When Alice uses a third-stage charged Basic Attack: Starshine Waltz or Ultimate: Starfall Finale, she enters the Victory State for 30s. During this time, whenever any squad member lands a hit on a target, Alice will follow up with an extra attack against the target, dealing Physical DMG equal to 3,300% of her Anomaly Proficiency. This effect can trigger once every 1s and is guaranteed to CRIT. This effect can trigger up to 6 times. Gaining the Victory State again refreshes the available trigger count.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
The thyme-scented manor,
The night spent watching the stars,
The moment she came to understand what courage truly meant.
A fragrant wind swept the clouds away, and sunlight outshone the crystal chandelier.
The girl gave a gentle bow to the days gone by.
Then, slowly, she vanished into the field of thyme.

profile.details:
Ukinami Yuzuha, a resident of Waifei Peninsula's Failume Heights, currently attends a low-tuition company affiliated school in the city. Aside from being part of the Inter-Knot subforum Spook Shack, she's not affiliated with any other groups — though in New Eridu, such forums aren't typically seen as formal organizations, and are, instead, more like hobby clubs.
Yuzuha is the adopted daughter of Li Baorong, owner of the Mystic Wares Porcelume store. Word around Failume Heights is that Baorong lost his wife and two daughters when the old capital fell. In the years that followed, he took in five children. Yuzuha is the second oldest, with an older brother, a younger brother, and two younger sisters. The family lived on the second floor above the store, and with just two bedrooms, Yuzuha shared one with her sisters, while the boys stayed with Baorong. Now that her older brother has moved out and she mostly stays in the school dorm, the apartment feels a bit less crowded. But on weekends and holidays, Yuzuha usually returns from school to help her father at the store.
Even as a child, Yuzuha showed a surprising level of maturity. Her eloquence and cheerful nature have made her a favorite among neighbors — and a hit with the kids around Waifei Peninsula and Sailume Bay.
On the Spook Shack forum, Yuzuha goes by the username "Yuzupepper." In addition to her real-life friends Manato and Alice, she is also close with two other users known as "Night Emissary" and "Strawberry Parfait" on the forums.
profile.details2:
According to Yuzuha, she's been wandering the Faunus Quarter for as long as she can remember, living as part of a small gang of street kids. She didn't have a name back then. Due to malnutrition, she had night blindness and always carried a candlestick after dark, so the others nicknamed her "Little Candle."
Yuzuha was part of an experimental project called "Project New Leaf." Since she never had a proper name, one of the lower-level researchers assigned to care for the children gave her the name "Yuzuha." However, this name was never known to Ferox or the other higher-ups — they only ever referred to her as ES-07. Despite the name coming from the lab, Yuzuha has always felt the name carried a spark of life — and that spark was part of her luck.
Both of Yuzuha's younger sisters were adopted as infants, and when Baorong named them, he continued his tradition of using names inspired by plants.

skins.name: Tanuki Under the Shade
skins.description: Can you tell what the umbrella conceals? A tanuki, a trap, a ghost, or a girl's sly, spirited smile?

skins.name: Tanuki in Broad Daylight
skins.description: Ghost stories aren't born only in shadows. Unconvinced? Just lock eyes with that playful young lady splashing in the water. She'll possess your thoughts, while Kama sneaks away with your drink.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Tanuki Claws
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
Unleashes up to 5 strikes ahead, dealing Physical DMG.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Tanuki Cloak
descriptions.description:
Hold to activate:

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Hard Candy Shot

Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max initially deals Physical DMG.
Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max does not contribute its accumulated Attribute Anomaly Buildup toward Anomaly DMG calculation.
Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by {0}%.

descriptions.name: Sweet Scare
descriptions.description:
The Sweet Scare state lasts for {0}s, repeated triggers reset the duration.

Tanuki Wish grants an ATK increase equal to 40% of Yuzuha's initial ATK, up to a maximum increase of 600, and increases the DMG dealt by those with the effect by 15%, lasting 40s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

skills.name: Additional Ability: The More the Merrier

mindscapes.name: Lucky Constitution
mindscapes.description: Yuzuha regains 30 Energy when she enters the battlefield. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger at most once every 180s. Enemies in the Sweet Scare state have their All-Attribute RES reduced by 10%. The Attribute Anomaly DMG and Disorder DMG buff from her Additional Ability is increased to 130% of its original value.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"Ugh, I'm done for!"
"Yuzuha, you failed too? ...Hold up, a 92?! Are you seriously telling me you guessed your way to that score? You're just showing off!"
"No, seriously! Luck only works if you don't overdo it. I had no reason to get such a high score on this one... I can feel it — there's no way the next test will have multiple choice!"

mindscapes.name: Full of Colorful Company
mindscapes.description: When Yuzuha's EX Special Attack: Cavity Alert, EX Special Attack: Cavity Alert, Right Now!, or Ultimate: Surrender or Suffer the Mischief hits an enemy, all squad members' DMG increases by 15% and Anomaly Buildup Rate by 15%, lasting 40s and repeated triggers reset the duration. When a heavy attack hits an enemy that is not Stunned, it will trigger a forced Chain Attack. Chain Attacks triggered this way have reduced Interrupt Level and forced Chain Attacks can only occur once every 20s. Whenever another character enters through a Chain Attack, Yuzuha gains 1 Sugar Points. Yuzuha's Basic Attack: Hard Candy Shot cooldown is reduced by 25%.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"Kama, you've never left my sight, but how did you swap so many things like just like that?"
"Heh heh~ Kama's got a lot of friends too! Come on out, everyone! Let me introduce them — left to right: Takenosuke, Inosuke, Hyakunosuke..."
"Wait, you're going too fast!"
"Okay, one more time: Shinnosuke, Kinosuke, Harunosuke..."
"Those names are completely different!"

mindscapes.name: Fairytale of the Haunted City
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"...The princess led a busy life. At sunrise, her silent and stoic maids would adorn her with lavish garments, a weighty magical crown, and layers of jewelry before guiding her to the throne where she used her powers to turn mundane stones into priceless gems."
"Does the princess really have to turn stones into gems every single day? That sounds even more boring than doing homework while minding the shop."
"Well... if she doesn't, the poor kingdom will collapse."
"If a kingdom can only survive by overworking the princess, then let it collapse!"
She bursts into laughter. Yes — let such a useless kingdom fall.

mindscapes.name: Falling Magic
mindscapes.description: The DMG of Yuzuha's Assist Follow-Up: Stuffed Hard Candy Shot and Assist Follow-Up: We Have Cookies increases by 30%, Anomaly Buildup Rate by 20%, and triggers a Quick Assist when it hits an enemy.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
The girl I saw through the narrow vent shone like she'd stepped right out of a fairytale.
She was the real princess — and I was just a prisoner.
Lord, she has so much already... would it be so wrong if I had just a tiny bit of it too?
That's when the hairpin silently fell.

mindscapes.name: Dreams of a Fading Winter
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
The day the TOPS executives and the Inspection Team arrived, she and Manato had just returned from school. Their airship had to circle overhead for ages, waiting for a place to land because the guests' vehicles took priority. Sweating as they hurried across the skybridge, they passed just above a throng of reporters surrounding the guests. That's when she spotted the girl. That night, she had a dream: it was her being swarmed by reporters, walking that same path under the bridge. And at the end of it... stood a throne, waiting just for her.
It had been a long time since she'd had a dream like that. She got up for a drink of water, replaying the words she'd overheard during the day: "A so-called expert Inspection Team, and they've got some rich girl tagging along just for show!"
"Kama, Kama!" She cracked open the window and whispered. A fuzzy little face popped up instantly from outside. "I've got a great idea. Tomorrow night... let's go do something fun."

mindscapes.name: Put Down Roots
mindscapes.description: Gain 1 additional Sugar Points when successfully parrying an enemy attack using a Defensive Assist or Basic Attack: Tanuki Cloak. When using Assist Follow-Up: Stuffed Hard Candy Shot, hold to charge for up to 0.8 seconds. Releasing or reaching full charge fires an extra powerful shell at the enemy. For every 0.4s charged, Yuzuha consumes 1 Sugar Point to fire an additional powerful shell, each dealing 300% of her ATK as Physical DMG. If any powerful shell from Assist Follow-Up: Stuffed Hard Candy Shot hits an enemy, all squad members' Disorder DMG Multiplier increases by 105% for 40s, and stacking up to 3 times, with each stack duration being calculated separately. In addition, if the powerful shell hits an enemy under Sweet Scare, it'll trigger 1 Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max attack. If Yuzuha is attacked while charging, she will automatically dodge the attack and immediately unleash the max-charged attack.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
The night the hearing ended, Baorong said they should celebrate Kaede getting a scholarship, so Mystic Wares closed early and the whole family went to Yum Cha Sin.
During the meal, her brother called from the far-off Faunus Quarter to offer his congratulations. While Sumire and A-Wen animatedly recounted the day's events: a calico cat at school had lost her kitten, and no one could find it — until, miraculously, it came back on its own at noon.
On the phone, her brother sighed, "A-Wen, every time I ask about your grades, you change the subject. If Dad and Yuzuha won't say anything, then I will!"
Everyone laughed — except Baorong, who just kept murmuring, "It came back, that's what matters... that it came back..."

profile.details:
Anby, the original member of Gentle House.
According to the New Eridu resident records, her identity as "Anby Demara" only exists after joining Gentle House, the name obviously being taken from Nicole. Before registering as an employee of Gentle House, all data relating to Anby is suspiciously blank.
Despite her extreme lack of common sense, Anby is well-versed in matters related to combat and is among the strongest combatants of the Cunning Hares.

Anby's greatest interest is movies, of which she likes an extensive range of genres. Due to an excessive obsession, she tends to take the stories in movies as reality.
Contrary to her seemingly emotionless appearance, Anby is easily moved by movie storylines.
Her favorite food is hamburgers because "they contain protein, carbs, and greens, taste good, and are even affordable — there's nothing else besides hamburgers."
profile.details2:
Rumors suggest Nicole found Anby near the ruins of the old capital and took her in because she was impressed by her formidable combat abilities.
"It's not because she's strong! I took her in because I'm kind~" — Nicole
Anby's behavior and combat performance suggest she has had military training.
Due to the suspicious gaps in her history, it's advised to maintain a certain level of vigilance towards her.
profile.aptitude:
HIA License Archive Information:
Hollow Investigator - Anby. High aptitude for Ether. Permitted to conduct investigations, basic mining, etc. in known Hollows within the city (including companion Hollows).
Reminder: Similar to Nicole, Anby's investigator license has not been updated for a long time.
Self-funded tests are recommended as soon as possible to avoid any losses.

skins.description:
Anby's old Silver Squad uniform, stained with memories that never truly fade.
When the shadows of the past strike without warning, would you stand and face them, or stumble and flee? No matter the choice, home always awaits your return.

mindscapes.name: Static Charge
mindscapes.description: When Soldier 0 - Anby uses an EX Special Attack to hit an enemy, it triggers the additional DMG from White Thunder 3 times. This effect does not consume any White Thunder stacks.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"Please keep my business here a secret from Nicole and the others."
"Alright. Are you sleeping on the couch downstairs or upstairs?"
"...Proxy... Thank you."

mindscapes.name: Fail-Safe Protocol
mindscapes.description:
Soldier 0 - Anby's CRIT Rate increases by 12%. When she uses her Ultimate, she gains 6 stacks of Thunder's Cry (max 6 stacks). With Thunder's Cry, when using Special Attack: Azure Flash to hit an enemy with White Thunder, it will consume 1 stack of Thunder's Cry instead. Only 1 stack of Thunder's Cry will be consumed when a single use of a skill hits multiple enemies, and consuming Thunder's Cry will still activate the additional DMG from White Thunder.
After activating potential, every 3 stacks of Thunder's Cry consumed, the next Special Attack: Azure Flash - Boundary will be activated faster.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"What's wrong? You look really tired."
"I'm... fine."
"If you need help, just say the word."

mindscapes.name: Past Glory
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"Anby, we were just talking about you. Are you really okay?"
"I... I'm..."
"If you try to brush it off with 'I'm fine' again, I might not be so kind."
"What does 'not being kind' from you look like, Proxy?"

mindscapes.name: Silver Reverb
mindscapes.description: When hitting an enemy marked with Silver Star, Soldier 0 - Anby ignores 12% of the target's Electric RES.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"Anby, you just came back from the Hollow. Do you want to take a shower?"
"You go ahead, Proxy. I still need to organize some information..."
"Ha."
"Hmm?"
"Why do I feel like Anby has been living in this house for a long time..."

mindscapes.name: Director's Cut
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"I get it now. About Anby and Silver Squad..."
"Sorry. I never meant for all of this to become your burden, Proxy."
"So — what movie do you feel like watching tonight?"
"Huh...?"
"Your troubles will never be a burden. See? Normal life can go on as usual."

mindscapes.name: Prequel Protagonist
mindscapes.description: Upon triggering 6 instances of White Thunder's additional DMG, an electromagnetic vortex will be generated, dealing 1,000% of Soldier 0 - Anby's ATK as Electric DMG against the target and surrounding enemies. This DMG is considered Aftershock DMG.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"Well... I should be heading back, Proxy. Thanks for everything you've done for me."
"I know you promised Nicole you wouldn't run away from home again, but isn't this a little unfair to me?
—I miss those days when you and I would watch movies together until dawn."
"Unfair... to you? Well, I'll just have to come up with a way to make up for it."
"Hurry up and think of something."
"Soldier 0, at your service... Huh, huh...?"

profile.details:
Pulchra, formerly a mercenary from the Outer Ring, is now a member of the Sons of Calydon. She works as an ordinary employee at the logistics company Leaps and Bounds.
Warning: Financial transactions have been detected between Pulchra and several biker and criminal gangs from the Outer Ring. These records have reduced since joining the Sons of Calydon, but there has been a large increase in funds transferred from New Eridu. This is likely because Pulchra's new position allows for easier access to New Eridu.
Further information indicates Pulchra has indirect involvement in several major events in the Outer Ring, including but not limited to: gang conflicts, leaks of crucial convoy supply intel, mysterious road damage, and price surges of essential goods...
Pulchra does not have deep connections with Lucius, and there is no current risk of her being an insider for any other biker gangs. However, her interpersonal network is highly complicated. Caution is advised when interacting with her, especially in protecting personal privacy.
profile.details2:
Employment records for Pulchra were found for two Outer Ring mercenary groups that disbanded years ago. She was hired alongside a young woman named Milena, but her records completely vanished about eight years ago.
Around eight years ago, Pulchra briefly formed a small mercenary group, but no records were found regarding the team members or the reason for its dissolution. Her personal career suddenly began to take off after this.
profile.aptitude:
There is no record of Pulchra's Aptitude for Ether in the New Eridu Citizen Verification Profile.
Note: Pulchra has excellent aptitude for Ether, but her thick cat Thiren fur is susceptible to influence from the Hollows. Once corruption begins, there is a significant risk of rapid deterioration, requiring special attention.

skins.description: A wandering mercenary should be out roaming the world, but the sunlight here is warm — perfect for a nap.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Swift Strike
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
Unleashes up to 3 attacks forward, dealing Physical DMG.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Leaping Strike
descriptions.description:
Hold to activate:
Leap forward and unleash a series of slashes, dealing Physical DMG.

descriptions.name: Dodge: Reversal Shot
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: First Strike Advantage
descriptions.description:
Press during a dodge to activate:
Dash forward and slash, dealing Physical DMG.

descriptions.name: Dodge Counter: Relentless Retribution
descriptions.description:
Press during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Thrust at enemies in front, then follow up with a swift slash, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Quick Assist: Contract - Bodyguard
descriptions.description:
When the active character is launched, press to activate:
Thrust at enemies in front, followed by rapid slashes, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Evasive Assist: Contract - Outsourced Combat
descriptions.description:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press to activate:
Dodges the enemy's attack and activates Vital View.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Assist Follow-Up: Independent Pricing
descriptions.description:
Press after an Evasive Assist to activate:
Leap forward into the air and fire, dealing Physical DMG.
Upon activating this skill, consume 1 Assist Point to enter the Hunter's Gait state.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Rending Claw
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
Perform a rapid back-and-forth piercing attack, dealing Physical DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Rending Claw - Nightmare Shadow
descriptions.description:
While Pulchra is in the Hunter's Gait state, and when another active character in the squad hits an enemy with a heavy attack from a Special Attack or EX Special Attack:
Dash back-and-forth piercing enemies centered on the target, dealing Physical DMG.
After using this skill, if another active character in the squad hits an enemy, Pulchra will repeat the attack up to 5 additional times, with the final attack being a more powerful Finishing Move.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Special Attack: Rending Claw - Nightmare Shadow is an Aftershock attack.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Rending Claw - Flashstep
descriptions.description:
With enough Energy, press to activate:
Pierce back and forth times, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Chain Attack: Hey, Didn't Expect That, Right?
descriptions.description:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a charged shot forward, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Ultimate: Oh, Time to Play?
descriptions.description:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate:
Unleash a powerful shot at enemies in a large area ahead, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Core Passive: Hunter's Instinct
skills.description: When Pulchra activates an EX Special Attack, Assist Follow-Up, Chain Attack, or Ultimate, she enters the Hunter's Gait state, increasing the Daze she deals by 15% for 6s. After switching to another character, if Pulchra is still in the Hunter's Gait state, the state will last until Pulchra switches back in. While in the Hunter's Gait state and as the active character, when Pulchra lands a heavy attack on enemies, she can trigger a Quick Assist from the previous character in the squad.

skills.name: Additional Ability: Business Partner
skills.description:
When another character in your squad is an Attack or Rupture character or shares the same Faction:
When Pulchra hits enemies with Special Attack: Rending Claw - Nightmare Shadow, EX Special Attack: Rending Claw - Flashstep, Assist Follow-Up: Independent Pricing, Chain Attack: Hey, Didn't Expect That, Right?, or Ultimate: Oh, Time to Play?, it applies the Binding Trap effect for 15s. After applying Binding Trap, all units' Aftershock DMG against the target is increased by 30%.

mindscapes.name: Self-Interest
mindscapes.description: When dealing DMG to enemies affected by Binding Trap, increase own CRIT Rate by 10%.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"Self-interest is an instinct, but it can also be learned over time."
"How do you learn it?"
"Get burned a few times and you'll figure it out."

mindscapes.name: Opportunistic
mindscapes.description: While in the Hunter's Gait state from Core Passive: Hunter's Instinct, Pulchra's ATK is increased by an additional 10%.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"A mercenary's most valuable trait isn't loyalty - it's knowing when an opportunity appears. Picking the right employer, taking the right commissions, doing what's required, and never signing long-term contracts. Then even if you switch sides to work for the competition, your former employer can't say a thing."
"Pulchra, someone else came looking for trouble just now. I sent them packing. How did you manage to make so many enemies?"
"Too many people let their emotions get the better of them. See? That's why they're all just losers who don't know their own lack of worth."

mindscapes.name: Territorial
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
There's a large note posted on the door of Pulchra's car. Written in big red letters: THIS IS MY TURF! KNOCK BEFORE ENTERING! KNOCK! KNOCK!
Below it, there's a slightly smaller note with big black letters that reads: Caesar, you'd better pay for breaking my lock! 100,000 Dennies!
Under the black letters, there's a crooked line of small text: I asked Proxy, lock's only worth 20,000!

mindscapes.name: Joy of the Hunt
mindscapes.description: Reduces Energy Cost of activating EX Special Attack: Rending Claw - Flashstep by 5.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"What's the point of challenging strong opponents? I'm not a masochist. For me, the real joy of the hunt comes when I know I'm gonna win!"
5 minutes later...
"Man, this game's AI is way too weak. Boring."

mindscapes.name: Tail Game
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
Pulchra's earliest blurry childhood memory was of a warm, big tail. When she first learned to crawl, she loved to chase after it.
"And then what?"
"They tell me it was my own tail."
But Pulchra knew it wasn't hers. Aside from the tail game, at night, it would wrap tightly around her, keeping her warm through each cold night. Maybe the Hollow took it, or maybe something else... But it doesn't matter - she stopped playing that game long ago.

mindscapes.name: Behind the Mask
mindscapes.description: Special Attack: Rending Claw - Nightmare Shadow's DMG is increased by 15%, and the number of times the repeated attack can trigger is increased by 2. Additional Ability: Business Partner's Binding Trap effect now also applies to all damage types, not just Aftershock DMG.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
The respirator mask blocks out Ether particles and pollen, and shields her from curious, fearful, or malicious gazes — but it makes it impossible to curl up and get a good night's sleep. How she longs to find a warm place and take a carefree afternoon nap...
The car door suddenly swings open without warning. Startled awake, she instantly grabs her old partner and straps it to her face. "Would it kill you to knock?!"
...Ah, right. She can actually take it off now.

profile.details:
Vivian is a member of Mockingbird, skilled in gathering all kinds of intel. She's also a jack of many trades — cooking, mixology, translation, art forgery, electronics repair, and more.
In the past, she apparently wandered without a home and was viewed as one who "brought disaster," almost like a living omen of bad luck.
It's said she can predict incoming misfortune through her tears, though there's no scientific proof of this ability.
A loyal follower of Phaethon. Ever since your original account went inactive on Inter-Knot, she's been trying to track you down — digging for clues, running intense searches across the network. However, Master, she didn't find anything... all thanks to my efforts in keeping your cybersecurity airtight.
Suggestion: Until her true intentions are clear, do not reveal your identity as Phaethon.
In case you've already let your identity slip, be sure to lock your doors and wear proper sleepwear before going to bed. Based on her old blog posts, she's likely to express her admiration in... overly passionate and intense ways.
profile.details2:
As a child, Vivian was adopted by a man named Landon, a member of the Exaltists, and became close friends with a girl named Dina.
After Landon's crimes were exposed, Dina continued to defend her father, while Vivian broke away from the Exaltists and cut ties with her.
Vivian fell into despair for a while, hitting rock bottom — until you responded to one of her messages. That single reply gave her the hope to start trying again.
Out of respect for Vivian's wishes, I cannot tell you which message it was.
I may not fully understand human emotions, but I am certain you gave her hope and comfort when she needed it most.

skins.name: Fluttering Violet
skins.description: Maintain your elegance, Miss Vivian, from the point of your parasol, right down to your flowing skirt. Maintain your courage, Miss Vivian, through last night's lonely walk, or here today at my side.

skins.name: Iris of the Shore
skins.description: Birds soar into the starlit skies, while irises bloom by the pond. Though this enchanting moonlit night may be brief, please let me see the lingering anticipation in your eyes in the moment I bloom.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Feathered Strike
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
Unleashes up to four attacks in front, dealing Physical DMG and Ether DMG.
After triggering the fourth attack, enter the Noblewoman state.
With Flight Feathers available, holding during the fourth attack will activate the Fluttering Frock state.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Noblewoman - Waltz
descriptions.description:
Press while in the Noblewoman state to activate:
Dash forward with an attack that deals Ether DMG and restores 1 Flight Feather upon hitting an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
If a Perfect Dodge is triggered during the dash, gain 1 additional Flight Feather.
If Flight Feathers are available after the skill, enter the Fluttering Frock state, which can be canceled by holding when the skill is used.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Fluttering Frock - Suspension
descriptions.description:
Press while in the Fluttering Frock state to activate:
Attack an area ahead, dealing Ether DMG.
After activation, this skill consumes all Flight Feathers, and each one consumed grants 1 Guard Feather.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
When switching characters during the Fluttering Frock state, Vivian will automatically perform Basic Attack: Fluttering Frock - Suspension.
While in the Fluttering Frock state, press to exit the state.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Featherbloom
descriptions.description:
After any squad member hits a target with an EX Special Attack, Vivian will consume 1 Guard Feather to launch Basic Attack: Featherbloom against the target, dealing Ether DMG, triggering at most once per use of a skill. This effect can trigger even while Vivian is off-field.
A maximum of 5 Guard Feathers can be stored.

descriptions.name: Dodge: Lightstream
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: Silver Thorned Melody
descriptions.description:
Press during a dodge to activate:
Launches a forward thrust at enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.

descriptions.name: Dodge Counter: Wingblade Reverb
descriptions.description:
Press during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Launches an attack on enemies ahead, dealing Physical DMG and Ether DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After activating the skill, enter the Noblewoman state.
When there are Flight Feathers available, hold during skill activation to enter the Fluttering Frock state.

descriptions.name: Dodge: Dainty Steps
descriptions.description:
When in the Noblewoman state and about to be attacked, an automatic dodge will trigger, during which the character will be Invulnerable, but a Perfect Dodge will not be triggered.
This can trigger once each time the Noblewoman state is entered.

descriptions.name: Quick Assist: Frostwing Guard
descriptions.description:
When the active character is launched, press to activate:
Launches an attack on enemies ahead, dealing Physical DMG and Ether DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After the skill activates, enter the Noblewoman state.
With Flight Feathers available, hold during skill activation to enter the Fluttering Frock state.

descriptions.name: Defensive Assist: Silver Umbrella Formation
descriptions.description:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Assist Follow-Up: Featherblade Execution
descriptions.description:
Press after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Launch an attack at enemies ahead, dealing Ether DMG and gaining 2 Flight Feathers.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After the skill activates enter the Fluttering Frock state, which can be canceled by holding during the skill.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Song of Silver Wings
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
Quickly attack forward, dealing Physical DMG and Ether DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Violet Requiem
descriptions.description:
With enough Energy, press to activate:
Unleash a powerful forward attack that deals massive Ether DMG and grants 3 Flight Feathers.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Enter the Fluttering Frock state after using the skill. Hold during the skill to enter the Noblewoman state.

descriptions.name: Chain Attack: Chorus of Celestial Wings
descriptions.description:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Launch a powerful attack on a large area of enemies ahead, dealing massive Ether DMG and gaining 2 Flight Feathers.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After the skill activates, enter the Fluttering Frock state, which can be canceled by holding during the skill.

descriptions.name: Ultimate: Soaring Bird's Song
descriptions.description:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate:
Launch a powerful attack on a large area of enemies ahead, dealing massive Ether DMG and gaining 5 Flight Feathers.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After the skill is activated, enter the Fluttering Frock state, which can be canceled by holding during the skill.

skills.name: Core Passive: Dirge of Destiny
skills.description:
When Basic Attack: Featherbloom hits a target that is suffering from an Ether, Electric, Fire, Physical, or Ice Anomaly, it will trigger Abloom, dealing additional Attribute Anomaly DMG. The additional DMG is 3.07%/1.6%/4%/0.37%/0.54% per 10 points of Anomaly Proficiency of the original Anomaly DMG.
When Basic Attack: Fluttering Frock - Suspension or Basic Attack: Featherbloom hits a target suffering any Attribute Anomaly, it will inflict Vivian's Prophecy, causing the target to take Ether DMG equal to 55% of Vivian's ATK every 0.55s. This DMG can trigger additional DMG from Attribute Anomalies. Vivian's Prophecy ends when the target is no longer suffering an Attribute Anomaly.
When entering the battlefield, Vivian gains 2 Flight Feathers.

skills.name: Additional Ability: Prophetic Tears
skills.description:
When another character in your squad is an Anomaly character or shares the same attribute:
Whenever another squad member applies an Attribute Anomaly to an enemy, Vivian will consume 1 Guard Feather to launch Basic Attack: Featherbloom on the target. This can trigger once every 0.5s.
Corruption DMG dealt by all squad members and the Corruption status' Disorder DMG increases by 12%.

mindscapes.name: "Walking Into the Orchard in Spring"
mindscapes.description: When a total of 4 Guard Feathers are consumed, gain 1 Flight Feather. All Attribute Anomaly DMG and Disorder DMG received by targets under Vivian's Prophecy increases by 16%.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"Every morning is like our first encounter, every night a reunion."
She had once seen fate's fickleness, with the inevitable ending always tainted by tears.
She no longer wishes to be the prophetic bird of disaster. She's willing to vanish in the fire, sleep in the light, and change your fate with all she has.
So, please don't close the window; the bird will bring you love and carry away death.

mindscapes.name: "Stormy Night, Stormy Night"
mindscapes.description: Vivian's Ether Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by 25%. The benefits of Abloom from Anomaly Proficiency are raised to 130% of the original value, and 15% of the target's All-Attribute RES is ignored.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"If I had never seen the sun, I could have endured the darkness."
The word "savior" feels too heavy, and "good person" seems too light.
So, perhaps it's better to say, you were once her boatman.
In that storm called malice and self-regret, you were a ray of light, guiding her through the flood.
From that moment on, she could no longer bear the curse or the nightmares. She set out on a journey to find you.

mindscapes.name: "Another and the Same"
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"We measure each other's shadows with the dusk, discovering they completely overlap."
In countless dusks you were unaware of, she watched the same sun set with you, turning the sea into a beautiful warmth.
Amid countless diverging paths, she resolutely chose the one that led to your side.
And today, she finally stands with her shadow overlapping yours.
And today, the sunset remains unchanged.

mindscapes.name: "The Wind Between the Reeds"
mindscapes.description:
Basic Attack: Fluttering Frock - Suspension and Basic Attack: Featherbloom will always CRIT on hit, and they will also increase Vivian's ATK by 12% for 12s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
When entering the battlefield, Vivian immediately gains 5 Guard Feathers.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"I will lay my true heart, like moonlight, to cover the path beneath your feet."
In chasing after you, she has already formed her own sky.
She is not one of vast love, nor does she have much.
But for you, only for you, she can spill moonlight, cover the darkness, and repair the fractures.
You are her only generosity, her greatest bravery.

mindscapes.name: "Sonnet"
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"Shall I compare thee to a summer's day?"
She is like a bird, flying from late autumn with excitement and anticipation, her wings sweeping across the winter snow. In the spring, she picks a flower and flies straight into the scorching sun of summer.
All because your eyes hide a thousand suns, she loves the fierce sunlight and fears no frost.

mindscapes.name: "Vivian"
mindscapes.description: Vivian's Ether DMG increases by 40%. When triggering a Perfect Dodge during Basic Attack: Noblewoman - Waltz's dash, or using EX Special Attack: Violet Requiem, gain 1 additional Flight Feather. Launching Basic Attack: Fluttering Frock - Suspension consumes all Guard Feathers, the downward attack's area of effect increases, and upon hit, triggers a special instance of Abloom. Each additional Guard Feather consumed will increase the proportion of additional Anomaly DMG dealt by that instance of Abloom, consuming a maximum of 5 Guard Feathers to increase the DMG up to a maximum of 5 times the original.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"Vivian is a love poem written only for you."
"We have all the time in the world."
"So, please allow me to write the rest of my life as your footnotes."

profile.details:
Seth, a rookie officer in the Public Security Criminal Investigation Special Response Team, is a key player in providing fire support during criminal investigations.
He graduated at the top of his class in the academy and could have landed a higher position, but he chose the tougher path of the Special Response Team.
His impressive profile makes him seem like a genius, but he's actually a hard worker who has had his own struggles. There have been times when he practiced the subjects he wasn't good at until he cried.
Seth is quite smart, but his personality often leads to him being taken advantage of by cunning criminals, or sometimes, coworkers (?).
The subject he's worst at is infiltration. Rumor has it that he holds the academy record for "fastest to get busted" in infiltration tasks. Based on the video intel we have, he seems a bit slow to catch on. For instance, when someone is being sarcastic, it takes him a long time to realize it.
profile.details2:
The profile shows that Seth has an older brother who holds a higher position in Public Security.
To some, Seth is a rookie riding on family connections within Public Security, but he got in on his own merit and has nothing to do with his brother's influence.
Currently, they are not on good terms. When they encounter each other at work, they pretend not to know one another.
Seth views his brother as a rival he must surpass, and is working hard to achieve that goal.
profile.aptitude:
HIA License Archive:
Public Security Patrol Officer, Seth, Ether aptitude is classified. He's allowed to perform basic tasks like conducting investigations and extracting resources in known Hollows within the city (including Companion Hollows).
Note: (Omitted clearance-related details) As a Lynx Thiren, Seth has excellent Ether aptitude.

skins.description: He may be slow to pick up on things, slower even than the weight of the shield in his left hand, but his ability to detect evil is keener than the baton in his right.

When Seth's Chain Attack: Final Judgment or Finishing Move during Basic Attack: Lightning Strike - Electrified hits an enemy, the target's Anomaly Buildup RES to all Attributes is reduced by 20%, lasting 20s.

skills.name: Core Passive: Protector
skills.description: When Seth uses EX Special Attack: Thunder Shield Rush - High Voltage, he gains a Shield of Firm Resolve equal to 80% of his initial ATK, up to a max of 3,000 points, and lasting 25s. This effect can trigger once every 10s. When Basic Attack: Lightning Strike - Electrified or Assist Follow-Up: Public Security Ruling triggers a Quick Assist or Chain Attack, causing another squad member to enter the field, that squad member gains a Shield of Firm Resolve equal to 80% of Seth's initial ATK, up to a max of 3,000 points, and lasting 25s. This effect can trigger once every 10s. Having a Shield of Firm Resolve increases Anomaly Proficiency by 100.

skills.name: Additional Ability: High Spirit
skills.description:
When another character in your squad shares the same Attribute or Faction:
When Seth's Chain Attack: Final Judgment or Finishing Move during Basic Attack: Lightning Strike - Electrified hits an enemy, the target's Anomaly Buildup RES to all Attributes is reduced by 20%, lasting 20s.

mindscapes.name: Heroism
mindscapes.description: The shield value provided by Shield of Firm Resolve and its maximum limit is increased by 30%. When Shield of Firm Resolve ends, the Anomaly Proficiency increase provided by Core Passive: Protector lasts an additional 10s.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
When it comes to team missions, Seth is always leading the charge.
"Let me handle the arrests! I scored a 99 in close-quarters arrests, and the only point deducted was because I accidentally sprained the instructor's wrist."

mindscapes.name: Recklessness of Youth
mindscapes.description: Upon entering battle, Seth immediately gains 75% Resolve. Hitting an enemy with Basic Attack: Lightning Strike - Electrified increases the move's accumulated Electric Anomaly Buildup by 35%.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
Many criminals make the mistake of underestimating Seth.
It might be his pure, clear eyes or those innocent-looking furry ears and tail. Whatever the reason, everyone who underestimates him eventually pays the price.

mindscapes.name: Slow Reflexes
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"A skilled officer like you must handle everything on your own, right? No help from others, surely?"
Even after hearing this, Seth remained composed and didn't say a word.
It wasn't until midnight that he suddenly woke up: "Could that guy's comment earlier... have been a dig at me?"

mindscapes.name: Core Aspiration
mindscapes.description: The Daze caused by Defensive Assist: Thundershield is increased by 25%.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"Put aside your foolish notions of good and evil. You can't protect everyone. Sometimes, you have to make a choice."
"This is my choice, and it's the core responsibility of an officer — you're the one who has changed, Brother."

mindscapes.name: Distant Admiration
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
Seth used to deeply admire and respect his older brother. But as you know, "admiration" is the furthest thing from "understanding."
"Someday, I'll become the finest officer... and make him eat his words!"

mindscapes.name: Idealist
mindscapes.description: When Seth lands a Finishing Move on an enemy with Basic Attack: Lightning Strike - Electrified, it deals additional damage equal to 500% of his ATK. The attack is guaranteed to trigger a critical hit, and CRIT DMG is increased by 60%.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
To a young person, everything is clear-cut, with a stark contrast between black and white, right and wrong.
There will always be someone who tries to tell him that the world is a murky gray. But is a world where everything is clear-cut and distinct really not worth striving for?

profile.details:
Qingyi is a new officer in the Criminal Investigation Special Response Team.
As an artificial human, her personality is derived from ancient cultural texts from the old civilization. Her body, known as an "Automaton," is an intelligent construct composed of biological materials.
Recommended by White Star Institute, she was assigned to Public Security as a new officer partnered with Zhu Yuan.

Qingyi always exhibits an easygoing, laid-back demeanor, not restricted by rules.
In contrast to modern individuals affected by today's society, Qingyi frequently proposes unexpected solutions to problems.

Qingyi always carries a cup of hot water and takes occasional sips.
"Drinking hot water is good for your health."
Suggestion: Approaching Qingyi is also an ill-considered decision that may compromise your cover. Please remember your true identity as a Proxy.
profile.details2:
Qingyi's full name is officially designated as "01 Neo-Genesis VI."
This code is marked on a specific location of Qingyi's body, abbreviated as "01NG Ⅵ."
The researcher from White Star Institute who discovered her thought her code name looked like QING YI, so that's what he called her — Qingyi.
profile.aptitude:
Hollow Investigative Association Licensing Archive:
Public Security Officer: Qingyi. Ether aptitude confidential. Licensed for investigation, exploration, and other basic work in known Hollows (including Companion Hollows) in the city.
Note: Qingyi's file belongs to the New Eridu Public Security Janus Quarter Metropolitan Order Division Criminal Investigation Special Response Team. The relevant information can be obtained within the Public Security system, requiring special access permissions.
Further Note: As an intelligent construct, Qingyi demonstrates excellent Ether aptitude.

skins.description: Keep your teapot close and drink plenty of hot water — that's ancient wisdom passed down from the old civilization. But why would an intelligent construct drink tea? It must be for health purposes... right?

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Penultimate
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
Launch up to four strikes forward, dealing Physical DMG and Electric DMG.
During the 3rd hit, repeatedly press to continue the attack, continuously striking the enemy. Using Dodge during this period will not interrupt Qingyi's Basic Attack combo count.
During the 3rd hit, stop pressing to interrupt the continuous attack, transitioning automatically to the 4th hit. If the continuous attack lasts for a certain time, the 4th hit will be enhanced.
Anti-Interrupt Level is increased and DMG received is reduced by 40% during the 3rd and 4th hit.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Enchanted Blossoms
descriptions.description:
Hold to activate:
Launches a forward rush attack, dealing Electric DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Flash Connect
descriptions.description: When Qingyi deals Electric DMG with a skill, she accumulates Flash Connect Voltage. When Flash Connect Voltage reaches 75%, she will enter the Flash Connect state. When using her Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms, Qingyi will consume all Flash Connect Voltage and exit the Flash Connect state. For every 1% of Flash Connect Voltage consumed over 75%, her Damage and Daze inflicted by this skill will be increased by 1%/0.5%. Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms itself does not accumulate Flash Connect Voltage.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms
descriptions.description:
During the Flash Connect state, hold to activate:
Launch five consecutive forward rush attacks, then execute a Finishing Move that inflicts massive Electric DMG. Release during the move to trigger the Finishing Move early.
Activate the Finishing Move just before the character is attacked to trigger Perfect Dodge.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased and DMG received is reduced by 40% during the rush attack. Qingyi is invulnerable during the Finishing Move.

descriptions.name: Dodge: Swan Song
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: Breach
descriptions.description:
Press during a Dodge to activate:
Rush forward and then launch an upward attack, dealing Physical DMG.

descriptions.name: Dodge Counter: Lingering Sentiments
descriptions.description:
Press during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Leap into the air and then perform a downward attack, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Quick Assist: Wind Through the Pines
descriptions.description:
When the active character is launched, press to activate:
Leap into the air and perform a downward attack, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Defensive Assist: Graceful Embellishment
descriptions.description:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of Assist Points when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Assist Follow-Up: Song of the Clear River
descriptions.description:
Press after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Rush forward with an attack and inject electrical energy into the ground, then pull back to trigger an explosion, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Sunlit Glory
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
Quickly swings upward, followed by a downward smash, dealing Electric DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Moonlit Begonia
descriptions.description:
With enough Energy, press to activate:
Quickly swings upward and leaps into the air, turning around to launch a series of attacks, then follows up with a powerful downward smash, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Hold to consume additional energy to increase the number of hits of the series of attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After executing the move, you can immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of a Basic Attack.

descriptions.name: Chain Attack: Tranquil Serenade
descriptions.description:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Launch a series of powerful strikes over a large area in front, dealing massive Electric DMG
When this attack hits an enemy, the skill's DMG increases by 3% for every stack of Subjugation in Core Passive: Eternal Seasons the target has.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Ultimate: Eight Sounds of Ganzhou
descriptions.description:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate:
Launch a series of powerful strikes over a large area in front, followed by a Finishing Move, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Core Passive: Eternal Seasons
skills.description: When Qingyi lands a Finishing Move on an enemy with her Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms, it applies 5 stacks of Subjugation to the enemy, stacking up to 20 times. Each stack of Subjugation increases the target's Stun DMG Multiplier by 2%. For each rush attack performed during Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms, the Finishing Move will apply 1 extra stack of Subjugation. If Perfect Dodge is triggered when using the Finishing Move, it directly applies {0} stacks of Subjugation. When applying Subjugation to normal and elite enemies, the target receives double the stacks. When the target recovers from being Stunned, the corresponding stacks of Subjugation are reset.
