mindscapes.name: Insulation Breakdown
mindscapes.description: When Qingyi enters combat, Flash Connect Voltage is instantly restored to its maximum, and the accumulation rate is increased by 30%. When using her Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms, if Flash Connect Voltage is at its maximum, the attack will reduce the DEF of the enemy it hits by 15%, and Qingyi's CRIT Rate against that enemy will increase by 20% for 15s.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"While there will be no threat to your life, we kindly request you do not resist arrest..."
The direction and intensity of the current have been precisely calculated to ensure that every suspect receives a safe electric shock experience.

mindscapes.name: Minimal Effort, Maximum Impact
mindscapes.description: The Stun DMG Multiplier increase provided by each stack of Subjugation in Core Passive: Eternal Seasons increases to 135% of its original value. When Qingyi's attack hits an enemy and the stacks of Subjugation she applies reaches its maximum stacks, her Daze dealt to the target increases by 15%.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
An ancient combat technique mentioned in old civillization texts. It seems to have started as a martial arts technique, rather than a staff technique.
"Don't be so constrained, the arm itself can be used like a three-section staff, mhm."

mindscapes.name: Drink Hot Water
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"Young people should be mindful their health, and drinking more hot water is a good start."
Qingyi always appears comforted when she drinks from her flask. But be careful if she offers you a drink—
"Even 100-degree Celsius boiling water doesn't faze her..." One Public Security Officer who encountered this left such a note.

mindscapes.name: Stable Arc Barrier
mindscapes.description: Upon entering or exiting Flash Connect state, gain a shield equal to 10% of Qingyi's Max HP. If a previous shield is still active when the shield effect refreshes, Qingyi generates 5 Energy. This Energy Generation effect can be triggered once every 10s.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
By reverse-engineering Automatons from the old civilization, the White Star Institute developed the Arc Barrier, a technology that combines defense, attack, and electrical energy conversion.
"As the saying goes: Water can float a boat or sink it. Physics has a saying: Electric current flows like water. Therefore: Electric current can be used both offensively and defensively. It's a fantastic combination."

mindscapes.name: Youthful Spirit
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"Great, young people should be courageous and try new things. Keep it up!"
It sometimes feels like Qingyi's encouragement is lazy and teasing, but if you really get into trouble, just rely on her.
After all, she's been around for centuries and can handle anything.

mindscapes.name: Eight Meridians
mindscapes.description: The Interrupt Level of Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms is greatly increased, and the CRIT DMG is increased by an additional 100%. When Qingyi hits an enemy with her Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms, the target's Attribute DMG RES is reduced by 20% for 15s.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
A theory about the human circulatory system documented in ancient texts from the old civilization. It's said those who fully master this theory can instantly disable an opponent in a fight.
"How about trying the pressure points that cause itching next time? Who should be the guinea pig? Manager? Or Zhu Yuan?"

profile.details:
Zhu Yuan, an exceptional officer at Public Security, is a highly skilled individual expected to become the next commissioner. She currently leads the Criminal Investigation Special Response Team at the Janus Precinct within the Metropolitan Order Division. Her team members include Qingyi, Seth, and [redacted].
Note: For documents with higher security levels within the Public Security system, further investigation is required; scheduling priority - low.

Zhu Yuan possesses excellent skills in criminal investigation, combat, and self-management (including working overtime). She has no unresolved cases on record.
Suggestion: Approaching Zhu Yuan is an ill-advised decision that may compromise your cover. Always remember your true identity as a Proxy. Remember your true identity as a Proxy. Remember your true identity as a Proxy.
profile.details2:
She has a tendency to be a perfectionist and exhibits a strong obsession with "neatness" and "perfection," which may be considered her only weakness (?). Officer Qingyi, her mentor in life and subordinate at work, often remarks that Zhu Yuan's perfectionism complex will worsen unless someone can talk her out of it. However, due to her high standards for herself, she has gained ample experience and skills to lead the Criminal Investigation Special Response Team and attract exceptional talents.

Zhu Yuan seems to have a passion for gardening. She is currently growing a tomato plant in her office, which is often pilfered by a raccoon family residing near the Public Security office.
Thoughts: Could this provide a potential avenue for infiltrating Public Security?

Zhu Yuan is a rarity among humans, showing no particular fondness for small furry animals.

skins.description:
This high-grade anti-riot uniform from Public Security has been specially modified to suit Zhu Yuan's fighting style.
Winner of the Janus Precinct's combat tournament three years running, the young top Public Security Officer is on call 24/7, ready to arrest any criminal in her path.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Don't Move!
descriptions.description:
[Assault Mode]
Press to activate.
Unleash a flurry of martial arts, bullets, and Ether Buckshots in a series of up to 5 attacks, dealing Physical DMG and Ether DMG.
When the 4th or 5th hit strikes an enemy, obtain 1 Enhanced Shotshell per hit. A max of 1 can be obtained per activation of this Basic Attack.
While using this skill, drag the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} and press to activate Dash Attack: Firepower Offensive and readjust to face the selected direction.
While under Assault Mode, hold to switch to Suppressive Mode.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Please Do Not Resist
descriptions.description:
[Suppressive Mode]
Hold to activate:
Unleash up to 3 Shotshell piercing attacks, dealing Physical DMG. If Zhu Yuan has Enhanced Shotshells upon firing, 1 Enhanced Shotshell will be consumed, dealing massive Ether DMG.
While using this skill, drag the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} to activate her Dash Attack: Overwhelming Firepower and readjust to face the selected direction.
While in Suppressive Mode, release to return to Assault Mode.

descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: Firepower Offensive
descriptions.description:
Assault Mode
Press during a dodge to activate:
Uses handgun to attack, dealing Ether DMG.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: Overwhelming Firepower
descriptions.description:
Suppressive Mode
Drag the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} during Basic Attack: Please Do Not Resist to activate:
Unleashes a Shotshell piercing attack, dealing Physical DMG. If Zhu Yuan has Enhanced Shotshells when firing, 1 Enhanced Shotshell will be consumed, dealing massive Ether DMG.

descriptions.name: Dodge Counter: Fire Blast
descriptions.description:
Press during a Perfect Dodge to activate.
Shoots enemies in front with an Ether Buckshot, dealing Ether DMG.
Gain 1 Enhanced Shotshell on skill use.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Dodges the enemy's attack and activates Vital View.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Assist Follow-Up: Defensive Counter
descriptions.description:
Press after an Evasive Assist to activate:
Attack with a combination of martial arts and shotshells, dealing Physical DMG and Ether DMG.
Upon activation, gain 3 Enhanced Shotshells.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Buckshot Blast
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
Shoots Ether Buckshots that deal Ether DMG. This can be repeated 3 times by repeatedly pressing .
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

descriptions.description:
With enough Energy, press to activate:
Shoots a series of Ether Buckshots, that explode and deal massive Ether DMG.
Upon activation, gain 3 Enhanced Shotshells.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

When another character in your squad is a Support character or shares the same Faction:
Zhu Yuan's CRIT Rate is increased by 30% for 10s after using an EX Special Attack, Chain Attack, or Ultimate.

skills.name: Core Passive: Special Ops Ammunition
skills.description: When Zhu Yuan is under Suppressive Mode, using Enhanced Shotshells increases her DMG by 40%. When attacking Stunned enemies, this DMG buff is increased by an additional 40%. When Zhu Yuan enters the battlefield, she immediately gains 6 Enhanced Shotshells.

skills.name: Additional Ability: Tactical Coordination
skills.description:
When another character in your squad is a Support character or shares the same Faction:
Zhu Yuan's CRIT Rate is increased by 30% for 10s after using an EX Special Attack, Chain Attack, or Ultimate.

mindscapes.name: Quick Reload
mindscapes.description: When Zhu Yuan activates Chain Attacks/Ultimates, gain the Quick Reload effect. When Zhu Yuan has the Quick Reload effect and uses up all Enhanced Shotshells, the Quick Reload effect will be consumed to instantly gain 6/9 Enhanced Shotshells.
mindscapes.flavorDesc: Zhu Yuan once competed in the Janus Quarter's Public Security Officer Contest, clinching first place with her extraordinary reloading techniques. Her colleague commented: "It's nothing but sheer practice."

mindscapes.name: Ether Ember
mindscapes.description: In Suppressive Mode, Zhu Yuan's Anti-Interrupt level is increased and DMG taken reduced by 10%. When Zhu Yuan hits an enemy with Enhanced Shotshells, deal 10% more Basic Attack: Please Do Not Resist and Dash Attack: Overwhelming Firepower Ether DMG, stacking up to 5 times and lasting for 5s. Each shot adds one stack of this effect, and repeated triggers reset the duration.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
Zhu Yuan is equipped with Ether bullets specially designed by Public Security, which cause irreversible corruption upon hitting the enemy.
This is why Zhu Yuan always warns her enemies to surrender and stop resisting before she fires. It really is for their own health and safety...

mindscapes.name: Public Security Special Training
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc: As an elite Public Security Officer, Zhu Yuan's training focused on a single objective: to enhance all aspects of her combat abilities within the Hollow, ensuring she could outmatch any criminal.

mindscapes.name: Ether Perforation
mindscapes.description: When Zhu Yuan hits an enemy with Enhanced Shotshells, her Basic Attack: Please Do Not Resist and Dash Attack: Overwhelming Firepower ignore 25% of the target's Ether RES.
mindscapes.flavorDesc: When in battle, the gangs in the Hollows often try to quietly calculate how many bullets their enemies have left. What they don't know is that Zhu Yuan's custom magazine can recharge itself with the Ether in the air...

mindscapes.name: Special Ops Experience
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc: A seasoned Public Security Officer excels at reading the battlefield, striking precisely and maximizing combat efficiency. Sometimes, one stern look is enough to make her enemies think twice about putting up a fight.

mindscapes.name: Expanded Energy Pack III
mindscapes.description: When Zhu Yuan consumes a total of 12 Enhanced Shotshells, she receives the Ether Afterglow effect, and the Energy cost of the next EX Special Attack is reduced by 30. Launching an EX Special Attack will consume Ether Afterglow and shoot an additional 4-bullet Ether Buckshot. Each extra bullet deals DMG equal to 220% of Zhu Yuan's ATK.
mindscapes.flavorDesc: Zhu Yuan often worries about her gear's remaining battery, getting nervous when the power dips into the red zone and consciously saving power. Public Security finally equipped her with an energy pack that offered both high capacity and long-lasting endurance.

profile.details:
Rina, the head maid of Victoria Housekeeping Co., and the most senior member of the organization.
She possesses beauty and grace, appearing immaculate from head to toe, with a noble demeanor and a gentle smile on her face.
She places considerable importance on how she is perceived by others.

Rina is always accompanied by two Bangboo named Anastella (brown hair) and Drusilla (blonde hair), both of whom have distinct personalities.
Drusilla has been with Rina for a significant period of time and displays high intelligence, capable of discerning Rina's true emotions and thoughts.
Anastella, a recent addition, usually responds rather than initiates conversation and is frequently teased by Drusilla.

Rina's favorite hobby is cooking, but only a few individuals are capable of enduring the dishes she prepares.
Suggestion: You may try tasting Rina's dishes as a test to determine if you are the Chosen One.
profile.details2:
To protect her impeccable image, Rina maintains a professional and gracious demeanor even with the most challenging clients.
Drusilla, however, may occasionally express her true thoughts regardless of the situation.

* Rina's family holds significant influence within the industry, as all of its members have served as attendants or maids to some of the most prominent figures.
Lycaon learned some of his attendant skills from Rina.
profile.aptitude:
New Eridu Citizen Verification Profile:
Rina, possessing high Ether aptitude, is allowed to perform basic tasks like investigating and extracting resources in known Hollows within the city (including Companion Hollows).
Note: The floating Bangboo accompanying Rina also exhibit excellent Ether adaptability.

skins.description: Her skirt is immaculate and her appearance flawlessly composed — such is the head maid's standard of perfection. Yet in the kitchen, her definition of "perfect" appears to be something else entirely...

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Whack the Dimwit
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
Order Drusilla and Anastella to attack up to 4 times, dealing Physical DMG and Electric DMG.
Performing other actions with Rina during Drusilla and Anastella's attacks will not interrupt Rina's Basic Attack combo count.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Shoo the Fool
descriptions.description:
Hold or to activate:
Calls back Drusilla and Anastella to swing them around for a ranged attack, dealing Electric DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dodge: Dress Adjustment
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: Sudden Surprise
descriptions.description:
Press during a dodge to activate:
Order Drusilla and Anastella to execute a piercing attack, dealing Physical DMG.

descriptions.name: Dodge Counter: Bangboo Callback
descriptions.description:
Press during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Order Drusilla and Anastella to spin forward and trigger an explosion, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Quick Assist: Duple Meter Allemande
descriptions.description:
When the active character is launched, press to activate:
Order Drusilla and Anastella to spin forward and trigger an explosion, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Evasive Assist: Triple Meter Courante
descriptions.description:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press to activate:
Dodges the enemy's attack and activates Vital View.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Assist Follow-Up: Quadruple Meter Gavotte
descriptions.description:
Press after an Evasive Assist to activate:
Order Drusilla and Anastella to push forward and generate an electrical vortex, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Beat the Blockhead
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
Order Anastella to execute a downward smash, dealing Electric DMG
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Dimwit Disappearing Trick
descriptions.description:
With enough Energy, press to activate:
Order Drusilla and Anastella to execute multiple downward smashes, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.

descriptions.name: Chain Attack: Code of Conduct
descriptions.description:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Order Drusilla and Anastella to push forward and generate a ball-shaped electrical field that deals massive Electric DMG.
During this skill, Drusilla and Anastella are unable to perform Basic Attacks, Dash Attacks, Special Attacks, and EX Special Attacks, but can be recalled to Rina's side through Basic Attack: Shoo the Fool.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.

descriptions.name: Ultimate: The Queen's Attendants
descriptions.description:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate:
Order Drusilla and Anastella to spin forward, dealing massive Electric DMG.
During this skill, Drusilla and Anastella are unable to respond to Basic Attack, Dash Attack, Special Attack, or EX Special Attack commands, but can be recalled to Rina's side through Basic Attack: Shoo the Fool.
Upon activating this skill, the other squad members recover 10 Energy. The next character to switch in recovers an additional 20 Energy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.

mindscapes.description:
After being sent out to launch an attack, Drusilla and Anastella stay in place for an additional 5.5s before returning to Rina.
The effect gained from Core Passive: Mini Destruction Partner by characters within 10m is increased to 130% of the original value.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"Get your work done, or you're in for a beating!" is how Drusilla tries to encourage everyone.
"Yeah, a beating!" Anastella always chimes in.

mindscapes.name: Master's Paragon
mindscapes.description: Upon becoming the active character in combat, Rina's DMG increases by 15% for 12s. This effect can trigger once every 18s.
mindscapes.flavorDesc: "It takes an excellent head maid to lead excellent maids, and an exemplary master to raise exemplary Bangboo." — Excerpt from Rina's speech at the "Victoria Housekeeping Human Resource Management and Bangboo Training Insight Seminar."

mindscapes.name: Head Maid's Specialty
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
Rina always has the confidence to excel at anything and the ability to annihilate everything.
However, when it comes to being in the mood to annihilate enemies, both her confidence and capability align.

mindscapes.name: Needle and Hammer
mindscapes.description: Rina's Energy Regen increases by 0.5/s when both Drusilla and Anastella are deployed. The effect ends when Drusilla or Anastella returns to Rina.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
Drusilla and Anastella can never agree on anything.
"Beating up the dummy in front" is an exception.

mindscapes.name: Head Maid Perfectionist
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"Rina" means perfection in the Bangboo language.
Perfectionism is the number one rule in the Victoria Housekeeping handbook.
And Rina has her own criteria for judging "perfection."

mindscapes.name: Stormy Night's Fright
mindscapes.description: When an EX Special Attack, Chain Attack or Ultimate hits an enemy, the entire squad's Electric DMG is increased by 15% for 8s.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
Thunder rumbles in the old castle on a rainy night. The depths of the long corridors are filled with eerie shadows.
Fear circuits overloaded, the filming of a thriller commences.

profile.details:
Lighter, the Champion of the Sons of Calydon and an ex-mercenary.
In the Outer Ring, the Champion of a team refers to the one responsible for dealing with the opponent's strongest fighter in a gang fight, and they often need to participate in one-on-one duels. Their victory is crucial, as it brings glory and morale to the entire team.
"The Champion can perish, but cannot lose."

A red scarf is what identifies the Champion of the Sons of Calydon.
Even if the opponent doesn't know Lighter, they'll know who he is just from seeing that red scarf.

From what is currently known, Lighter is actually very low profile. He only steals the spotlight on the battlefield when he acts on his obligations as Champion.
Note: Lighter is the second Red Scarf of the Sons of Calydon. He teasingly refers to the previous Red Scarf as "Brother" or "predecessor."
profile.details2:
Lighter was once the leader of a mercenary troupe.
After a certain accident, Lighter disbanded his group of mercenaries and ended up in serious debt. Lighter chose to fight in an underground arena to pay back what he owed.
Later, Lighter was discovered by Big Daddy, who paid a huge sum to hire him to join the Sons of Calydon and take Billy's previous position.
profile.aptitude:
New Eridu Citizen Verification Profile:
Lighter, possessing high Ether aptitude, is allowed to perform basic tasks like investigating and extracting resources in known Hollows within the city (including Companion Hollows).
Note: There is a mental health counselling report among Lighter's records.

skins.description: The undefeated champion never takes off his sunglasses... or his scarf. Glory stopped mattering long ago, but the countless dusks shared with his companions are still worth waiting for.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: L-Form Thundering Fist
descriptions.description:
Press or hold to activate:
Perform up to five forward strikes, dealing Physical DMG and Fire DMG.
During the 3rd hit of the Basic Attack, drag the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick}, and repeatedly press or hold to unleash a series of melee follow-up attacks. Release the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} to follow up with the 4th hit of the Basic Attack.
While performing the startup light punch in the 5th hit of the Basic Attack, drag the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} and repeatedly press or hold to keep alternating between the light punch and 4th hit of the Basic Attack. Release the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} to follow up with the subsequent jab combo.
Continue repeatedly pressing or holding to extend the duration of the jab combo.
When you stop pressing or holding , or when the combo reaches its maximum duration, launches a Finishing Move forward. Lighter is invulnerable during the Finishing Move.
During the 5th hit of the Basic Attack, Lighter takes 40% less DMG.
While in the Morale Burst state, Anti-Interrupt Level is increased during the 5th hit of his Basic Attack, and the DMG reduction effect is increased to 80%.

descriptions.name: Dodge: Shadowed Slide
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Press while the character is attacking to activate:
Perform a quick shuffle dodge in the direction of the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#Joystick}.
This skill will not interrupt the combo count for Basic Attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: Charging Slam
descriptions.description:
Press during a dodge to activate:
Rapidly strikes enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.

descriptions.name: Dodge Counter: Blazing Flash
descriptions.description:
Press during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Strike enemies in front, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using the skill, press or hold to immediately follow up with the 5th hit of the Basic Attack.

descriptions.name: Quick Assist: Blazing Flash - Guard
descriptions.description:
When the active character is launched, press to activate:
Strike enemies in front, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using the skill, press or hold to immediately follow up with the 5th hit of the Basic Attack.

descriptions.name: Defensive Assist: Swift Break
descriptions.description:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Assist Follow-Up: Charging Slam - Stab
descriptions.description:
Press after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Strike enemies in front, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, press or hold to immediately follow up with the 5th hit of the Basic Attack.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: V-Form Sunrise Uppercut
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
Strikes enemies in front with an uppercut, dealing Fire DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.
Press during a shuffle dodge to activate:
Strike forward with a series of punches, dealing Fire DMG.
This skill will not interrupt the combo count for Basic Attacks.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: V-Form Sunrise Uppercut - Full Distance
descriptions.description:
With enough Energy, press to activate:
Strikes enemies in front with a powerful uppercut, leaping into the air and dealing massive Fire DMG.
During the move, press again to spend additional Energy to perform a powerful follow-up attack, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill
After using the move, press or hold to transition to the 4th hit of the Basic Attack.
During the shuffle dodge, with enough Energy, press to activate:
Perform a powerful combo punch forward, dealing massive Fire DMG. Using this skill will not break the combo count for Basic Attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After the attack, press or hold to immediately transition into the 5th hit of the Basic Attack.

descriptions.name: Chain Attack: V-Form Scorching Sun
descriptions.description:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a powerful strike at enemies in front in a small area, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Ultimate: W-Form Crowned Inferno
descriptions.description:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate:
Unleashes a powerful strike in a large area around, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Core Passive: Accelerant
skills.description:
Lighter automatically gains Morale over time, at a rate of 2.9 points per second. For each point of Energy consumed by any squad member, Lighter recovers an additional 0.26 Morale, up to a maximum of 100. When Morale reaches 80, the next time Lighter switches into battle he immediately launches a Quick Assist. Once Morale is 80 or higher, executing the 5th hit of his Basic Attack puts Lighter in the Morale Burst state, enhancing the power of the startup light punch, jab combo, and the Finishing Move of the 5th hit of his Basic Attack. When a skill hits an enemy with its power increased, it will continuously consume Morale. With every 10 points of Morale consumed, Lighter's Impact increases by 1%, up to a maximum increase of 10%, and lasting 6s.
In the Morale Burst state, Lighter will no longer automatically gain Morale over time. If his Morale is exhausted during a startup light punch or jab combo, he will automatically follow up with a more powerful Finishing Move.
In the Morale Burst state, when startup light punches or jab combos hit enemies, the target's Ice RES and Fire RES are reduced by 15%, lasting 30s.
In the Morale Burst state, when the Finishing Move hits an enemy, it applies the Collapse effect on the target, extending its Stunned duration by 3s. The Collapse effect can trigger only once on the same target before they recover from Stun.
When the Finishing Move of the 5th hit of his Basic Attack hits an enemy, when he switches off field, or when his Morale runs out, Lighter will leave the Morale Burst state, keeping any unspent Morale.

skills.name: Additional Ability: Fighting Spirit
skills.description:
When another character in your squad is an Attack character or shares the same Faction:
While under the Morale Burst state, when the 5th hit of Lighter's Basic Attack hits an enemy, all squad members gain a stack of Elation, stacking up to 20 times and lasting 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. For each stack of Elation, an Agent's Ice DMG and Fire DMG increase by 1.25%.
When obtaining Elation, if Lighter's Impact exceeds 170, every additional 10 points of Impact will increase the buff effect provided by each stack of Elation by an extra 0.25%. When any squad member launches a Chain Attack, it will refresh the duration of all squad members' Elation. Elation can increase the Ice DMG and Fire DMG of Agents by a maximum of 75%.

skills.description:
When another character in your squad is an Attack character or shares the same Faction:
While under the Morale Burst state, when the 5th hit of Lighter's Basic Attack hits an enemy, all squad members gain a stack of Elation, stacking up to 20 times and lasting 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. For each stack of Elation, an Agent's Ice DMG and Fire DMG increase by 1.25%.

mindscapes.name: The Champion
mindscapes.description: Among the debuffs imposed by Core Passive: Accelerant, the Collapse effect increases Stun duration by 5s, while further reducing Ice RES and Fire RES by 10%. The more powerful Finishing Move that follows when Lighter's Morale is completely exhausted during a startup light punch or jab combo deals 30% increased DMG.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
Victory for the champion is crucial. By facing off against the strongest fighter from the opposing side, he eliminates the threat to his leader — bringing an immense morale uplift to the team.
For him, only victory deserves recognition.
"The Champion cannot be defeated."

mindscapes.name: Red Scarf
mindscapes.description: When applying Collapse via Core Passive: Accelerant to enemies, the target's Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 25%. The increase to Ice DMG and Fire DMG provided by Elation from Additional Ability: Fighting Spirit increases to 120% of the original.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
As the "Red Scarf" of the Sons of Calydon, Lighter is quite famous in the Outer Ring, and not just because of his fists, but also due to... his unique way of speaking.
"I enjoy taking it easy... but you wouldn't manage without me, would you?"

mindscapes.name: Mercenary Leader
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc: "I'm probably the last person anyone should pick as their leader."

mindscapes.name: Sunglasses
mindscapes.description: When Lighter is off-field, the Energy Regen for the on-field character is increased by 10%. Upon entering the Morale Burst state, Lighter restores 4 Energy for off-field characters. This effect can trigger once every 18s.
mindscapes.flavorDesc: "You're asking why I wear sunglasses? Uh... it's because I get queasy at the sight of blood, I guess."

mindscapes.name: Decision Maker
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"Give me an order, and I'll carry it out. It's that simple."
Lighter adjusted his sunglasses with a carefree smile.
"Just don't put me in charge of making decisions."

mindscapes.name: Survivor
mindscapes.description: Lighter's Morale recovery efficiency is increased to 200% of its original value. When Lighter lands a heavy strike on enemies during a Basic Attack, Dodge Counter, Special Attack, EX Special Attack, Quick Assist, Assist Follow-Up, Chain Attack, or Ultimate, it will trigger the Blazing Impact effect, dealing 250% of ATK as Fire DMG. This effect can trigger once every 8s on each enemy. If Lighter's Impact exceeds 170 points, each additional point will further increase the multiplier of Blazing Impact by 5%, up to a maximum increase of 500%. The more powerful Finishing Move that follows when Lighter's Morale is completely exhausted during a light punch or jab combo will trigger an additional activation of Blazing Impact when hitting an enemy, ignoring the effect's cooldown.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
If given the chance to do it all over again, he would never opt to be the only survivor.
Unfortunately, fate is rarely a choice.

profile.details:
Orphie Magnusson serves in the New Eridu Defense Force's Obsidian Division, Obol Squad. She is the wielder of Magus, an Intelligent Construct in gun form.

Magus is the captain of Obol Squad. She was gravely injured during the fall of the old capital and on the brink of death. After taking part in a military research project, her consciousness was transferred into a weapon, allowing her to survive as an Intelligent Construct. Since the squad's formation, she has remained its heart and soul — hot-tempered and impulsive at times, yet deeply respected and trusted by her comrades.
Orphie shares an extraordinary bond with Magus — one that goes far beyond that of just "partners." The two have known each other for years, and Magus often acts like a mother, offering guidance and care. In return, Orphie does everything she can to meet Magus' expectations, aspiring to become a strong, independent soldier like her captain.

Strictly speaking, Orphie enjoys many things Magus disapproves of: fancy desserts, cute animals, and overly decorative toys. Her captain sees them as signs of softness, unfit for a soldier. Still, while Magus enforces discipline in public and imposes the expectations of a perfect soldier, she pretends to be in "sleep mode" just to turn a blind eye to Orphie's less-than-perfect behavior. According to this supposedly "strict and impartial" captain, she's simply following the parenting advice laid out in an online series titled "Raising a Child Prodigy."
profile.details2:
It may seem like Captain Magus is the one giving orders and calling the shots, but in truth, Orphie quietly keeps her in check in her own way.
They see each other as reflections of themselves, sharing certain vulnerabilities, though Magus tends to keep hers well concealed.

Note: Even so, you've already uncovered plenty of weaknesses Magus tried to keep hidden. Nothing escapes your keen eyes!

skins.description: A soul of mirrored halves, having twice crossed the river of the dead. One side forged in fire, the other shaped into ice; one looking back on where it came from, the other watching for a new dawn. They wander on — never lost, never ceasing.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: High-Pressure Flamethrower
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
Unleashes up to 5 attacks in front, followed by a powerful flame blade strike, dealing Physical DMG and Fire DMG.

descriptions.name: Dodge: Flickering Flames
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: Rush Command
descriptions.description:
Press during a dodge to activate:
Perform a quick forward attack, dealing Physical DMG.

descriptions.name: Dodge Counter: Counter Strike Opportunity
descriptions.description:
Press during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Launch a series of attacks on enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG and Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Quick Assist: Searing Slash
descriptions.description:
When the active character is launched, press to activate:
Unleash a series of attacks on enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG and Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Defensive Assist: Blazing Gunblade
descriptions.description:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Assist Follow-Up: Boiling Pierce
descriptions.description:
Press after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Unleash multiple attacks against enemies in front, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Blazing Chamber
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
Thrust forward and perform a tail attack, dealing Fire DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Corrosive Flash
descriptions.description:
Automatically triggers during ally attacks:
Unleashes 4 laser Aftershock attacks, dealing Fire DMG.
Triggers once per 5s.
Upon activating this skill, restore 20 Bottled Heat.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Watch Your Step
descriptions.description:
With enough Energy, press to activate:
Perform a sweeping laser attack forward, dealing Fire DMG.
After using this skill, immediately follow up with the powerful fire blade from the Basic Attack.
Upon activating this skill, restore 20 Bottled Heat.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Crimson Vortex
descriptions.description:
When off-field with 60 or more Energy, automatically triggers during ally attacks:
Performs a sweeping laser attack in an area around, dealing Fire DMG.
Upon activating this skill, restore 20 Bottled Heat.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Heat Charge
descriptions.description:
When Bottled Heat is greater than or equal to 100, hold to activate:
Consume 100 Bottled Heat to continuously fire a laser forward, dealing Fire DMG.
When firing begins, triggers Quick Assist.
After continuous firing for a period, firepower increases, greatly boosting the skill's Interrupt Level.
When attacked during firing, will parry enemy attacks and immediately increase firepower.
When maximum firing duration is reached, automatically activates EX Special Attack: Fiery Eruption.
During the low firepower phase, Anti-Interrupt Level increases and DMG taken is reduced by 40%, while character is invulnerable during the high firepower phase.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Fiery Eruption
descriptions.description:
Automatically activates after EX Special Attack: Heat Charge reaches maximum firing time:
Performs a spinning attack forward, then fires a laser ahead dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Chain Attack: Overheated Barrel
descriptions.description:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Perform a spinning attack forward, then fire a laser ahead, dealing Fire DMG.
Upon activating this skill, restore 20 points of Bottled Heat.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Ultimate: Dance With Fire
descriptions.description:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate:
Perform a spinning attack forward, then fire a laser ahead, dealing Fire DMG.
When leaping into the air, a Quick Assist will be triggered. If the Quick Assist is activated, Orphie & Magus will extend the laser firing duration.
Upon activating this skill, recover 20 Bottled Heat.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Core Passive: Taming Wind and Fire
skills.description:
Orphie & Magus's CRIT Rate increases by 12.5%, and Aftershock DMG increases by 42.5%.
Orphie & Magus initially gain 100 Bottled Heat, up to a maximum of 125.
When Orphie & Magus are off-field, if Special Attack: Corrosive Flash is available and Energy is greater than or equal to 60, consume 30 Energy to automatically trigger EX Special Attack: Crimson Vortex instead.
When the laser from EX Special Attack: Heat Charge hits enemies, all squad members gain Zeroed In for 12s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Zeroed In increases Agent ATK by 130. When Orphie & Magus's initial Energy Regen is greater than or equal to 1.6, for every 0.1 initial Energy Regen above this threshold, ATK increases by an additional 20. The total increase from both initial and additional ATK increases cannot exceed 340. When an Agent with Zeroed In triggers Aftershock, their Zeroed In duration extends by 4s, up to a maximum extension of 20s.
The fire blade attack from Basic Attack: High-Pressure Flamethrower, EX Special Attack: Watch Your Step, EX Special Attack: Crimson Vortex, EX Special Attack: Heat Charge, EX Special Attack: Fiery Eruption, Chain Attack: Overheated Barrel, and Ultimate: Dance With Fire all count as Aftershock DMG, and using these skills counts as triggering Aftershock.

mindscapes.name: Luxurious Cat House
mindscapes.description: Orphie & Magus' Special Attack: Corrosive Flash, EX Special Attack: Crimson Vortex, EX Special Attack: Heat Charge, and EX Special Attack: Fiery Eruption ignore 15% of target's Fire RES, and Agents with Zeroed In deal 20% increased DMG.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
The corners of Orphie's room are filled with all sorts of cat supplies: a cat tree for climbing, a soft cushion, a scratching post that won't break, and carefully selected toys...
"I'm always worried about finding a sick, homeless cat near the outpost... If I have these things ready in advance, it'll be easier for them to stay here..."
"Though we can't keep cats in the camp... I'll definitely find a kind owner for them within the captain's deadline!"
"But Orphie, those things have been in the dorm for three years, and you still haven't found such a cat!"

mindscapes.name: Weird Food List
mindscapes.description: When Orphie & Magus launch an Aftershock, restore 65 Decibels. This effect can trigger once every 4s. After Orphie & Magus use their Ultimate, their ATK increases by 20% for up to 45s.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
Sea grape popcorn, sakura peach seafood porridge, spicy strawberry braised tofu... Orphie sometimes tries foods with bizarre flavors, all chaotically listed on the list at the corner of her desk.
"While tasty food is tempting, interesting flavors are worth trying too! ...Just as long as they're not bitter!"
"Hey Proxy, wanna try my favorite ultra-spicy strawberry coconut candy? I've already unwrapped it for you—"
"Soldier Orphie, your weird tastes are gonna scare away all your friends one day!"

mindscapes.name: "Tactics Manual"
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
No one knows what's written in the "Tactics Manual: Orphie's Special Extension" sitting on the young lady's bedside table, not even Captain Magus...
"'Annihilation-1', 'Retreat-3', 'Patrol-2'... Oh, and 'Social Rendezvous-5'!"
"Hold up, Orphie, since when did the tactical strategies for social rendezvous expand to five entries?!"
"I was just testing if you were familiar enough with the Tactics Manual, hehe! You passed, Captain!"

mindscapes.name: Pink Holster
mindscapes.description: Initial duration of Zeroed In increases to 16s, and Orphie & Magus's EX Special Attack: Heat Charge and Ultimate: Dance With Fire DMG increases by 40%.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
Magus never responds to empty threats, which is exactly why Orphie actually bought a pink holster.
It sits in the bottom drawer of the storage locker, serving as a constant reminder for Magus to watch her words — though with limited success.
"Captain, I've told you before, think thrice before speaking, or you'll end up hurting others!"
"Those punks deserved those bullets! Wait, Orphie... Squad Member Orphie, I order you to put that horrendously pink thing down!"

mindscapes.name: Ferry Toll
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
It was Orphie who placed the silver, gleaming commemorative coin right at the entrance where anyone could see it.
"Where could that silver coin for crossing the River of the underworld be~"
"How about... making a set of commemorative coins like this? Using the squad emblem as the design, as a symbol of our squad spirit."
"So a badge of moonlight can be born from black flames...?"
"Stop saying things nobody understands, Soldier 11! But Trigger's idea is great! We could even put all the squad members' names on the back! What do you think, Captain?"
"Approved."

mindscapes.name: Magic Seed
mindscapes.description: With enough energy, after the fire blade attack of Basic Attack: High-Pressure Flamethrower, press to immediately follow up with EX Special Attack: Crimson Vortex. When the fire blade attack of Basic Attack: High-Pressure Flamethrower is activated, recover 10 Bottled Heat, and the Interrupt Level during the low firepower phase of EX Special Attack: Heat Charge will also increase. When the laser from EX Special Attack: Heat Charge or Ultimate hits enemies, it deals additional Fire DMG equal to 250% of Orphie & Magus's ATK. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s and is counted as EX Special Attack and Aftershock DMG.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"Captain, this kind of seed won't grow into a flower. Just like me... no matter how hard I try, nothing ever comes of it..."
"Orphie, this is a magic seed. Though it can't bloom or sprout on its own, it helps other seeds grow into mighty trees... Just keep it with you, and it will bring you good fortune."
"Like me, it will always stay by your side, Orphie, watching as you gradually become the finest soldier."
—Facing that tiny figure who clumsily wipes away tears with her palms, her face twisted with hurt and sadness, Magus's voice flowed from her muzzle with a gentleness never heard before.

profile.details:
Ellen is a maid working for Victoria Housekeeping Co. and its latest member.
She is a laid-back individual who dislikes activities that require energy. However, with the full support of her teammates, she can unleash her formidable power during critical moments.
Since her fighting style leads to high energy consumption, she always carries a lollipop in her mouth to ensure an adequate sugar intake.
While she frequently expresses her desire to change jobs due to the hassle, she genuinely values her companions at Victoria Housekeeping.

Ellen attends a school in New Eridu and has a group of ordinary friends.
Apart from her role as a maid at Victoria Housekeeping, Ellen spends a significant amount of time with her friends, leading an ordinary and contented student life.

Thoughts: As a multitasker, Ellen must balance her student life with her job at Victoria Housekeeping Co.
Perhaps this is one of the reasons why she often feels tired?
profile.details2:
Ellen appears to possess a unique sense of taste that differs from that of ordinary people. Her teammate Rina consistently prepares various "whimsical" dishes, and Ellen is the only one who can consume them without breaking a sweat.

Suggestion: Perhaps you could also sample Rina's dishes. I will compare your reaction with Ellen's to gather more significant data.
profile.aptitude:
New Eridu Citizen Verification Profile:
Ellen, with a high aptitude for Ether, is authorized to perform basic tasks such as investigating and mining in identified Hollows (including Companion Hollows) within New Eridu.
Note: The remaining information about Ellen is currently archived in a certain school in New Eridu.

skins.name: Ellen Scissorhands
skins.description: The sharp scissors of Victoria Housekeeping, if only she weren't sleeping...

skins.name: On Campus

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Saw Teeth Trimming
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
Unleashes up to 3 attacks, dealing Physical DMG.
Press repeatedly or hold during the 3rd attack to extend the skill duration.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Flash Freeze Trimming
descriptions.description:
While Flash Freeze is active, press to activate:
Launch up to 3 attacks at enemies in front, dealing Ice DMG.
Each attack consumes 1 Flash Freeze Charge.
Press repeatedly or hold during the 3rd attack to extend the skill duration.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Glacial Blade Wave
descriptions.description:
After the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Flash Freeze Trimming, Dash Attack: Arctic Ambush's charged scissor strike, Dodge Counter: Reef Rock, and Quick Assist, if Ellen has Flash Freeze Charges, pressing will launch Basic Attack: Glacial Blade Wave, dealing Ice DMG.
This skill consumes 2 points of Flash Freeze Charge.
After use, it can be directly followed up with the 3rd hit of her Basic Attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Icy Blade
descriptions.description:
After the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Flash Freeze Trimming, EX Special Attack: Sharknami, Dodge Counter: Reef Rock, and Assist Follow-Up, automatically launch Basic Attack: Icy Blade, dealing multiple instances of Ice DMG to all enemies in a large area ahead. It inflicts additional instances of Ice DMG against Medium and Large foes.
After the skill, Ellen gains the Quick Charge effect.
Basic Attack: Icy Blade does not affect the branch or form of the original skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dodge: Vortex
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
A rapid dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
When Perfect Dodge is triggered, Ellen gains the Quick Charge effect, reducing the charge time of Dash Attack: Arctic Ambush, lasting up to 5 seconds or until it triggers.

descriptions.name: Dash: Roaming Hunt

Hold or double-press to activate:
Enter the Roaming state, allowing dashing movement.
In the Roaming state, drag the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} to control Ellen's direction, and release to stop.
Ellen is invulnerable for a brief time after activation.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: Arctic Ambush
descriptions.description:
While in the Roaming state, press to activate:
Delivers a spinning slash to enemies before opening her scissors for a Swift Scissors strike, dealing Ice DMG.
Gain 1 point of Flash Freeze Charge when the Swift Scissors strike hits.

While in the Roaming state, hold to activate:
Perform a spinning slash against the enemy, then pull apart the scissors to unleash a Charged Scissors strike, dealing massive Ice DMG.
Gain 3 points of Flash Freeze Charge when the Charged Scissors strike hits. If the enemy is Frozen, it always triggers Shatter.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while charging the skill, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: Arctic Ambush
descriptions.description:
While in the Roaming state, press to activate:
Delivers a spinning slash to enemies before opening her scissors for a Swift Scissors strike, dealing Ice DMG.

While in the Roaming state, hold to activate:
Perform a spinning slash against the enemy, then pull apart the scissors to unleash a Charged Scissor strike, dealing massive Ice DMG.
Gain 3 points of Flash Freeze Charge when the Charged Scissor strike hits. If the enemy is Frozen, it always triggers Shatter.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while charging the skill, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
When taking DMG from enemies while the skill is charging, that instance of DMG is nullified, and charging instantly completes.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: Monstrous Wave
descriptions.description:
Press during a dodge to activate:
Launches a dashing slash attack at enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: Cold Snap
descriptions.description:
While Flash Freeze is active, press during dodge to activate:
Launches a dashing slash attack at enemies in front, dealing Ice DMG.
Consumes 1 Flash Freeze Charge.

descriptions.name: Dodge Counter: Reef Rock
descriptions.description:
Press during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Rapidly move through enemies with open scissors for a cutting strike, dealing Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

stats.name: Swift Scissors Flash Freeze Charge Obtained
Charged Scissors Flash Freeze Charge Obtained

descriptions.name: Quick Assist: Shark Sentinel
descriptions.description:
When the active character is launched, press to activate:
Speedily move through the enemy with open scissors for a cutting strike, dealing Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
When the character on the field is launched, drag the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} and press to activate:
Enter the Roaming state, enabling dashing movement.
While in the Roaming state, use the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} to change directions and release to stop.
Character is invulnerable briefly when triggering the skill.
Upon triggering a Quick Assist, Ellen gains the Quick Charge effect, shortening the charging time of Dash Attack: Arctic Ambush, lasting up to 5s or until it triggers once.

descriptions.name: Defensive Assist: Wavefront Impact
descriptions.description:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Assist Follow-Up: Shark Cruiser
descriptions.description:
Press after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Charge and slash enemies in front, dealing Ice DMG.
Press repeatedly or hold during the attack to extend the skill duration.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Drift
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
Use a quick tail sweep attack in front, dealing Ice DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Tail Swipe
descriptions.description:
With enough Energy, press to activate:
Perform a forceful tail whip attack that deals massive Ice DMG.
Gain 1 Flash Freeze Charge upon striking an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After executing the move, you can immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of a Basic Attack.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Sharknami
descriptions.description:
With enough Energy and after executing EX Special Attack: Tail Swipe, press to activate:
Perform a powerful series of slashes ahead that deal massive Ice DMG.
Gain 1 Flash Freeze Charge upon striking an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After executing the move, you can immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of a Basic Attack.

descriptions.name: Chain Attack: Avalanche
descriptions.description:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Crash down from above and unleash an ice storm, dealing massive Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Ultimate: Endless Winter
descriptions.description:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate:
Crash down from above and unleash an ice storm before a powerful scissor strike, dealing massive Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

mindscapes.name: Glacial Omen
mindscapes.description: Upon hitting an enemy with a Swift Scissors strike during Dash Attack: Arctic Ambush, the obtained Flash Freeze Charges are increased to 3. Upon hitting an enemy with a Charged Scissors strike during Dash Attack: Arctic Ambush, the obtained Flash Freeze Charges are increased to 6. For each Flash Freeze Charge consumed, Ellen's CRIT Rate is increased by 2% for 15s, stacking up to 6 times. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
Chilling winds are an omen of winter, and a signal that Ellen is about to apply for extended leave to hibernate.
Speaking of which, do sharks actually need to hibernate?

mindscapes.name: Arctic Ocean Predator
mindscapes.description: The 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Flash Freeze Trimming can be directly followed up with EX Special Attack: Sharknami. For each point of Flash Freeze Charge when using an EX Special Attack, the current attack's CRIT DMG is increased by 20%, up to a max of 60%.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
Despite being freshly stained with red, the massive shears held by Ellen lacked any trace of warmth.
The icy cold stems from her iron-forged instrument, as well as the fear of facing a predator such as herself.

mindscapes.name: Overtime-Intolerant
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
The whole point of "efficiency" is being able to go home early and sleep.
So strike harder and strike faster.

mindscapes.name: Endless Hoarfrost
mindscapes.description: Whenever a squad member Freezes or Stuns an enemy, Ellen gains 6 Flash Freeze Charges and the Quick Charge effect. She also recovers 4 Energy. The Energy recovery effect can trigger once per 10s.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
A relentless assault of piercing cold. Terrifying monstrosities will learn the beauty and cruelty of winter under Ellen's blade.
But, actually, the endless work that maids have during holidays is far more cruel...

mindscapes.name: Adequate Sleep
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
Except for when in the toughest of battles, Ellen always seems to have that "I can fall asleep at any moment" look.
Many an enemy has met their demise after underestimating Ellen because of it.

mindscapes.name: The Feast Begins
mindscapes.description: When Ellen uses an EX Special Attack, Chain Attack, or gains Quick Charge, her PEN Ratio increases by 20% for 6s. She also gains 1 stack of The Feast Begins, up to a maximum of 3 stacks. With 3 stacks of The Feast Begins, using a Charged Scissors strike during Dash Attack: Arctic Ambush consumes all stacks, increasing the DMG of the current attack by 250%.
mindscapes.flavorDesc: An open wound, a drop of blood. A thrilling hunt, a grand feast. A fragile life, a moment of satisfaction.

profile.details:
Jane, a criminal behavior specialist, has had a "colorful" career as a consultant with Public Security over the years.
She is an expert in disguise, infiltration, and other investigative work.
She has a bad habit of trolling others and sometimes plays harmless pranks.
She's a skilled mimic, able to change her appearance and demeanor at will, making people wonder what the "real" Jane is like.

Jane has a wealth of life experience and can seamlessly blend into any environment, as though she has dabbled in everything there is to do.
However, if you ask her for any further details, she'll give you a different story every time.
Who knows which, if any, are true.

Note 1: Jane does not know our true identity. Do not reveal this to her under any circumstances.
Note 2: Despite "Jane Doe" being an obvious alias, we haven't found any information about her real or former name.
This is not my problem. My guess is that her true identity has been completely erased due to her special status.
Let me reiterate: This is not my problem.
profile.details2:
Jane is a total night owl. She loves working the night shift and is most alive after dark.
She's also a bit of a hoarder, constantly filling her home with stuff (usually a bunch of junk food).

The pouch at her waist might look like a makeup bag, but it's actually her toolkit, packed with all the "essentials" for her work.
profile.aptitude:
Hollow Investigation Association Licensing Archive—
Public Security Officer: Zhu Yuan. Ether aptitude confidential. Licensed for investigation, exploration, and other basic work in known Hollows (including Companion Hollows) in the city.
Note: Zhu Yuan's file belongs to the New Eridu Public Security Janus Quarter Metropolitan Order Division Criminal Investigation Special Response Team. The relevant information can be obtained within the Public Security system, requiring special access permissions.
Further Note: Zhu Yuan has excellent Ether aptitude.

skins.name: Hidden Nightfade
skins.description: Her everyday look when she isn't putting on a disguise. Maybe it's just one of the countless faces she wears. The night becomes her cover, and her mask is the one truth she never sets aside.

skins.name: Nocturne of Light
skins.description: Who says sunlight must accompany a seaside stroll? For lurkers with names unknown, the night is their most faithful companion. The anonymous lady says the evening sea holds unspeakable secrets — is this the truth, or another deception?

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Dancing Blades
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
Unleashes up to 6 attacks in front, dealing Physical DMG.

descriptions.name: Passion
descriptions.description:
When Jane triggers Perfect Dodge, Defensive Assist, or performs a move that deals DMG to the enemy, she accumulates Passion Stream. Upon reaching the maximum Passion Stream, Jane enters the Passion state.
While in the Passion state, Jane's Physical Anomaly Buildup Rate is increased by 25%. Additionally, if Jane's Anomaly Proficiency exceeds 120, each extra point raises her ATK by 2, up to a maximum of 600.
In the Passion state, Jane's skills that deal damage consume Passion Stream. Activating a Perfect Dodge or Defensive Assist regenerates Passion Stream. Jane exits the Passion state when all of her Passion Stream is consumed.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Salchow Jump
descriptions.description:
Entering the Passion state grants Jane one use of Basic Attack: Salchow Jump.
When available, hold to activate:
Launch rapid consecutive attacks forward, followed by a Finishing Move, dealing Physical DMG.
Hold the button during the consecutive attacks to extend the skill duration. Release to trigger the Finishing Move early.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased during the consecutive attacks, and Jane takes 40% reduced DMG. Jane is invulnerable during the Finishing Move.
Using and damaging an enemy with Basic Attack: Salchow Jump while in the Passion state generates Passion Stream.

descriptions.name: Dodge: Phantom

Press to trigger.
A quick slide dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Jane has an extra dodge. Before she enters the Passion state, she alternates between the two dodges. After entering the Passion state, Jane can pass through enemies in front when dodging.

Launch three quick rushing slashes in front, dealing Physical DMG.

Press after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Leap up and swiftly slash the enemy, then execute a wide sweeping slash across a large area in front, dealing Physical DMG.

descriptions.name: Chain Attack: Flowers of Sin

Weaves between and slashes enemies with a powerful attack in a large area in front, followed by a Finishing Move, dealing massive Physical DMG.

Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Assault DMG has a chance to trigger a critical hit against enemies in the Gnawed state, with a base CRIT Rate of 20% and CRIT DMG of 50%. Each point of Jane's Anomaly Proficiency further increases this CRIT Rate by 0.1%.

mindscapes.description: The maximum uses of Basic Attack: Salchow Jump are increased by one. While in the Passion state, Jane's Physical Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by an extra 15% and each point of Jane's Anomaly Proficiency increases her DMG by 0.1%, up to a maximum increase of 30%.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"A criminal consultant advises on criminology, not on how to actually commit crimes."
Jane suddenly leaned closer and blinked.
"Of course, if you see it as the latter... I won't mind."

mindscapes.name: Adapt to the Environment
mindscapes.description: When Jane's attack hits an enemy in the Gnawed state, or when any squad member triggers Assault on an enemy in the Gnawed state, 15% of the enemy's DEF is ignored. Additionally, when Assault DMG triggers a critical hit, the CRIT DMG dealt is increased by an additional 50%.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
Gaze into the abyss, and it gazes back. That's only the first step.
"Then you must approach, enter, and understand it. This is the second step."
"The final step... is to resist becoming it."

mindscapes.name: Anonymity
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"Anonymity — that means to become anyone. Your favorite person, perhaps~"
"Or maybe, your worst fear?"

mindscapes.name: Adapt and Thrive
mindscapes.description: When any squad member triggers the Assault or Disorder effects, all squad members' Attribute Anomaly DMG is increased by 18%, lasting 15s.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"Whether you're a hunter or the hunted usually depends on your perspective. However, I favor a more straightforward assessment—"
"The Loser is the prey."

mindscapes.name: Compulsive Hoarder
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
Jane's room is filled with all sorts of things, especially fast food.
"Isn't it nice here? There's food within reach everywhere~"

mindscapes.name: "Shady" Technique
mindscapes.description: While in the Passion state, Jane's CRIT Rate increases by 20%, and CRIT DMG by 40%. After any squad member inflicts Assault, Jane instantly enters the Passion state, and gains max Passion Stream. When that instance of Assault triggers a critical hit, Jane performs an additional attack on the target, dealing Physical DMG equal to 1,600% of her Anomaly Proficiency.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
On the streets, the means don't matter, only the outcome.
"Seeing the darkest desires reveals the most crucial weaknesses."

profile.details:
Piper is a truck driver for the Sons of Calydon. Apart from driving, she's also responsible for vehicle maintenance and other related jobs.
Her tiny stature, cute voice (though she always seems half-asleep when not driving), and adorably harmless appearance (though she's a shut-in who can't be bothered to take care of her own appearance) make it hard to imagine that she would have such a crazy driving style.
Usually, by the time she drawls out, "Hold~ on~ tight~," the truck is already barreling down the road.
Rumor has it, Piper is a driver who doesn't need brakes. Though riding with her is a terrifying experience, she will always get you where you need to go safely, and in the shortest time possible. Of course, "safely" doesn't include any trauma that may be induced.

Piper has many hobbies that don't seem to match her age, such as reading newspapers, buying lottery tickets, and collecting car magazines.
Piper's biggest wish is to live each day slowly and leisurely.
Note: Please keep in mind, Master, that this is also my wish.
profile.details2:
Piper has a love for the sound of truck engines starting up, so she recorded the sound of Steeltusk starting up. She has to listen to the recording to fully wake up in the morning.
If Piper falls asleep during a meeting, playing a recording of a truck engine can quickly get her wide awake again (this intel was provided by Lucy).
profile.aptitude:
TLDR: Piper has a high Aptitude for Ether.
Note: I believe, considering Piper's personality, she prefers a simple introduction such as this.

skins.description: Don't be fooled by this truck driver's lazy gaze. One tap on the gas is enough to fling every passenger's soul straight into the back seat.

During the skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.

mindscapes.flavorDesc:
One ordinary morning at Sons of Calydon, Piper lets out a lazy yawn.
"Good morning—"
"Can we have another relaxing day today? It's important to take it easy, or else lil ol' me might end up working meself to death—"

mindscapes.name: Motivation

When using Special Attack: One Trillion Tons, EX Special Attack: Really Heavy, or Ultimate to launch a downward smash that hits an enemy, the Physical DMG dealt by the move is increased by 10%. For each stack of Power, this buff is further increased by 1%.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
A bit of effort now means more rest later.
Though, it'd be even better if I didn't have to put in any effort at all — Piper stretches, pats the soft bed in her truck, and lies down.

mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
Piper is always all about trucks.
Even when she's fast asleep, the rumble of an engine snaps her awake in an instant:
"100 horsepower, 5-ton capacity... must be the new light truck from Three Gates Industries!"

mindscapes.flavorDesc:
Riding with Piper is a heart-pounding experience.
By the time she drawls out, "Hold~ on~ tight~," the truck is already barreling down the road.
She always gets you to your destination fast—though your nerves might take a hit.

mindscapes.name: Personal Hobbies

mindscapes.flavorDesc:
Piper seems to have some hobbies that are not what you'd expect from her.
"This horse looks like a real runner... Hmm, but not many people are betting on it. Guess the one with the higher win rate is the safer bet..."
"Burp— Nitro-Fuel... I can drink more... Gimme another one!"

mindscapes.name: Mild Excitement

mindscapes.flavorDesc:
As you may already know, Piper's biggest dream is to live a life of perpetual relaxation.
But right now, her usually half-closed eyes are surprisingly bright and alert.
"If it's for you... I suppose lil ol' me can try a little harder~"

profile.details:
Astra Yao is widely regarded as Ridu's most iconic singer. With her extraordinary voice, stage presence, and songwriting talent, she has led the musical trends of an entire era. "If music is the resonance of the soul, then Astra Yao is the spark that ignites it all," said one famous music critic.

As brilliant as she is, Astra remains remarkably sincere and pure. On stage, her voice resonates deeply with the audience, which has allowed her to amass a large and loyal fanbase known as her "Astranauts." Of course, Astra's brilliance wouldn't be possible without the careful protection of her manager, Evelyn. Offstage, she appears to be just a cute, hapless girl who depends on Evelyn in her daily life, and on Wise and Belle in the Hollows.

"If I tickled Eous, would it make you laugh?" Astra asked curiously while lifting the Proxy, who was linked via the HDD system.

She seems to have a particular fondness for Eous.
Contemplation: Human emotions are indeed an interesting subject. It's still hard to determine whether Astra likes Eous because of the owner, or whether she likes the owner because of Eous.
profile.details2:
Astra is particularly fond of Random Play. However, her whereabouts are closely monitored. For now, it seems she can still use an excuse like, "The store offers rare versions of old movies, and I've got such good taste in movies, so of course I'd love it!" But being the biggest celebrity in Ridu, such frequent visits to a video rental store are not exactly conducive to keeping our identity under wraps.

But, who cares about that! If our identity gets exposed, so be it — Astra can't not come.
Contemplation: Creating various situations to bring Astra and Master together is a great way to win the Master's favor.
profile.aptitude:
There's no record of Astra Yao's aptitude for Ether in her New Eridu Citizen Verification Profile.
Note: She has an outstanding aptitude for Ether.

skins.name: Scarlet Rock
skins.description: The bold red is only to ignite the freedom deep within. On stage, nothing can overshadow her brilliance.

skins.name: Chandelier
skins.description: The black-and-white dress glimmers in both light and shadows. Every smile of hers seems to sink into the flowing light of the night, becoming a timeless classic.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: "Capriccio"
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
Perform up to three attacks forward, dealing Ether DMG.
During the 3rd hit, hold to charge, drawing enemies in and expanding the attack range for a stronger attack.
After using other skills, hold to initiate the 3rd hit directly.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Interlude
descriptions.description:
While in the Idyllic Cadenza state, press to activate:
Release Tremolo forward to attack, dealing Ether DMG.
A Quick Assist will be triggered when this skill hits an enemy.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Chorus
descriptions.description:
While in the Idyllic Cadenza state, press during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Launch multiple Tremolo attacks at enemies in front, dealing massive Ether DMG.
A Quick Assist will be triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Finale
descriptions.description:
While in the Idyllic Cadenza state, hold to activate:
Release Tremolo forward to attack, dealing Ether DMG and exit the Idyllic Cadenza state.
Upon activation of the skill, it grants Astra Yao the buff from Core Passive: "Graceful Andante".
With enough Energy, consumes Energy to follow up with 1 Tremolo and 3 Tone Clusters. This Tremolo attack released is considered an EX Special Attack.

descriptions.name: Dodge: "Mini Waltz"
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: "Lunar Eclipse Melody"
descriptions.description:
Press during a dodge to activate:
Attack ahead, dealing Ether DMG.
When triggered, dragging the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} allows movement in the corresponding direction.

descriptions.name: Dodge Counter: "Umbrella Waltz"
descriptions.description:
Press during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Attack enemies in front, dealing Ether DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Quick Assist: "One Luminous Sky"
descriptions.description:

Attack enemies in front, dealing Ether DMG.

descriptions.description:

descriptions.name: Assist Follow-Up: "Three Lifetimes of Fate"
descriptions.description:
Press after an Evasive Assist to activate:
Release an energy beam forward, dealing Ether DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: "Windchimes & Oaths"
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
Quickly move away, then release Tremolo, dealing Ether DMG, and enter the Idyllic Cadenza state.
During activation, dragging the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} enables movement in the direction held.
Hold to charge during activation, drawing enemies in, and follow up with 1 to 4 Tremolos depending on the charge duration.
A Quick Assist will be triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Character is invulnerable when quickly moving away.

descriptions.name: Idyllic Cadenza
descriptions.description:
After entering the Idyllic Cadenza state, Astra Yao increases all squad members' DMG by {0}% and CRIT DMG by {1}%.
While in the Idyllic Cadenza state, Astra Yao cannot move, but pressing will activate Basic Attack: Interlude, and pressing will activate a dodge. After triggering a Perfect Dodge, press to activate Basic Attack: Chorus.
While in this state, Astra Yao's Anti-Interrupt Level is increased, and the DMG she takes is reduced by 40%. After switching to another character, Astra Yao will remain on the field and become Invulnerable. When switching back to her, she will automatically follow up with Special Attack: "Windchimes & Oaths".
During this state, hold to activate Basic Attack: Finale, exiting the Idyllic Cadenza state, or hold to exit the Idyllic Cadenza state directly.

descriptions.name: Chord
descriptions.description:
For every 25 Energy, Astra Yao will have 1 Chord.
While in the Idyllic Cadenza state, when Astra Yao has Chords, a Quick Assist can be triggered in the following situations:
· When the active character's attack hits an enemy, once per 3s.
· When the active character's heavy attack hits an enemy, once per 1s.
When other squad members switch in through a Quick Assist, Chain Attack, Defensive Assist, or Evasive Assist, Astra Yao will consume 25 Energy and release 1 Tremolo to attack. This Tremolo attack released is considered an EX Special Attack.
After triggering a Quick Assist, quickly press to switch characters and trigger a Precise Assist, causing Astra Yao to follow up with 3 Tone Clusters to attack. When other squad members switch in through a Chain Attack, Defensive Assist, or Evasive Assist, it will automatically trigger a Precise Assist.

descriptions.name: Chain Attack: "Tipsy Concerto"
descriptions.description:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Use song to channel energy into a blast, dealing massive Ether DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
After the skill, Astra Yao enters the Idyllic Cadenza state.

descriptions.name: Ultimate: "Fantasian Sonata"
descriptions.description:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate:
Use song to channel energy into a blast, dealing massive Ether DMG, and restoring {0} HP to all squad members.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
A Quick Assist is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
After the skill, Astra Yao enters the Idyllic Cadenza state.
After the skill, the next two Quick Assists will be replaced by Chain Attacks.
Before all replacement chances are used up, a Quick Assist is triggered whenever any squad member hits an enemy with a Chain Attack or Ultimate.
