mindscapes.name: 12-Tone Equal Temperament
mindscapes.description: When Astra Yao's attack hits an enemy, the target's All-Attribute RES is reduced by 6%, stacking up to 3 times and lasting 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Upon entering the battlefield, Astra Yao immediately gains 1,000 Decibels. When activating her Ultimate, all squad members gain 1 stack of Song of Protection for 60s. When attacked by an enemy, consume Song of Protection, granting Invulnerability for 1s.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"What is the 12-tone equal temperament?"
"12-tone equal temperament is a musical tuning system, just like how children have to line up, sounds need to be in order too."
"But sounds probably don't like lining up, just like children!"
—Astra Yao's music teacher, recalling when she was six.

mindscapes.name: Art of Greed
mindscapes.description: The ATK buff from Core Passive: "Graceful Andante" is further increased by 19%, with an increased maximum of 400. While in the Idyllic Cadenza state, when other squad members switch in through a Quick Assist, Chain Attack, Defensive Assist, or Evasive Assist, Astra Yao will additionally follow up with 1 Tremolo and 3 Tone Clusters to attack. This effect can trigger once every 3s.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"The shiniest thing in the world is, of course, love!"
Just like a bird gathering shiny things for its nest, an artist's inner greed is probably to gather all the love in the world. By gathering all the love, one can create the most beautiful melody.

mindscapes.name: Interwoven Staff Notation
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
A blank musical staff is a set of parallel lines that never intersect, like souls that have never met, quietly waiting for their melodies to intertwine into a song.
"Let's fill it with notes! And lots and lots of tied notes. It'll make a fantastic song!"
And that's how a new song was created, stretching across 136 bars, all connected with ties...

mindscapes.name: "Hair Upon Your Nape"
mindscapes.description: After activating a Chain Attack or Ultimate, within 15s, Astra Yao can trigger a Quick Assist even if she does not have Chords. When the attack hits an enemy, the interval for triggering a Quick Assist is reduced to 1s. While in the Idyllic Cadenza state, when other squad members enter the field via a Quick Assist, they will receive different buffs based on their specialty, and this effect can be triggered once every 3s for the entire squad: Attack: The next Quick Assist heavy attack on an enemy will deal extra DMG equal to 300% of Astra Yao's ATK; Anomaly: The next Quick Assist will have 50% increased Anomaly Buildup; Stun: The next Quick Assist will inflict 50% increased Daze.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
One hand hovers over the piano
Not sure which note will bring me peace
A sad minor key
Or gentle melody of longing?
I seek your shadow through the score
I close my eyes, and see you more
Such as the hair upon your nape

mindscapes.name: Proxy and Silk String
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"Eve! I've just realized something huge — both you and {M#Wise}{F#Belle} are tall and slim!"
"...And your point being...?"
"You're both my favorite people!"
Astra beamed with joy, as if she had uncovered an earth-shattering secret.

mindscapes.name: We Are the World
mindscapes.description: While in the Idyllic Cadenza state, the DMG multiplier for Tremolo and Tone Clusters released or followed up with will increase to 200% of the original, and CRIT Rate is increased by 80%. When triggering a Precise Assist, Astra Yao will automatically follow up with the charged 3rd-hit of Basic Attack: "Capriccio", with a 80% increased CRIT Rate. This effect can trigger once every 10s.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
The turmoil in the world originates from the solitude of the human heart. If everyone's heart was reciprocated, perhaps all the suffering, sadness, and silence in the world would vanish?
If we could weave this connection with song, would all the cracks heal, and all the pain turn into a beautiful melody, filling the silence? At that point, the world would no longer be a lonely island.
"This song is dedicated to the world!"

profile.details:
Trigger is a sniper of New Eridu Defense Force, Obsidian Division's Obol Squad. Trigger is the code name she was assigned when enlisting in Eridu, and she's used it ever since.

She has extremely unique eyes. While she cannot see most things, in Hollow environments, she can distinctly identify the position and changes of any entities that emit Ether fluctuations. Note: Such entities include living beings, native Ether substances, Ether products, and Ethereals.

As a visually challenged person in the broadest sense, Trigger has honed her other senses to the utmost, allowing her to move and act as if she could see. She can even detect subtle changes in her environment with precision. This makes her highly adept in the tactical position of a sniper, capable of handling a variety of covert tasks such as stealth, surveillance, and assassination.

In contrast to her precise and deadly combat abilities, her personality makes her seem rather unassuming. Aside from occasionally appearing silently in the video store and giving the Second Assistant a sudden scare, she can generally be considered harmless.
profile.details2:
According to records, Trigger originally served in the Lyre Squad of the Eridu Defense Force, Chrysoberyl Division. The other members of the squad were all killed during the fall of the old capital. Her eyes were also corrupted during this disaster. Trigger is currently working alongside the other members of her new squad to investigate the truth behind the fall of the old capital.

Trigger has a deep sense of loyalty to her companions, willing to go to great lengths for them. Master, from her actions, it is evident that she considers you a companion and has a noticeably high level of affection for you. It is likely that some event has occurred, which has left a strong, positive impression on her.

Suggestion: Offering unlimited red bean buns and round-the-clock access to soundproof rooms for harmonica playing as conditions, try negotiating a long-term partnership. This would enable you to secure extremely dependable combat strength with minimal expenditure.
profile.aptitude:
Hollow Investigative Association Licensing Archive:
Defense Force soldier Trigger has excellent Ether aptitude, and is allowed to perform basic tasks like investigating and extracting resources in known Hollows within the city (including Companion Hollows).
Note: Trigger's eyes have come into direct contact with Ether beams and have suffered significant corruption. It is therefore recommended she does not remove her eye mask or expose her eyes to the air in Hollow environments.

skins.description: In the Hollows, her aim never wavers. She's a teammate one can rely on to cover their back without question. But once she returns to Sixth Street, that constant watchfulness softens, lingering for a moment before disappearing the instant it's sensed.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Cold-Bore Shot
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
Unleashes up to 4 shots ahead. The first 3 hits deal Physical DMG, the 4th hit deals Electric DMG.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Silenced Shot
descriptions.description:
Hold to activate:
Trigger enters the Sniper Stance and fires forward continuously, dealing Electric DMG.
While continually firing, when attacked by an enemy, Trigger will automatically evade. This effect can trigger once every 8s.
While continually firing, you can drag the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} to adjust her position to the left/right/back.
Automatically evading attacks or adjusting position when about to be hit will trigger a Perfect Dodge, followed by an automatic charged counter.
After releasing , Trigger will step back, ready her weapon and unleash a Finishing Move, then exit Sniper Stance.
Character is invulnerable during the charged counter and Finishing Move.
When the continuous firing or the charged counter hits an enemy, Trigger gains 25 Purge, up to a maximum of 100 Purge.
When the Finishing Move hits an enemy, it triggers the Quick Assist of the previous character in the squad. A Quick Assist can only be triggered through this method once every 25s.

Upon activating this skill, consume 3 Purge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot is an Aftershock attack.
The squad can trigger Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot once every 3s.

While encircling the enemy, rapidly fires three shots at the enemy, followed by a Finishing Move, dealing Electric DMG.
Upon activating this skill, consume 5 Purge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot - Tartarus is an Aftershock attack.
The same skill type can trigger Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot - Tartarus up to 2 times within 20s for the entire squad.
During Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot, Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot - Tartarus will immediately activate instead if triggered.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Flash Burial
descriptions.description:

Lunge forward with a slash, then leap up with a powerful shot to the ground, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
When this skill hits an enemy, it triggers the Quick Assist of the previous character in the squad.
When this skill hits an enemy, Trigger enters Coordinated Support. While in this state, when another active character in the squad hits an enemy with any attack, it triggers a Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot without consuming Purge and with no cooldown restrictions. This state lasts 8s and the effect can trigger up to 4 times. Repeatedly entering Coordinated Support extends the duration and grants additional triggers, lasting a maximum of 20s and triggering up to a maximum of 10 times.

descriptions.description:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes continuous powerful shots forward, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Ultimate: Underworld Requiem
descriptions.description:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate:
Deliver a powerful shot at enemies in a large area ahead, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
When the skill hits an enemy, it triggers the Quick Assist of the previous character in the squad.
When the skill hits an enemy, Trigger enters Coordinated Support. While in this state, when another active character in the squad hits an enemy with any attack, it triggers a Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot without consuming Purge and with no cooldown restrictions. This state lasts 12s and the effect can trigger up to 6 times. Repeatedly entering Coordinated Support extends the duration and grants additional triggers, lasting a maximum of 20s and triggering up to a maximum of 10 times.

mindscapes.name: Sharpened Senses
mindscapes.description: The Stun DMG Multiplier applied through Core Passive: Soul-Searching Gaze is increased by an additional 20%. When activating Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot, the cooldown is reduced to 2s. Purge gained upon hitting an enemy with the continuous fire or charged counter in Sniper Stance increases by 25%. Maximum Purge increases to 125.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
Hearing that can distinguish every subtle change in the wind, touch that can sense every tremor in the ground. To compensate for her visual limitations, the young lady honed her other senses to perfection.
"Being a sniper is the only thing I excel at... At least in this, I refuse to lose to anyone."

mindscapes.name: "Ether Vision"
mindscapes.description: Upon using an Aftershock, Trigger gains 1 stack of Hunter's Gaze. When executing a Finishing Move in Sniper Stance, Trigger gains 2 stacks of Hunter's Gaze. Each stack of Hunter's Gaze increases all squad members' CRIT DMG by 6%, stacking up to 4 times, and lasting 10s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
When inside the Hollow, every Ether fluctuation around her becomes an aid to her spatial observation.
"I used to think these eyes were cursed, bringing nothing but pain."
"But now... they're my ticket to reaching my goals, and proof that I haven't forgotten my past."

mindscapes.name: "Homecoming"
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
The home she could return to is now sealed away in the past.
Her cold lips pressed against the harmonica, the lonely melody the only testament to her memories.

mindscapes.name: Concealment
mindscapes.description: When Trigger enters or extends Coordinated Support, while the state is active, the next time other squad members trigger Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot or Basic Attack: Harmonizing Shot - Tartarus, it will trigger Disconnect upon hitting an enemy, dealing additional DMG equal to 200% of Trigger's ATK and inflict Daze equal to 120% of Trigger's Impact. This skill has a relatively high Interrupt Level.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
Footsteps, breaths, heartbeats. She smothers every trace of her own aura until her entire form blends seamlessly with the environment. She moves through the battlefield like a ghostly reaper.
Outside of combat though, this silent way of moving has been strictly forbidden after scaring her teammates one too many times.
Of course, she definitely hasn't been using these stealth tactics to observe the video store when she can't find an opportunity to meet someone there... right?

mindscapes.name: Locked In
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
Once a target is locked, even with a broken, decaying body or through excruciating pain, never let your crosshair waver. From the targets of her revenge to those she must protect, from enemies to allies — this is the will of a sniper.
But with the Proxy, the one who gave her light in her darkest hour, it's not about locking in but being drawn in. Even if there's no reason to keep watching, she will never divert her aim — this is the will of a young lady.

mindscapes.name: Beyond the River of the Dead
mindscapes.description: Upon entering the battlefield, Trigger gains 5 Armor Break Rounds. For every 25 Purge consumed, Trigger gains 1 additional Armor Break Round, up to a maximum of 5 rounds. While possessing Armor Break Rounds, when Trigger hits a target in Sniper Stance, 1 Armor Break Round is consumed to deal additional Electric DMG equal to 1,200% of Trigger's ATK. Armor Break Round DMG is additionally increased by 50%. This effect can trigger once every 0.2s.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"You know what? Those who are stained with blood in battle can only go to the underworld after death."
"Beyond the river of the dead lies a sight of unparalleled beauty. Flowers bloom all around me, while familiar faces from my past accompany me to my final, peaceful place of rest."
"But... because of you, because I have something to protect, perhaps I don't want that day to come so soon."

profile.details:
Evelyn is the manager and personal bodyguard of Ridu's most iconic singer, Astra Yao. Known for her calm, decisive decision-making and professional, efficient style, she's an irreplaceable pillar behind Astra. "In terms of commercial value, if Astra Yao represents the 1, then Evelyn is all the 0s that follow," a reporter from an entertainment magazine stated.

Evelyn is skilled at planning comprehensive schedules and product endorsements, while also ensuring Astra Yao's safety during any unexpected situations. "Want to get close to Astra Yao? You'll have to get past Evelyn Chevalier first..." Though she's always busy with work, Evelyn never seems overwhelmed, and she has an almost obsessive attention to detail, ensuring that every performance and every product endorsement goes through her strict scrutiny. But strangely, such an exceptional manager is not trusted by her parent company, Odeum HAE.

Intel: Evelyn's role seems to go beyond just being a manager and personal bodyguard; there seems to be an "organization" behind her.

It seems a lot of people in Astra Yao's central Astranauts group ship them together.
profile.details2:
Information about the "organization" Evelyn is affiliated with is scarce. Currently, it is only known that she was brought into the "organization" at a young age, where she underwent harsh training and developed skills to make quick decisions and carry out tasks in any environment. While these experiences have left numerous hidden scars on her, they also gave her remarkable abilities and composure.

Consideration: We need to look into what kind of "organization" it actually is.
profile.aptitude:
Hollow Investigative Association Licensing Archive:
Evelyn Chevalier, possessing a good Ether aptitude, is allowed to perform basic tasks like investigating and extracting resources in known Hollows within the city (including Companion Hollows).

skins.description: A sharp, no-nonsense manager's outfit. Its hidden edges are enough to make onlookers back off. Her yellow-brown hair weaves a fine, delicate net, where a quiet pool of starlight seems to rest.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Razor Wire
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
Launch up to five attacks ahead, dealing Physical DMG and Fire DMG.
When the 5th hit lands against an enemy, Evelyn will use her Lunalux Garrote to bind the primary target and enter Binding Seal.

descriptions.name: Passive: Bind
descriptions.description:
When Evelyn uses her skills to deal DMG to enemies, she will accumulate Burning Embers.
When Evelyn consumes Burning Embers to activate Garrote or consumes Decibels to perform an Ultimate, she gains 1 Burning Tether Point.
Once Evelyn has 3 Burning Tether Points, her next use of Garrote will consume all Burning Tether Points to instead use a lower Interrupt Level version of Chain Attack: Lunalux - Snare.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Garrote - First Form
descriptions.description:
When Burning Embers is at 50% or higher, hold or to activate:
Consume 50% Burning Embers to use Lunalux Garrote to perform a slashing attack, dealing Fire DMG.
During skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
After using this skill, gain 1 Burning Tether Point.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Garrote - Second Form
descriptions.description:
When Burning Embers is 50% or higher, after using Basic Attack: Garrote - First Form, continue to hold or to activate:
Consume 50% Burning Embers to use Lunalux Garrote to perform a follow-up attack, dealing Fire DMG.
During skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
After using this skill, gain 1 Burning Tether Point.

descriptions.description:

A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: Piercing Ambush
descriptions.description:
Press during a dodge to activate:
Deliver a kick to the enemy in front, causing Physical DMG.

descriptions.name: Dodge Counter: Strangling Reversal
descriptions.description:

mindscapes.name: Dreamweave
mindscapes.description: Upon entering the battlefield, Evelyn immediately gains 1,500 Decibels. Enemies affected by Binding Seal will be Bound. When Evelyn attacks Bound enemies, she ignores 12% of their DEF. When Evelyn uses Special Attack: Binding Sunder - First Form or EX Special Attack: Binding Sunder - Final Form, the Bound effect spreads to all enemies hit by the skill. This spread Bound effect lasts for 10s.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
The distant, blurred light seemed to be a dream she had crafted, an unreachable future. It wasn't about atonement, but a yearning for freedom.
"You want it too, don't you? A real life." An anonymous former coworker once asked Evelyn.

mindscapes.name: Dance of Fire
mindscapes.description: Evelyn's ATK increases by 15%. When Evelyn uses Basic Attack: Garrote - First Form or Basic Attack: Garrote - Second Form, the Burning Embers consumed will be returned. This effect can trigger once every 25s. When Evelyn consumes Burning Tether Point to trigger Chain Attack: Lunalux - Snare, the skill's Interrupt Level increases.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"To me, that light was unfamiliar, something I should have steered clear of, but it broke through every barrier, as though it was trying to remind me that beyond the darkness, there was something worth chasing."
When Evelyn recalls the first time she met Astra Yao, there's a rare softness in her tone.

mindscapes.name: Metamorphosis
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc: At that moment, she frees herself from her restraints and becomes her truest self. The tightened ropes snap, and the chains turn into a broken cocoon. Evelyn stands at the boundary of rebirth, and in her cold, sharp gaze, there is the flicker of a faint, soft glow.

mindscapes.name: Fate's Melody
mindscapes.description: Upon activating a Chain Attack or Ultimate, Evelyn immediately gains a shield equal to 10% of her Max HP. While this shield exists, Evelyn's CRIT DMG increases by 40%.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"You know, Eve? Every time I meet someone important to me, my heart goes 'thump-thump!'"
Evelyn sighs, signaling that it was getting late. Astra quickly fastens the back of her gown and rushed out the door.
"Thump thump," Evelyn mutters to herself, left alone in the dressing room.

mindscapes.name: Crimson Threads Like the Dawn
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
Her threads, dyed crimson like the clouds at dawn.
After each attack, she spins elegantly, blazing flames scattering like the morning light. No words are needed — Evelyn's protection has turned into a radiant flame.

mindscapes.name: Bond of Light and Shadow
mindscapes.description: Upon launching a Chain Attack or Ultimate, Evelyn gains Shadowstring Edge for 20s. During Shadowstring Edge, when Evelyn hits her primary target with a Basic Attack, Dash Attack, Special Attack, or EX Special Attack, she additionally executes a Lunalux Garrote follow-up attack, dealing Fire DMG equal to 375% of her ATK to enemies in the area. This DMG is considered Chain Attack DMG and can trigger up to 16 times. Gaining another Shadowstring Edge will refresh the trigger count.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
Where there is light, there will always be shadow.
It silently hides, tracing the light's path, guarding each bright burst. The shadow never tries to steal the light's brilliance, but at every turn, it quietly fills those corners the light cannot reach. The two have never been separated, nor can they be — light is whole because of shadow, and shadow exists because of light. It's an eternal pursuit, an unspeakable connection.

profile.details:
Tsukishiro Yanagi, Hollow Special Operations Section 6 Deputy Chief and intelligence officer.
Primarily responsible for personnel management, mission management and feedback, collecting intel, on-site support, etc.
At the same time, Yanagi is also Section 6 member Soukaku's Protector. Apart from taking care of Soukaku's day-to-day affairs, she is also responsible for and takes responsibility for all of Soukaku's behavior at work.

Section 6 Chief Hoshimi Miyabi possesses a rather eccentric personality; Asaba Harumasa, a member of Section 6, is overly relaxed and carefree; and Soukaku, another member of Section, 6 is still an innocent and excitable child, so most of the team's work falls upon Yanagi's shoulders.
Serious, diligent, and meticulous, Tsukishiro Yanagi is the only "normal" person on the team, so to speak. It is only due to her guidance and leadership that the strength of the three who make up Section 6's primary on-field force can be transformed into true combat power.
Overall, Tsukishiro Yanagi is a talented and highly efficient executive officer, whose abilities are both exceptional and comprehensive.
However, from certain data, Tsukishiro Yanagi appears to have a somewhat clumsy side to her when it comes to day-to-day affairs.
profile.details2: Due to an accident long ago, Tsukishiro Yanagi appears to possess blood that does not belong to her, flowing through her veins.
profile.aptitude:
Hollow Investigative Association Licensing Archive:
Executive Officer Tsukishiro Yanagi, Ether aptitude confidential, is allowed to perform basic tasks like investigating and extracting resources in known Hollows within the city (including Companion Hollows).
Note: Tsukishiro Yanagi has high Ether aptitude and the specific details can be obtained via the Hollow Special Operations system... including a report containing a blood analysis with peculiar results.

skins.description: Even reflective lenses can't hide the sharp gleam in the Deputy Chief's eyes. She has to constantly keep watch over a warrior obsessed with training, a scout who slacks off whenever possible, and a little one who's forever getting stomachaches.

profile.details:
Hugo calls himself a collector and runs a fairly successful gallery, mingling with the "elite" of New Eridu.
In truth, he's the leader of the phantom thieves syndicate, Mockingbird — and Lycaon's former partner.
Despite his cruel (edgy and dramatic) words, deep down he has his own sense of fairness and justice.

Records suggest that Hugo had a troubled childhood.
As the illegitimate son of the Ravenlocks, a long-established TOPS family, he was rejected by his mother from an early age because of his heterochromatic eyes.
His father bought him back like a cheap commodity, using him to provoke a cutthroat succession battle between his children. In that brutal struggle, the only one kind to Hugo — his sister, Serena — became the first to fall. The ones who orchestrated her death pinned the blame on Hugo, thinking it would destroy him. But to their shock, their father actually praised Hugo's actions, calling them the very traits a worthy heir should possess.
After running away from his family, Hugo met Lycaon and Jack and learned to be a phantom thief. After Jack passed away, Hugo and Lycaon formed Mockingbird together.

Later, during one of Mockingbird's missions, Hugo came face-to-face with his father. In a brief moment of hesitation, he chose not to take his revenge and kill him — an act of mercy that ended up costing the lives of many innocent people. His close friend Lycaon, due to a misunderstanding born from those circumstances, broke ties with him and ultimately left Mockingbird.
After drifting on his own for a while, Hugo met Vivian, a girl who reminded him of his sister Serena. He took her under his wing and reformed the Mockingbird syndicate.
profile.details2:
Back during his time with the Ravenlock family, Hugo once ate a piece of cake that his older brother liked. In retaliation, the other children forced him to eat an entire table's worth of desserts.
Ever since, the taste of anything sweet makes him want to throw up — likely due to PTSD.
But due to his hypoglycemia, he needs sugar to keep his body functioning properly. Hugo forces himself to eat sweets over and over, pushing through the nausea to overcome the pain.
Note: Neither Lycaon nor Vivian knows about this, and Hugo once asked you to keep it a secret from them.

skins.description: Never be claimed by fate. Defy its clamps, its control, its taunts, its alms, its curses, and its so-called blessings. Once you return from the abyss, it is fate that should kneel to you.

Performs a series of attacks on enemies in front, dealing Ice DMG.
During the skill, hold to launch a shot. During the shot, hold to charge and perform a charged shot.
The shot is considered a Basic Attack, with its DMG treated as Basic Attack DMG.
After the skill is used, it can be directly followed up with the 4th hit of Basic Attack: Dark Abyss Quartet.
During the skill's ranged phase, Anti-Interrupt level is increased, and DMG received is reduced by 40%.
Invulnerable during the slashes and ranged retreat of the skill.

descriptions.description:

descriptions.name: Defensive Assist: The End Has Not Come
descriptions.description:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Assist Follow-Up: Ace Reversal
descriptions.description:
Press after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Dash forward and perform two slashes, dealing Ice DMG.
After the skill is used, it can be directly followed up with the 4th hit of Basic Attack: Dark Abyss Quartet.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Soul Hunter - Judgment
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
Spins the scythe and then unleashes a forward slash, dealing Ice DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Soul Hunter - Punishment
descriptions.description:
With enough Energy, press to activate:
Spins the scythe to attack and then executes a powerful Finishing Move, dealing massive Ice DMG.
This skill is not counted as a heavy attack.
After the skill is used, it can be directly followed up with the 4th hit of Basic Attack: Dark Abyss Quartet.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Chain Attack: Trick of Fate
descriptions.description:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Dash forward to perform a slash across a large area, then launch a shot, dealing massive Ice DMG.
The shot activated by this skill is considered a charged shot.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Ultimate: Blaspheme
descriptions.description:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate:
Throws the scythe in a powerful spinning attack, then launches a Finishing Move, dealing massive Ice DMG.
This skill is not counted as a heavy attack.
After the skill is used, it can be directly followed up with the 4th hit of Basic Attack: Dark Abyss Quartet.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Core Passive: Terminating Verdict
skills.description:
When Chain Attack: Trick of Fate hits an enemy or Hugo's attacks Stun an enemy, Hugo gains the Dark Abyss Reverb state for 6s, and repeated triggers reset the duration. During this state, Hugo's CRIT Rate increases by 12% and CRIT DMG increases by 25%.
When there are 1/2 Stun characters in your squad, Hugo's ATK increases by 25/75.
When the Finishing Move of EX Special Attack: Soul Hunter - Punishment or Ultimate: Blaspheme hits an enemy while they are Stunned, it triggers the Totalize effect, increasing the DMG Multiplier of the skill's Finishing Move by 500%. Additionally, the Totalize effect further increases the skill's DMG multiplier based on the remaining Stun time of the enemy when triggered: for each remaining second of Stun time from the portion that is less than or equal to 5s, the skill's DMG multiplier increases by 140%; for each remaining second of Stun time from the portion between 5 and 15s, the skill's DMG multiplier increases by 50%. The total increase can raise the skill's DMG multiplier by a maximum of 1,700%.
After Hugo triggers the Totalize effect, the enemy's Stunned state will immediately end. Based on the remaining Stun time at the moment Totalize is triggered, a certain amount of Daze will be accumulated. For every second of Stun time remaining, 5% Daze is accumulated, up to a maximum Daze equivalent to 25% of the enemy's maximum Daze.
When EX Special Attack: Soul Hunter - Punishment hits an enemy, if the enemy is not Stunned, the Daze accumulated by the skill increases by 20%.

skills.name: Additional Ability: Prelude to Finality
skills.description:
When another character in your squad is a Stun character or shares the same attribute:
Chain Attack: Trick of Fate's DMG increases by 15%, with a further increase of 35% against normal enemies. When Totalize is triggered, the DMG dealt by the skill increases by 40%. EX Special Attack: Soul Hunter - Punishment generates an additional 20 Energy when triggering Totalize on normal enemies. The Energy generation effect can trigger once every 30s.

mindscapes.name: Child of Hatred
mindscapes.description: When triggering the Totalize effect in the Dark Abyss Reverb state, the skill's CRIT Rate is increased by an additional 12%, and CRIT DMG by 30%.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"So, do not deny your own desires, do not resist your own ambition. This is the talent you were born with, the best gift fate has ever given you!"
"Admit it, deep within your heart lies a spark, yearning to ignite a raging inferno that will burn everything down—"
"And I, am that spark."

"Yeah, I know. I've always known."

mindscapes.name: The Child Within
mindscapes.description: When Ultimate: Blaspheme triggers Totalize, it will not end the enemy's Stunned state. Additionally, when Totalize is triggered, the skill will ignore 15% of the enemy's DEF.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"Family is an everlasting, unavoidable curse placed upon a person."
"No matter how much you grow, no matter where you go, that curse will forever follow you like a shadow."
"When you fall to rock bottom or climb to your peak, it will appear, turning you back into that helpless, powerless child who can do nothing but hide in the closet and weep."

"Unless you truly see him, embrace him."
Some pain can only be healed when it is seen and accepted.

mindscapes.name: Fruit of the Poisonous Tree
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
They say that the flowers that bloom in the abyss are always soaked in malice, just like how a poisonous tree can't bear safe fruit.
But all fruit falls.
So, he broke himself into a rain of shattered pieces.
The rain covered the earth, and each dewdrop reflected a fresh new dawn.

mindscapes.name: Dramatic Theory
mindscapes.description: After a Charged Shot hits an enemy, Hugo's attacks against that target will ignore 12% of that target's Ice RES for 15s, repeated triggers reset the duration.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
Justice, evil, madness, reason, charm, stubbornness.
He's composed of countless faces.
"So, which is the real you?"
"That's not important. How about, instead, you tell me, Lycaon—"
"What kind of person do you see in me?"

mindscapes.name: Nirvana
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
The world doesn't need to be destroyed and rebuilt, and no one has the right to do such.
But a person can.
So, he shattered himself and was reborn.
"If I must fall, let me fall. The person I am meant to become will surely catch me."

mindscapes.name: Crown of Thorns
mindscapes.description: All shooting attacks that hit enemies trigger the Dark Abyss Reverb state, lasting up to 6s, and repeated triggers reset the duration. Additionally, whenever any skill triggers the Totalize effect, that DMG is further increased by 60%. The Finishing Move of EX Special Attack: Soul Hunter - Punishment also triggers the Totalize effect when hitting an enemy that isn't Stunned, boosting the DMG multiplier of the Finishing Move by a fixed 1,000 %.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
He walked willingly toward the endless abyss, letting the thorns on the ground tear at his wounds.
Where the blood spread, broken dignity and stubbornness began to sprout from the wounds.
He picked up the blood-soaked thorns to crown himself.
"There's only ever been one person who can kill me or save me... And that is me."

profile.details:
Asaba Harumasa, a member of Hollow Special Operations Section 6.
Possessing exceptional Ether aptitude since he was young and being dubbed a prodigy, he entered HSO after graduating with outstanding merit.
Was originally a member of a certain ace division within HSO, but later left due to various reasons, joining Miyabi's team instead.

He possesses a carefree and laidback attitude, and his only wish is to achieve acceptable results with minimum effort.
After efficiently taking care of his work to the lowest acceptable standard, he will hurry to use all the remainder of his available time to rest (slack off).
He claims he uses a bow to better slack off, as it effectively lowers the amount of running he has to do.

Asaba Harumasa has poor health, and over-exercise sometimes triggers his illness.
He often uses this reason to apply for sick leave, though no one knows what he does with this time off. Either way, it's probably not resting.
profile.details2:
Asaba Harumasa has a very rare illness, Ether Aptitude Regression Syndrome.
This illness causes certain parts of the patient's body to mutate, wrecking their constitution, but also giving them unusually exceptional Ether aptitude.
In the late stages of the illness, the patient's body will rapidly deteriorate, losing their Ether aptitude and sensory functions while under immense pain, eventually resulting in death. If the patient's illness worsens in late stages while in a Hollow, they'll quickly be corrupted into an Ethereal.
Those who suffer from Ether Aptitude Regression Syndrome do not live long. Currently, the longest-lived person with this illness died at the age of 26.
There is no known method to completely cure this disease.
profile.aptitude:
The information shows:
Executive officer Asaba Harumasa, possessing excellent Ether aptitude, is allowed to perform basic tasks like investigating and extracting resources in known Hollows within the city (including Companion Hollows).
For more information, I suggest obtaining access to Asaba Harumasa's medical history.

skins.description: His eyes are brighter than the streak of bright yellow upon his brow. His arrows pierce through deceit and lies and scatter the past like feathers on the wind. Dawn may not have arrived yet, but beyond the horizon, a golden future shimmers faintly.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Cloud Piercer
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
Launch up to five piercing attacks ahead, dealing Physical DMG and Electric DMG.
When the 5th hit of the Basic Attack hits an enemy, it generates 2 Electro Quivers.
After activating a Chain Attack, the next time Harumasa activates the 5th hit of Basic Attack: Cloud Piercer and hits an enemy with it, it generates 6 Electro Quivers.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Cloud Piercer - Drift
descriptions.description:
During Basic Attack: Cloud Piercer, drag the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} and press to activate:
Shoot a ranged piercing attack and reposition towards the corresponding drag direction, dealing Physical DMG.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Falling Feather
descriptions.description:
After the 5th hit of Basic Attack: Cloud Piercer, a Special Attack, an EX Special Attack, or a Chain Attack, hold to activate:
Immediately shoot Falling Feather at enemies ahead, dealing Electric DMG.
Hold to aim at a target and release to activate:
After drawing the bowstring and aiming, shoot Falling Feather at the target, dealing Electric DMG.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Ha-Oto no Ya
descriptions.description:
When the 5th hit of Basic Attack: Cloud Piercer/EX Special Attack/Chain Attack hits an enemy or the ground, it can generate 2/6/6 Electro Quivers. If there are no Electro Quivers on the field when any squad member applies an Attribute Anomaly to an enemy, generate 6 Electro Quivers. This effect can trigger once every 12s.
There can be up to 6 Electro Quivers present at a time. If there are any Electro Quivers present when Harumasa fires and hits enemies with Falling Feather, the Electro Quivers will activate and fire Ha-Oto no Ya at the enemies hit by Falling Feather, dealing Electric DMG.
Ha-Oto no Ya will apply Electro Prison to enemies hit, stacking up to 8 times and lasting 10s, repeated triggers reset the duration. While a target has at least 2 stacks of Electro Prison, they will be X-Marked.

descriptions.name: Dodge: Quick Flash
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru
descriptions.description:
Press during a dodge to activate:
Launch multiple piercing attacks ahead, dealing Physical DMG.

descriptions.name: Dodge Counter: Hidden Edge
descriptions.description:
Press during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Pierces enemies in front, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash
descriptions.description:
While there are X-Marked enemies on the field, Harumasa will enter the Awakened state, switching Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru for Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash.

While in the Awakened state, press during a dodge to activate:
Rush forwards to the closest X-Marked enemy and execute a powerful slash, dealing Electric DMG.
When the slash hits the target, it consumes 2 stacks of Electro Prison. With less than 2 stacks of Electro Prison, X-Marked will be removed from the enemy. Before X-Marked is removed, repeatedly press to repeatedly use Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash. While no X-Marked enemies exist on the field, Harumasa leaves the Awakened state.
While in the Awakened state, press after Basic Attack: Falling Feather to quickly follow up with Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash.
During skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash
descriptions.description:
While there are X-Marked enemies on the field, Harumasa will enter the Awakened state, switching Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru for Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash.

While in the Awakened state, press during a dodge to activate:
Rush forwards to the closest X-Marked enemy and execute a powerful slash, dealing Electric DMG.
When the slash hits the target, it consumes 2 stacks of Electro Prison. With less than 2 stacks of Electro Prison, X-Marked will be removed from the enemy. Before X-Marked is removed, repeatedly press to repeatedly use Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash. While no X-Marked enemies exist on the field, Harumasa leaves the Awakened state.
While in the Awakened state, press after Basic Attack: Falling Feather to quickly follow up with Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash.
Can Block enemy attacks during the first hit.
During skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.

descriptions.name: Assist Follow-Up: Yugamae - Slash
descriptions.description:

descriptions.description:
With enough Energy, press to activate:
Launch daggers and an enhanced arrow ahead, dealing massive Electric DMG.
When the enhanced arrow hits an enemy or the ground, it generates 6 Electro Quivers.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.description:
With enough energy, press after using the 4th/5th attack of Basic Attack: Cloud Piercer, Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash, an Ultimate, Dodge Counter: Hidden Edge, or Quick Assist: Braced Bow to activate:
Fire enhanced arrows forward in rapid succession, dealing massive Electric DMG.
When the first enhanced arrow hits an enemy or the ground, 6 Electro Quivers are generated. When the final enhanced arrow hits an enemy, it activates the Electro Quivers on the field, firing Ha-Oto no Ya at the target, dealing Electric DMG.
When the target's Electro Prison stacks are close to the maximum, fewer Electro Quivers will be activated.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Chain Attack: Kai - Hanare
descriptions.description:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleash a piercing attack on enemies in a large area ahead then fire an enhanced arrow, dealing massive Electric DMG.
When the arrow hits the ground, it generates 6 Electro Quivers.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.description:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate:

Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.description: The CRIT Rate of Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash increases by 10.6%, and when Harumasa's Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash triggers a critical hit against an enemy, he gains 1 stack of Gleaming Edge, for up to a maximum of 3 stacks per use of the skill and stacking up to 6 times, lasting 5s, repeated triggers reset the duration. Each stack of Gleaming Edge increases the CRIT DMG of Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash by 6%.

mindscapes.name: "High Spirit"
mindscapes.description: The maximum stack limit of Electro Prison from Basic Attack: Ha-Oto no Ya increases to 14 stacks. When an Electro Quiver is triggered, 2 consecutive Ha-Oto no Ya will be fired at the target.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"I'm not like some stubborn idiots who insist on facing the enemy head-on."
"Be it a straightforward assault or an underhanded attack from the shadows, anything that gets me off work earlier is good in my eyes~"

mindscapes.name: Languish
mindscapes.description: When using an Chain Attack or Ultimate, Harumasa gains 7 stacks of Electro Blitz, up to a max of 7 stacks. While possessing Electro Blitz, the DMG of Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash increases by 50%. Consume 1 stack of Electro Blitz once Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash ends.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"Don't look at me like that, I'm actually real frail, y'know~"
Harumasa lazily sprawls across his office desk.
"So... how 'bout picking someone else for this mission?"

mindscapes.name: White Lies
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"...Don't worry, this isn't enough to kill me."
He wipes the blood from the corner of his mouth with a smile and readies his bow once more.
"After all, I'm going to live to make it everyone's problem."

mindscapes.name: Occasionally Motivated
mindscapes.description: Electro Prison now lasts for 20s. When Dash Attack: Hiten no Tsuru - Slash hits enemies, Harumasa gains 30 Decibels once per use of this skill. Upon activating Ultimate, apply the maximum stacks of Electro Prison to all on-field enemies.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
Harumasa is occasionally full of energy and motivation...
When there's only five minutes left until he can get off work.

mindscapes.name: No One Knows
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"I want vacations, freedom, to be happy every day!"
"Just kidding. I want to live."

mindscapes.name: Tacit Understanding
mindscapes.description: After Ha-Oto no Ya hits Stunned enemies or enemies under Attribute Anomalies, Harumasa will ignore 15% of the target's Electric RES for 12s. Every 12 times an enemy is hit by Ha-Oto no Ya, trigger an extra electromagnetic explosion, dealing 1,500% of Harumasa's ATK to the target as Electric DMG.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"My master taught me a lot of things, like how to draw a bow, how to wield a blade, and how to survive in this world with this body of mine."
"...What happened after that?"
"Well, after that... he left me."

profile.details:
Burnice, the Nitro-Fuel bartender for the Sons of Calydon.
A hopeless fuel lover. She is responsible for all the fuel used by the machinery owned by the Sons of Calydon.
She seems to have a passion for fuel that overwhelms all else.

Burnice is super outgoing, friendly, and carefree.
She is easily able to spread her emotions to the people around her, bringing them the same optimism she possesses.
"You like the drinks I mix? Thank you! Steeltusk does, too~ That big guy can drink two hundred liters in one go!"
"Do you wanna try its special fuel blend? It's suuuuper hot!"
profile.details2:
"Fire can bring warmth, but it can also burn. For someone like this, when used with good intentions, they can keep the cold at bay, but when used with bad intentions... well, that idiot Caesar couldn't think of any bad intentions if her life depended on it."
—From a certain young heiress who wishes to remain anonymous
profile.aptitude:
There's no record of Burnice in the New Eridu Citizen Verification Profile.
Note: Burnice has a high Aptitude for Ether

skins.description:
An outfit hotter than any Nitro-Fuel. Wander into a party in the Outer Ring, and odds are you'll bump into Burnice... but drink her signature cocktails at your own risk...
Wait, you've already taken a sip? Well then — 3, 2, 1... fire!

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Direct Flame Blend
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
Unleashes up to 5 attacks in front, dealing Physical DMG and Fire DMG.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Mixed Flame Blend
descriptions.description:
In the Nitro-Fuel Cocktail state, hold to activate:
Spin continuously while spraying flames around, followed by a Finishing Move that inflicts Fire DMG. Continuing to hold extends the flame-spraying duration.
When the move is activated, it consumes 20 Heat;
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.
After executing the Finishing Move, press to immediately follow up with EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: Mixed Flame Blend
descriptions.description:
In the Nitro-Fuel Cocktail state, hold to activate:
Spins continuously while spraying flames around, followed by a Finishing Move, then triggers an extra instance of Afterburn that doesn't cost Heat and deals Fire DMG. Continuing to hold extends the flame-spraying duration.
The DMG dealt by this skill also counts as Assist Attack DMG.
Upon activation, it consumes 20 Heat.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.
After executing the Finishing Move, press to immediately follow up with EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot.

descriptions.name: Dodge: Fiery Phantom Dash
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: Dangerous Fermentation
descriptions.description:
Press during a dodge to activate:
Perform a forward rush attack with the flamethrower, dealing Fire DMG.

descriptions.name: Dodge Counter: Fluttering Steps
descriptions.description:
Press during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Launch a series of attacks on enemies in front while spraying flames, dealing Physical DMG and Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Quick Assist: Energizing Specialty Drink
descriptions.description:
When the active character is launched, press to activate:
Unleash a flurry of attacks on enemies in front while spraying flames, dealing Physical DMG and Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Quick Assist: Energizing Specialty Drink
descriptions.description:
When the active character is launched, press to activate:
Launches a series of attacks at enemies ahead and sprays flames, dealing Physical DMG and Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, press to immediately follow up with EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot.

descriptions.name: Defensive Assist: Smoky Cauldron
descriptions.description:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Assist Follow-Up: Scorching Dew
descriptions.description:
Press after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Leap into the air and quickly spin forward while spraying flames in all directions, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using the skill, press to immediately follow up with EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Intense Heat Aging Method
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
Unleash a fire blast forward, inflicting Fire DMG;
Press and hold to charge, boosting the move's power.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method
descriptions.description:
With enough energy, press to activate:
Continuously spray flames with a one-handed flamethrower, then release a fire blast in a straight line ahead, dealing massive Fire DMG. Continue holding to steadily consume energy and extend the spray's duration.
While continuously spraying, drag the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} to execute a sidestep dodge, adjusting your position in the corresponding direction.
Anti-Interrupt Level is increased while continuously spraying, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
Character is invulnerable during sidestep dodge and fire blast.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method
descriptions.description:
With enough energy, press to activate:
Continuously spray flames with a one-handed flamethrower, then release a fire blast in a straight line ahead, dealing massive Fire DMG. Continue holding to steadily consume energy and extend the spray's duration.
While continuously spraying, drag the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} to execute a sidestep dodge, adjusting your position in the corresponding direction.
Anti-Interrupt Level is increased while continuously spraying, and DMG taken is reduced by 60%.
Character is invulnerable during sidestep dodge and fire blast.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot
descriptions.description:
While using EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method, with enough Energy, press to activate:
Use both flamethrowers to continuously spray flames, followed by a fire blast in a front line, dealing massive Fire DMG. Keep holding to continue consuming Energy and extend the spray's duration.
Character is invulnerable during the moment the spray is activated and during the activation of the fire blast.
Anti-Interrupt Level is increased while spraying, and DMG received is reduced by 40%.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot
descriptions.description:
While using EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method, with enough Energy, press to activate:
Use both flamethrowers to continuously spray flames, followed by a fire blast in a front line, dealing massive Fire DMG. Keep holding to continue consuming Energy and extend the spray's duration.
Character is invulnerable during the moment the spray is activated and during the activation of the fire blast.
Anti-Interrupt Level is increased while spraying, and DMG received is reduced by 60%.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Tossing Method
descriptions.description:
If Burnice has Emberflow, coming on-field activates this skill.
After squadmates trigger Afterburn 12 times, Burnice gains 1 point of Emberflow. With Emberflow, Burnice's next entry onto the field consumes 1 stack to automatically activate this skill. This entry is considered a Quick Assist. When Afterburn triggered by Basic Attack: Mixed Flame Blend hits an enemy, it counts for 2 times. While possessing Emberflow, the counter no longer increases. Consuming Emberflow clears the counter.
Quickly dashes forward and passes through the enemy, unleashing a fiery impact that deals Physical DMG and Fire DMG.
When the skill's heavy attack hits a target suffering Ether, Electric, Fire, Physical, or Ice Anomaly, it triggers Abloom: deals an additional instance of DMG equal to 480%/240%/600%/40%/60% of the original Anomaly's DMG.
The Fire Anomaly Buildup increase from Additional Ability: Fire Kindling applies to this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, press to immediately follow up with EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot.

descriptions.name: Chain Attack: Fuel-Fed Flame
descriptions.description:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Quickly dash forward while spraying flames in all directions, then launch a fire blast in a fan-shaped area ahead, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using the skill, press to immediately follow up with EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot.

descriptions.name: Ultimate: Glorious Inferno
descriptions.description:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate:
Dash forward quickly, then leap into the air and continuously spray flames over a wide area ahead, dealing massive Fire DMG.
When leaping into the air, a Quick Assist will be triggered. If the Quick Assist is activated, Burnice will extend the duration of her flame spray.
Upon activation, recover 50 Heat.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Core Passive: Nitro-Fuel Cocktail
skills.description:
When Burnice expends Energy, she accumulates Heat, up to a max of 100. She gains 1.4 Heat for each 1 point of Energy consumed. At 50 Heat, she enters the Nitro-Fuel Cocktail state until all Heat is expended. Upon entering the battlefield, Burnice instantly accumulates 100 Heat.
While in the Nitro-Fuel Cocktail state, when Burnice hits an enemy with a Basic Attack: Mixed Flame Blend, EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method, EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot, Chain Attack: Fuel-Fed Flame, or Ultimate: Glorious Inferno, she applies the Scorched effect to the target until she exits the Nitro-Fuel Cocktail state. When other squad members hit enemies under the Scorched status, it triggers the Afterburn effect, expending 8 Heat to deal Fire DMG equal to 175% of Burnice's ATK and accumulate Fire Anomaly Buildup. This effect can trigger once every 1.5s. For every 10 Anomaly Proficiency, Afterburn DMG increases by 1%, up to a max of 30%. DMG from the Afterburn effect is considered Assist Attack DMG.

skills.name: Additional Ability: Fire Kindling
skills.description:
When another character in your squad is an Anomaly character or shares the same Faction:
When Burnice's Basic Attack: Mixed Flame Blend, EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method or EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot hits an enemy, or when the Afterburn effect is triggered, the move's accumulated Fire Anomaly Buildup increases by 65%. When any squad member applies the Burn effect to an enemy, the duration of that effect is extended by 3s.

While in the Nitro-Fuel Cocktail state, when Burnice hits an enemy with a Basic Attack: Mixed Flame Blend, EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method, EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot, Chain Attack: Fuel-Fed Flame, or Ultimate: Glorious Inferno, she applies the Scorched effect to the target until she exits the Nitro-Fuel Cocktail state. When other squad members hit enemies under the Scorched status, it triggers the Afterburn effect, expending 8 Heat to deal Fire DMG equal to 235% of Burnice's ATK and accumulate Fire Anomaly Buildup. This effect can trigger once every 1.5s. For every 10 Anomaly Proficiency, Afterburn DMG increases by 1%, up to a max of 30%. DMG from the Afterburn effect is considered Assist Attack DMG.

skills.name: Additional Ability: Fire Kindling
skills.description:
When another character in your squad is an Anomaly character or shares the same Faction:
When Burnice's Basic Attack: Mixed Flame Blend, EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method or EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot hits an enemy, or when the Afterburn effect is triggered, the move's accumulated Fire Anomaly Buildup increases by 65%. When any squad member applies the Burn effect to an enemy, the duration of that effect is extended by 3s.

mindscapes.name: Kindred Flames
mindscapes.description: Increases the limit of Heat from 100 to 140. Upon entering the battlefield, Burnice accumulates an additional 40 Heat. Increases the DMG Multiplier of the Afterburn effect by 100% of Burnice's ATK. Additionally, the accumulated Fire Anomaly Buildup from the Afterburn effect is increased by 25%.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"Everyone has rough times; it's perfectly normal!"
"Cheer up, Caesar! How about a Nitro-Fuel special? I added a ton of sugar!"

mindscapes.name: Extra at No Additional Charge
mindscapes.description: When triggering the Afterburn effect, Thermal Penetration is applied to the enemy, stacking up to 5 times and lasting 6s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. When any allied unit in the squad hits the enemy, the attack's PEN Ratio is increased by 4% for each stack of Thermal Penetration, up to a max of 20%.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
As the mixologist for the Sons of Calydon, Burnice takes great pleasure in crafting the best Nitro-Fuel drinks in New Eridu for her friends.
Of course, if you happen to be her enemy... you might have the opportunity to try a new and unique flavor too.
"It's a once-in-a-lifetime, absolutely exquisite taste!"

mindscapes.name: Optimistic by Nature
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"That Burnice, she's always so full of energy! Even right after waking up! I have no idea where she gets all that energy..."
"What's even scarier is that she can get everyone around her to be just as enthusiastic! It's almost like she's some kind of monster!"
"But... I don't really dislike it, to be honest..."
— From a boar manager who wishes to remain unnamed

mindscapes.name: Ultimate Fuel Supply
mindscapes.description: When an EX Special Attack or Assist Attack hits an enemy, the move's CRIT Rate increases by 30%. The max flame spray duration of EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot is increased by 1s.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"You like the drink I mixed? Thanks! Steeltusk likes them too~ That guy can drink 200 liters in one go!"
"Oh, Steeltusk is our big truck!"
"Wanna try some of its special fuel? It's pretty fiery~"

mindscapes.name: Dance of Fire and Ice
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
When mixing drinks, ice is a crucial element.
Without an intense chill, the intense heat just doesn't stand out.
"That fusion of fire and ice~ It's truly captivating!"

mindscapes.name: Burning Invitation
mindscapes.description: When Burnice hits an enemy with EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot, it triggers an additional special Afterburn effect, dealing 60% of Burnice's ATK as Fire DMG to the target. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s and does not consume Heat. After hitting an enemy with EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot, while the move is active, EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot, special Afterburn effects, and Burn effects will ignore 25% of the target's Fire RES. When EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot's fire blast hits an enemy, if that enemy is Burned, trigger an additional instance of Burn DMG equal to 1,800% of the original DMG. This effect can trigger once every 20s for each target.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
It seems like no one has ever seen Burnice truly angry.
"Trust me, you don't want to see it."
— From a driver getting ready to sleep atop Steeltusk

Core Passive: Nitro-Fuel Cocktail's Afterburn interval is reduced to 1.35s.

profile.details:
Grace is a technical expert at Belobog Industries. She's the core talent in developing and patenting Belobog's in-Hollow machinery.
She's obsessed with gears, metal and wires — a true mechanical geek. She's eager to dismantle and study any machinery or equipment she takes an interest in: "Such sharp and strong lines, truly beautiful... I can't help but want to open it up and take a look."

Grace always shows extraordinary patience when dealing with machines, doting on the sophisticated metal constructions as if they were her own children.
According to the information at hand, Grace is probably the only one who can playfully refer to Koleda as "Sweet Pea" without receiving a kick in the shin.
Question: Based on Grace's understanding of machines, would she consider me one? I'm currently lacking a physical form, however, so I don't possess components like gears, metal, or wires.
profile.details2: Both of Grace's parents, who were research workers related to the Hollow, disappeared during a dangerous expedition into a Hollow, and were soon presumed dead. Grace was adopted by her parents' former friend, Khors, the previous president of Belobog Industries, and Koleda's father. As a result, Grace and Koleda are "sisters," though not related by blood.
profile.aptitude:
New Eridu Citizen Verification Profile Info:
Hollow Investigator — Grace, possessing high Ether aptitude, is allowed to perform basic tasks like investigating and extracting resources in known Hollows within the city (including Companion Hollows).
Note: Prolonged exposure to machinery in Ether environments could impact personal health, so please be mindful.

skins.description: A clean, no-nonsense work uniform. What the genius mechanic loves most are the many pockets on the outside — big ones, small ones — all perfect for holding screws, gears, and even wrenches of every size.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: High-Pressure Spike
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
Unleashes up to 4 attacks, dealing Physical DMG and Electric DMG.
While launching Basic Attacks, drag the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} to attack while moving. This allows Grace to reposition herself and deal Physical DMG.
While Grace is launching Basic Attacks, her Basic Attack combo will not be interrupted by her Special Attacks, EX Special Attacks, Dodge, Dash Attacks, or Dodge Counter.

descriptions.name: Basic Attack: High-Pressure Spike
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
Unleashes up to 4 attacks, dealing Physical DMG and Electric DMG.
While launching Basic Attacks, drag the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} to move while attacking. This allows Grace to reposition herself and deal Physical DMG. If used after the 1st or 2nd hit of a Basic Attack, pressing again resumes the combo from the 3rd or 4th hit of the Basic Attack.
While Grace is launching Basic Attacks, her Basic Attack combo will not be interrupted by her Special Attacks, EX Special Attacks, Dodge, Dash Attacks, or Dodge Counter.

descriptions.name: Dodge: Safety Regulation
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dash Attack: Quick Inspection
descriptions.description:
Press during a dodge to activate:
Slide forward while shooting, dealing Physical DMG.

descriptions.name: Dodge Counter: Violation Penalty
descriptions.description:
Press during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Throws a grenade at enemies, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Dodge Counter: Violation Penalty
descriptions.description:
Press during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Throws a grenade at enemies, dealing Electric DMG, then automatically triggers the Basic Attack's 4th hit.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Quick Assist: Incident Management
descriptions.description:
When the active character is launched in the air, press to activate:
Throws a grenade at the enemy, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Evasive Assist: Rapid Risk Response
descriptions.description:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press to activate:
Dodges the enemy's attack and activates Vital View.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Assist Follow-Up: Counter Volt Needle
descriptions.description:
Press after an Evasive Assist to activate:
Unleashes a spinning hail of bullets against enemies in front and throws a grenade, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Obstruction Removal
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
Throws a grenade to the front, dealing Electric DMG.
Upon use, drag the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} to change directions.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Obstruction Removal
descriptions.description:
Press to activate:
Throws a grenade forward, dealing Electric DMG.
During the skill, drag the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} to reposition in that direction.
When activated via consuming Zap, dodge incoming enemy attacks.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Supercharged Obstruction Removal
descriptions.description:
With enough Energy, press to activate:
Leap in the air and throw two grenades to the front, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Upon use, drag the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} to change directions.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: EX Special Attack: Supercharged Obstruction Removal
descriptions.description:
With enough Energy, press to activate:
Leaps into the air and throws two grenades forward, dealing massive Electric DMG.
During the skill, drag the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} to change directions.
If Zap reaches max stacks, throws an additional Vortex Cluster Grenade, generating an electromagnetic field at the point of detonation that pulls in enemies and deals Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Pulse
descriptions.description:
Activating an Ultimate grants 25 stacks of Pulse (max 25 stacks). When gaining Zap, consumes 1 stack of Pulse.
After consuming Pulse to obtain 8 stacks of Zap, the next grenade throw includes an additional Pulse Grenade. If it hits an enemy suffering Ether, Electric, Fire, Physical, or Ice Anomaly, it triggers Abloom: deals an additional instance of DMG equal to 560%/280%/700%/50%/70% of the original Anomaly's DMG.
While in the Pulse state, Special Attack: Obstruction Removal - Cycle is unlocked.

descriptions.name: Special Attack: Obstruction Removal - Cycle
descriptions.description:
While in the Pulse state, hold to activate:
Repeatedly hurls grenades forward during the skill, dealing Electric DMG and granting 1 Zap stack each time grenades are thrown.
During the skill, tilt the {LAYOUT_CONSOLECONTROLLER#stick}{LAYOUT_FALLBACK#joystick} to reposition and dodge enemy attacks.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Chain Attack: Collaborative Construction
descriptions.description:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Throws three grenades into the air then strafes to detonate them, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Ultimate: Demolition Blast - Beware
descriptions.description:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate:
Throws a custom grenade which explodes in the air and splits into four smaller grenades, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptions.name: Ultimate: Demolition Blast - Beware
descriptions.description:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press to activate:
Throws a custom grenade which explodes in the air and splits into four smaller grenades, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Gains 8 stacks of Zap and 25 stacks of Pulse (max 25 stacks).
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

profile.details:
Anton is a key member of construction staff at Belobog Industries and one of Koleda's trusted aides.
"Got a job you can't handle? Leave it to me!"
Anton is one of the top brass at Belobog, handpicked by its former president Khors, which makes him a "senior employee."
A genuine, straightforward man, always boosting the morale of his coworkers with his surplus of energy.

Apart from this, it seems Anton is always talking to his jackhammer, affectionately calling it, "Bro."
An instance from Anton's everyday life goes like this:
Anton, seemingly in dialogue with himself, asks, "Whaddaya think, Bro?"
The jackhammer replies, "Vroom vroom vroom—"
Anton, apparently enlightened, responds, "I see, I see! You still got it, Bro!"
Unfortunately, I have not collected enough information on such occurrences and am not able to deliver further analysis.
profile.details2:
Here is a video recording depicting Anton's life:
Late at night at the construction site, Anton gazes down at his jackhammer and mutters to himself, "Dang, this is exhausting, Bro..."
As the jackhammer buzzed to life, Anton nodded in acknowledgment. "No, a real one doesn't complain about being tired! Thanks for reminding me, buddy! You can never back down from a challenge!"
The truth is, Anton had set up demanding tasks for the construction workers, hoping to push them to their limits and unlock their true potential. However, witnessing their struggles and diminishing confidence, he couldn't bear to see them suffer any longer, so he secretly completed all the tasks in the dead of night.
In the end, Anton became the one who accepted all the trials.

* Anton's beloved "bro," aka his jackhammer, appears to have a connection to his former colleagues.

profile.details:
Lycaon, the substantive leader and representative of Victoria Housekeeping Co., is responsible for managing all members of the company.
Rational and reliable, Lycaon is an elegant gentleman and a versatile attendant who can solve any problem. He is the cornerstone of his team and a reassuring presence.
He has a slight obsession with cleanliness, always tidying up his surroundings and unable to tolerate dirty environments.

Although Lycaon maintains his elegance and composure, his canine instincts occasionally shine through. When he is particularly happy, his tail and ears unconsciously wag. He seems to be aware of this habit and somewhat bothered by it.
Additionally, like most furry Thiren, Lycaon takes great care of his fur.

Suggestion: Since Lycaon is a canine Thiren, stroking his head or chin may enhance the emotional connection between you. (Note: Success is not guaranteed.)
* Risks: Due to his height, you may not be able to do this even if you stand on tiptoes.
profile.details2:
Lycaon has a troubled past that he keeps to himself.
Despite his current elegant and gentle demeanor, the former Lycaon led a wild lifestyle and had a friend whom he trusted implicitly.
However, this friend has now become a bitter enemy.

Note: Due to limited information, it is challenging to uncover the specifics of his past.
You should consider trying to gather information from different angles about the individuals involved to obtain more valuable intelligence.

mindscapes.flavorDesc:
Records suggest that werewolves exposed to moonlight become significantly more aggressive.
"Don't stare directly at the moon."

mindscapes.name: Energy Feedback
mindscapes.description: When Stunning an enemy or triggering a squad member's Chain Attack, Lycaon gains 5 Energy. Can trigger once every 1s.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"Canines receive a brief dopamine boost in their brains after completing semi-complex tasks. At that moment, if their owner pets them to show encouragement, they will be extremely happy..."
—Excerpt from the "Handbook of Unreliable Canine Research"

mindscapes.name: Attendant Training
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc: His every gesture exudes poise, and his words and actions are as refreshing as a spring breeze. An attendant's training is about maintaining control over everything.

mindscapes.name: Graceful Demeanor
mindscapes.description:
If Lycaon is attacked while using a Basic Attack or Special Attack, he will immediately gain a Shield equal to 7.5% of his Max HP, lasting for 15s.
During the Shield's duration, his Anti-Interrupt level is increased. This effect can trigger once every 15s.
mindscapes.flavorDesc: "An outstanding attendant maintains a graceful demeanor at any and all times."

mindscapes.name: Alpha Nature
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2
mindscapes.flavorDesc: His glance harbors a primal ferocity, and the echoes of his howls rumble within his throat. Regardless of his current gracefulness, underneath the formal wear, he's still untamed.

mindscapes.name: Ruthless Hunter
mindscapes.description: When a charged attack hits an enemy, the target suffers 10% increased DMG from Lycaon, stacking up to 5 times and lasting 12s. Only one stack can be gained per skill use, and repeated triggers reset the duration.
mindscapes.flavorDesc:
"Apologies, but given the circumstances, I will not show any mercy."
"After all, if a fair fight is what you are after, a Hollow is not the place to look for it."
